items.title: American Dad!
items.overview: The series focuses on an eccentric motley crew that is the Smith family and their three housemates: Father, husband, and breadwinner Stan Smith; his better half housewife, Francine Smith; their college-aged daughter, Hayley Smith; and their high-school-aged son, Steve Smith. Outside of the Smith family, there are three additional main characters, including Hayley's boyfriend turned husband, Jeff Fischer; the family's man-in-a-goldfish-body pet, Klaus; and most notably the family's zany alien, Roger, who is "full of masquerades, brazenness, and shocking antics."
items.director: Matt Weitzman, Seth MacFarlane, Mike Barker
items.tagline: From the creator of "Family Guy" comes a man who will stop at nothing to protect his country.

items.title: Oops! I'm the Concubine
items.overview: Free-spirited commoner Lina unexpectedly becomes a candidate to wed the cold and duty-bound Prince Kiran, but as she navigates palace rivalries and political intrigue, she discovers she may be the key to exposing a rebellion—and the consort destined for him all along.

items.title: New Group
items.overview: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. One day, the people in her school inexplicably start to form a human pyramid. The principal and other teachers start to act weird and encourage taking part in it, and the various gymnastic formations start to spread and take over the whole town. Eventually only Ai and Yuu, a transfer student who finds it hard to fit in, are left to rebel against the conformity madness.

items.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
items.overview: Akhandanand Tripathi sits on the throne of Mirzapur. Munna Tripathi is heir apparent. Rati Shankar Shukla is the rival from Jaunpur. And, Guddu and Bablu are the two brothers who came like a tornado and changed things irreversibly. And now comes a new claimant in town. Babban Babua, from the desert of Jaisalmer. A ruthless man who is power hungry.
items.tagline: Witness the epic untold story.

items.title: Kahar: Kapla High Council
items.overview: Set in 2005, socially invisible Kahar risks tainting his family’s KUDRAT legacy when he volunteers for the Pilihanraya in order to protect his best friend. In this opportunity to rebrand himself, we witness the transformation of Kahar, from what begins as a noble act steers Kahar into the path of malevolence and tyranny.
items.tagline: Violence Is Not The Answer

items.title: Under Siege
items.overview: November 1985: The armed group, M-19, storms the Palace of Justice in Bogotá, unleashing a wave of violence that would change Colombia forever. Amid crossfire, desperate hostages, an unrelenting army, and a guerrilla movement ready to risk everything, the nation watches as war tears through the heart of its capital for the first time. The 27 hours of horror would be followed by 40 years of unanswered questions.

items.title: Jasmine
items.overview: Yasemin is a young woman battling a fatal heart condition, with her obsessive stepbrother Tufan as her only support. Her struggle to make it onto the transplant list draws them into dark networks and morally fraught choices.

items.title: Possible Love
items.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

items.title: Campus Drivers
items.overview: Lois has everything going for her: she's been accepted into the prestigious Belrose University alongside her lifelong love, Max. Lane, on the other hand, lives by his own rules. Creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, he is as famous for his devastating smile as for his inability to commit. Their paths were never supposed to cross. Until the night when Lois, heartbroken, shows up on his doorstep. An unexpected cohabitation. Two worlds colliding. And an attraction impossible to ignore. But some encounters change everything… even awakening buried wounds. And when love arrives uninvited, nothing is certain anymore.

items.title: Heart of the Beast
items.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
items.tagline: Survival depends on their bond.

items.title: Dream
items.overview: Years ago, journalist Shen Leshui recorded the lives of workers at the Old La City Brewery. Now she returns to La City, picks up her camera again, and explores corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan, Cheng Youtian... These people, once the subjects of her lens, experience the rise and fall of fate in the torrent of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time. Moving between the past and the present, Shen Leshui uncovers these chapters of the past buried by time.

items.title: Rising Justice
items.overview: A principled lawyer rebuilds her career in her hometown by forming an unconventional team to fight for justice while reconciling with her estranged father.

items.title: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
items.overview: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

items.title: Overacting
items.overview: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.
items.tagline: When Fake Missions Spiral Beyond Control.

items.title: April X
items.overview: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.
items.tagline: Find her. Find the truth.

items.title: Model Citizen
items.overview: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.
items.tagline: Bury the past. Control the truth.

items.title: No Game No Life
items.overview: Bored with life and considering the real world to be just a “crappy game,” savvy sibling shut-ins Sora and Shiro have withdrawn into their own fantasy world filled with video games. However, one day they find themselves summoned to another world by a boy who calls himself “God,” their abilities are about to be put to the ultimate test! Now not only their fates — but the fate of all of humanity — will be decided by a series of games that may just be the hardest these super-geniuses have ever faced!

items.title: Anaesthesia
items.overview: After a bold but unsuccessful surgery, a talented doctor swaps a prestigious clinic for a local hospital as he tries to get his life back on track.

items.title: The Greatest
items.overview: An intimate exploration of the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

items.title: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
items.overview: When a medical emergency pulls the Goss family apart, determined dog Winstead will do all he can to bring his humans back together before Christmas Eve.

items.title: Akka
items.overview: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

items.title: Obsess
items.overview: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

items.title: A Great Awakening
items.overview: One of the most defining moments in American history is the story of an unlikely friendship between the Reverend George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin.
items.tagline: Before the American Revolution, there was a revelation.

items.title: Toradora!
items.overview: Menacing in appearance but gentle at heart, second year high school student Ryuuji forms an unlikely friendship with classmate Taiga, a tiny girl with a sharp tongue and a tough attitude.
items.tagline: Palmtop Tiger. Delinquent Dragon.

items.title: Heartbeat
items.overview: Caught up in anxiety, eight-year-old Chul in school tells his teacher that he is going to the bathroom but runs straight home.

items.title: My Best Friend
items.overview: Facing menopause and empty-nest anxiety, friends Julia and Clara decide to travel together to visit their daughters who are on an exchange program abroad.

items.title: Bass X Machina
items.overview: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

items.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
items.overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

items.title: The Remarried Empress
items.overview: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.
items.tagline: ‎I accept this divorce and I request an approval of my remarriage.

items.title: Charlie Harper
items.overview: As an ambitious chef and her struggling partner move to a new city to start fresh, the stark divide in their drives tests the limits of their love.
items.tagline: is love enough?

items.title: Primetime
items.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
items.tagline: Are you ready to make television history?

items.title: Come Back Alive
items.overview: After being literally worked to death, one man comes back to life while possessing a handsome man for a limited time.
items.tagline: "I can't go to heaven because I'm wronged!"

items.title: The Village: Achiara's Secret
items.overview: Achiara is a quiet, peaceful village with hardly any crime. But on her first day of school there, English language instructor Kim So-yoon discovers a buried corpse. As the townspeople speculate on the identity of the dead person and the reason she was killed, So-yoon and policeman Park Woo-jae become determined to solve the mystery.

items.title: Beware Boiúna
items.overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.
items.tagline: Witness terror on a gigantic scale.

items.title: The Hidden Guardian
items.overview: A formidable bodyguard secretly searches for his estranged wife and daughter while protecting them from a corporate heir's schemes, fighting to reunite his family and bring his enemies to justice.

items.title: Resident Evil
items.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
items.tagline: A new era of evil.

items.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
items.overview: This 45-minute reimagining brings modern animation and fresh storytelling to the classic tale. In this new adventure, Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

items.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
items.overview: The Mouse King casts an evil spell over Clara that causes her to shrink. Clara and the Nutcracker set out on an adventurous journey to find Sugarplum Princess, who has the power to undo the spell.
items.tagline: Starring in Her First Movie!

items.title: The Snoopy Show
items.overview: The world's most iconic dog is ready for his close-up. Dive into new adventures with the happy-dancing, high-flying, big-dreaming beagle, who's joined by best friend Woodstock and the rest of the Peanuts gang.
items.director: Rob Boutilier, Mark Evestaff, Alex Galatis
items.tagline: Happiness is back.

items.title: The Vanishing Beauty
items.overview: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

items.title: IT: Welcome to Derry - A Story of Derry
items.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

items.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
items.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

items.title: Collision Course
items.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

items.title: Kong Tao
items.overview: Local property developer Song Longchen secretly employs black magic—known as Hexing—to seize control of valuable land parcels. His schemes leave behind a trail of unexplained deaths, which authorities dismiss as mere accidents due to widespread skepticism toward the supernatural.

items.title: The Birthday​ Gift​
items.overview: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

items.title: The Cursed: Insatiable Desires
items.overview: An old man attempting to harm the village's mystical guardian tree. An office worker, obsessed with beauty, tampering with her neighbor's packages. A mother making deals with ghosts to secure her daughter's place in medical school. A senior police officer insisting on handling a case alone, despite his junior's objections. A college student seeking fame on social media through horror content. These seemingly unrelated incidents are eerily linked by their intertwined relationships and a shared undercurrent of wrong choices driven by desire. At the heart of it all lies a sinister dark market. Once its true nature is revealed, there’s no turning back.

items.title: The Red Shoes
items.overview: A woman who finds a pair of pink high heels on a subway platform soon realizes that jealousy, greed, and death follow them wherever they go.
items.tagline: One size kills all.

items.title: The Omen
items.overview: Immediately after their miscarriage, the US diplomat Robert Thorn adopts the newborn Damien without the knowledge of his wife. Yet what he doesn’t know is that their new son is the son of the devil.
items.tagline: You have been warned. If something frightening happens to you today, think about it. It may be The Omen.

items.title: Dead-End Job
items.overview: When a debtor is lured by a strange agency with the promise of lucrative gigs, he is soon thrust into a hellish world of terror and unpredictability.
items.tagline: 50x Minimum wage guaranteed, will you accept this sweet gig?

items.title: The Perfect Lie
items.overview: After a heart-fluttering date, Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night. The next day, they meet at a police station with completely different memories. A shocking polygraph result turns their lives upside down.
items.tagline: The one who's been lying is you.

items.title: Siccîn 9
items.overview: A mother's desperate cry to protect her child awakens an ancient, forbidden spell. As a horrific murder is concealed, the buried secret festers beneath the earth, transforming into a darker force. Years later, a mysterious death resurfaces the long-hidden sin: "The Seal of Bloodline."
items.tagline: Horror never ends.

items.title: Nocturne
items.overview: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.
items.tagline: Outthink the killer. Outrun the lies.

items.title: First Love Again
items.overview: Gu Han, a quiet and distant basketball player, struggles with his past and a fear of separation, while Zhou Xiangxang, a cheerful student with stage fright, dreams of becoming a host. Their growing connection helps Gu Han face his fears, while Zhou Xiangxang finds new courage and warmth in their relationship.

items.title: Balaraw: Blood Island
items.overview: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

items.title: The Fall of El Mayo
items.overview: Co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, longtime partner of "El Chapo", and a ghost to authorities for over three decades. The documentary that tells the story of his downfall.

items.title: You, Me, Us
items.overview: A couple faces the difficult path to adoption, determined to become parents despite their complex vulnerabilities.

items.title: Her in Frame
items.overview: Inspired by the love story of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit, the movie follows a young photographer and a textile museum curator who connect through a mysterious vintage photograph.

items.title: The Gift of Deceit
items.overview: Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness affecting her daughter, art collector Lúcia Rossetti turns to a spiritual healer. When Lúcia falls victim to a scam, a series of secrets is revealed, intertwining two families marked by love, control, resentment, and guilt.

items.title: The World's Strongest Rearguard
items.overview: After a fatal accident, overworked office worker Arihito Atobe is reborn in the Labyrinth Country as a Seeker with the rare Rearguard class—an all-purpose support role that excels in attack, defense, and healing. Joined by a fierce demi-human mercenary and his former boss, Arihito dives into deadly dungeons and rises through the ranks. The adventure of the strongest support class begins!

items.title: The Chosen: Forbidden Cave
items.overview: Jin-Myung is a psychiatrist and exorcist. With his assistant, Ji-Kwang, they attempt an exorcism on Geum-Joo. She suffers from a bizarre phenomenon. They then face a powerful existence within Geum-Joo. Extreme horror arises out of her.

items.title: LA BOLA NEGRA
items.overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
items.tagline: Love leaves a legacy.

items.title: Driving Mom Crazy
items.overview: After criminals kidnap her baby, overwhelmed new mom Ruyi Zhang joins an unlikely crew of gangsters, ghosts and deities for a frantic rescue mission.

items.title: Fired Up!
items.overview: Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life’s challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

items.title: Call My Manager
items.overview: Shine Artist Management talent managers deal with personal drama, unexpected visits, and client dilemmas.

items.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
items.overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

cast.name: Sacha Baron Cohen
cast.character: Alistair Leslie 'Ali G' Graham/Colonel Erran Morad/Dr. Nira Cain-N'Degeocello

items.tagline: Livin XXX large.

items.title: Drive - The Pretenders
items.overview: A young race car mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star - officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything - including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

items.title: Never After Dark
items.overview: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

items.title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
items.overview: When a messy underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant, she must overcome skeptical doctors, a useless baby daddy, and her oversharing mum in order to survive and reclaim her life.

items.title: Light the Dark
items.overview: In the coastal town of Fogang, a family's life within the state oil corporation collapses after a gas explosion in 1997, leading the son Chen Shan to unearth factional conspiracies behind the tragedy through a new blast in 2001.

items.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
items.overview: Once the Demon King, now a shut-in NEET—Ryusei Narukami's second life is anything but peaceful! When Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who once defeated him, suddenly returns as a normal high school girl, his world is thrown into chaos. Determined to change, Ryusei reenters society as a teacher and ends up teaching at her school! Their explosive reunion reignites the past—and sparks an unexpected love!

items.title: Filipiñana
items.overview: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

items.title: Fresh Off the Boat
items.overview: A '90s-set single-camera comedy about a hip-hop-loving Asian kid growing up in suburban Orlando, being raised by an immigrant father obsessed with all things American and an immigrant mother often bewildered by white culture.

items.title: kiDnap GAME
items.overview: Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.
items.tagline: How Far Are You Willing To Go To Save Her(Him)? Only One Can Be Saved.

items.title: Summer Vacation
items.overview: An ordinary teen girl longs for something new – will meeting a handsome boy in a countryside village change her life?

items.title: Minimum Wage
items.overview: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage in this series based on the hit social media shorts.

items.title: The One About Matthew Perry
items.overview: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.
items.tagline: All great stories have both comedy and tragedy.

items.title: Verity
items.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.
items.tagline: There is no light where we're going.

items.title: Forgotten Island
items.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
items.tagline: No memory left behind.

items.title: The Lost Ones
items.overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

items.title: The Stunt Driver
items.overview: Based on a true story, a Canadian stunt driver recruits a top sports manager and rocket car designers to attempt a record-breaking jump across the Saint Lawrence River, hoping to achieve fame and fortune.

productionCompanies.name: Canada Media Fund | Fonds des médias du Canada

items.title: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP
items.overview: The story follows the unfolding of the U-17 World Cup, which takes place at the KCC Arena, in Melbourne, Australia. A total of 32 countries are participating in this long-awaited competition, and only 16 of them will manage to qualify for the final stages…

items.title: Overgeared
items.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

items.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet from My Cunning Fiancé
items.overview: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor’s son to make a bet with her about their future!

items.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

items.title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
items.overview: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

items.title: Sense and Sensibility
items.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
items.tagline: No one knows your heart like a sister.

items.title: The Dog Stars
items.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.
items.tagline: At the end of the world, no one survives alone.

items.title: Little Krishna
items.overview: Little Krishna, the darling of Vrindavan, defends the land of peace and tranquility from the evil king Kamsa. Kamsa sends ferocious demons to end Krishna, but Krishna is born to be a savoir and crushes them with heroic poise.

items.title: Star Detective Precure!
items.overview: On her 14th birthday, Anna Akechi meets a magical fairy and suddenly time-slips from 2027 to 1999! There, she befriends Mikuru, a spirited girl who dreams of becoming a detective. When mysterious thefts stir rumors of the Phantom Thieves, the two transform into Detective Precure, using courage, deduction, and friendship to solve cases and uncover the secret of Anna's journey through time.

cast.name: Nao Toyama
cast.character: Luluka Moria / Cure Arcana Shadow / Cure Arcana (voice)

items.title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In with a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
items.overview: In a world where magical Gifts determine your destiny, Lent’s rare ability lets him lend his magic points to others. He forms an adventuring party called the Skypiercers with his friends, helping them become powerful heroes, only to be later cast aside as dead weight. Furious, Lent awakens the true power of his Gift: Forced Collection, the power to repossess magic. His revenge starts now.

items.title: HORROR COLLECTOR
items.overview: Not all urban legends are myths. Some are real, and they’re coming to life. Fushigi roams Japan in a red hood, sealing them inside his magical notebook, with Jimmy, his human-faced dog, by his side. Each phenomenon brings him one step closer to capturing Himitsu, the girl responsible for manifesting the supernatural beings.

items.title: Magical Explorer
items.overview: Reborn in his favorite bishojo game, Kousuke gets the worst role possible: the forgettable sidekick. But armed with his knowledge of the game and this world’s largest mana pool, he might even surpass the hero! Now Kousuke must rewrite his fate and battle his way toward the heroines’ happy endings!

items.title: VERTEX FORCE
items.overview: Akira Todo has always lived in the shadow of his sister, Haruka, who secretly wields their father’s mysterious “Engine.” But when a mysterious enemy comes for his family, Akira is forced into a battle that threatens the entire world. He may have inherited none of his father’s power, but now he must find a way to fight back. Or risk losing everything he cares about.

items.title: #I'm Looking for Zombie
items.overview: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

items.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
items.overview: Fia always dreamed of being a great knight, despite her lack of talent as a swordswoman. Then, a brush with death in battle awakens memories of her past life as the legendary Saint who defeated the Demon King. Her powers return, but so do the enemies who killed her once before. Fia vows to conceal her true identity to survive. But how can a knight resist using her powers to help those in need?

items.title: Romelia War Chronicle
items.overview: Victory over the Demon King should have been Romelia’s triumph. Instead, her fiance, Prince Henri, breaks off their engagement and sends her home in disgrace to a province in ruins. With no aid in sight, Romelia vows to raise an army, rebuild the ruined towns, and restore a struggling kingdom as new conflicts arise. The war may be over, but her story’s just begun.

items.title: The Vermilion Mask
items.overview: Apprentice mask maker Peru should have known the perils of The Masks. Possessed by the Mask of the Warrior God, he unintentionally kills his friends and his master, the legendary Gaston Roux. Wracked with guilt, Peru vows to destroy every mask his master created before tragedy strikes again. As his mission takes him around the world, Peru makes friends, battles enemies, and reckons with his sins.

items.title: KERORO☆
items.overview: Sergeant Keroro comes to conquer Earth, only to get captured and stuck living with the Hinata family!

cast.name: Hisao Egawa
cast.character: Supreme Commander of the Keron Army (voice)

items.title: Rilakkuma
items.overview: No matter what your day brings, Rilakkuma—always by your side—is stepping out of the everyday and into a laid-back, expansive world of animation. A moment that makes your heart feel light and carefree. Wherever you are, whatever you’re doing, keep Rilakkuma close by. An exciting new story is about to unfold.

items.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
items.overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.
items.tagline: What's that coming over the hill?

items.title: Love Language
items.overview: Following a failed engagement, Lou discovers she has a talent for writing other people’s wedding vows. Word spreads across Chicago’s wedding scene and Lou’s services are in high demand. She even has a new admirer in Dash. But everything changes when she’s asked to write vows for Olivia, who’s marrying Warren, Lou’s old college flame.

items.title: The Cycle
items.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.
items.tagline: You can't bury the past forever.

items.title: The 3 Killer Pigs
items.overview: A local farmer is desperate and does the unthinkable in his attempt to get his precious livestock back. A blood oath is put in place when the killer pigs make their way back to where their nightmare began. Darkness shrouds the farmhouse and its occupants when the three piggies come home.

items.title: The Exit State
items.overview: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.
items.tagline: Make yourself at home.

items.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
items.overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

items.title: Romantic Killer
items.overview: A gaming-obsessed teen must reignite romance energy for a fading magic realm by dating within a month. Forced into proximity with three charming suitors, will she dodge love's chaos—or embrace unexpected heartbeats to reclaim her mundane life?

items.title: Totto-chan: The Little Girl at the Window
items.overview: This engaging series of childhood recollections tells of an unconventional school in Tokyo during World War II that combined learning with fun, freedom, and love. The school had old railroad cars for classrooms and was run by an extraordinary man – its founder and headmaster, Sōsaku Kobayashi – who deeply valued children's independence, and who was a firm believer in freedom of expression and activity.
items.tagline: You really are a good kid.

items.title: The Little Prince
items.overview: Based on the best-seller book 'The Little Prince', the movie tells the story of a little girl that lives with resignation in a world where efficiency and work are the only dogmas. Everything will change when accidentally she discovers her neighbor that will tell her about the story of the Little Prince that he once met.

cast.name: Jacquie Barnbrook
cast.character: The Nurse / The Worried Neighbor / The Snooty Panelist (voice)

items.tagline: Growing up isn't the problem... forgetting is.

items.title: Sense and Sensibility
items.overview: The Dashwood sisters, sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne, learn that their prospects of marriage seem doomed by their family's sudden loss of fortune. After Henry Dashwood dies unexpectedly, his estate must pass on by law to his son. These circumstances leave Mr. Dashwood's wife and daughters without a home and with barely enough money to live on. As Elinor and Marianne struggle to find romantic fulfillment in a society obsessed with financial and social status, they must learn to mix sense with sensibility in their dealings with both money and men.
items.tagline: Lose your heart and come to your senses.

items.title: A Clockwork Orange
items.overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?
items.tagline: Being the adventures of a young man whose principal interests are rape, ultra-violence and Beethoven.

items.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
items.overview: Holly Golightly is an eccentric New York City playgirl determined to marry a Brazilian millionaire. But when young writer Paul Varjak moves into her apartment building, her past threatens to get in their way.
items.tagline: Audrey Hepburn plays that daring, darling Holly Golightly to a new high in entertainment delight!

items.title: Roman Holiday
items.overview: Overwhelmed by her suffocating schedule, touring European princess Ann takes off for a night while in Rome. When a sedative she took from her doctor kicks in, however, she falls asleep on a park bench and is found by an American reporter, Joe Bradley, who takes her back to his apartment for safety. At work the next morning, Joe finds out Ann's regal identity and bets his editor he can get exclusive interview with her, but romance soon gets in the way.

items.title: GET JIRO
items.overview: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

cast.name: Dominic Burgess
cast.character: Mr. Madison / Young Chef / Big Purveyor (voice)

cast.name: Roger Craig Smith
cast.character: Monty DiTulio / Louie Cervantes / Officer Thomas (voice)

items.title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for the Throne
items.overview: To the empire, Prince Arnold is one big joke, a completely inept prince outshone by his more talented twin, Leonard. But in secret, Arnold operates as Silver, one of only five magic-wielding SS-rank adventurers on the continent. As the bloody battle for the throne intensifies after the crown prince’s death, Arnold pulls the strings from the shadows to crown his twin emperor to his own advantage.

items.title: Oh! My Guard
items.overview: A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

cast.name: Im Jung-min
cast.character: Man who moves out of the house

items.tagline: Her very strange world (?) has come to me.

items.title: Final Table
items.overview: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.
items.tagline: Bring the perfect dish to life.

items.title: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
items.overview: Gen Takasegawa, the first Japanese actor to play the lead role at London's Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, has been unable to return to Japan for some time. After two years, he finally makes his way back home, only to find out that he is suddenly and completely forgotten by the entire world.

items.title: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
items.overview: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

items.title: A Certain Dark Item
items.overview: In Academy City, psychic powers promise a brighter future. But beneath the city's peaceful surface lurks a merciless dark side. ITEM, an elite team of four girls with deadly abilities, carries out dangerous missions that can never see the light of day. When a fifth girl enters their lives, ITEM is drawn deeper into a world of violence, brutality, and moral corruption.

items.title: Firefly Wedding
items.overview: Satoko Kirigaya has everything a noblewoman could want—except time. With her life running out, she’s determined to marry well and make her father proud. But when a ruthless assassin kidnaps her, she makes a desperate offer: “Marry me, and we’ll have it all.” Shinpei Goto accepts, only to become dangerously obsessed. Now Satoko must choose between duty and a love that could consume them both.

items.title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
items.overview: High school sophomore Ito was excited for a new dad when her mom remarried, but she may have gained more than she bargained for when she found four younger stepbrothers waiting at home. There’s blunt but secretly caring Gen, calm Raku, reclusive Syu, and cheerful little Rui. Now, Ito must go from the quiet of being an only child to learning how to be the eldest sister of a lively household.

items.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
items.overview: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn's future shatters when he awakens the so-called "defective" Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

items.title: TETSURYO! Meet with Tetsudou Musume
items.overview: Misaki wants to escape her everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere. And while she doesn’t yet know what she will be in the future, Misaki knows for certain that she wants to find something she is passionate about. Soon after arriving on campus to start her college life, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Club. Misaki’s heart now beats with excitement for the new world that lies ahead on the railway.

items.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
items.overview: Buy! Sell! Profit...or lose it all! University student Kurumi Fukuga jumps into the fast-moving world of foreign exchange trading to recover the 20 million yen her late mother lost. Together with fellow FX enthusiasts Mochiko, Mebuki, and Yasuko, she’ll battle volatile markets where every decision can lead to fortune—or disaster!

items.title: Dandivine
items.overview: Twenty years have passed since the combining robot Dandivine repelled the mysterious enemy known as the Aposdoll. The world was at peace, but the toy manufacturer Kasuga, which once took the world by storm through its Dandivine toy line, was in a steady decline due to an over-reliance on the franchise. Genjuro Shijima, the president of Kasga, now yearns for the resurrection of Dandivine, even if it means disturbing the peace of the world. As if his desire reached the heavens, an Aposdoll appears in Tokyo once again.

items.title: Fading Grandeur
items.overview: Don Leandro, a marquis facing a dire financial situation, decides to part with the decaying family mansion he owns in Madrid. Sofía Carrington, a multimillionaire businesswoman, shows interest in acquiring the property. What initially appears to be a real estate transaction soon becomes complicated, as the relationship between the two goes beyond mere financial negotiation.

items.title: Magic Knight Rayearth
items.overview: A school trip to Tokyo Tower turns into a battle for another world when Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu are summoned to Cefiro! With Princess Emeraude captured, the magical world teeters on the brink of collapse. To save her, the three girls must awaken their powers, become the Legendary Magic Knights, and face deadly enemies before Cefiro is lost forever!

items.title: Paw & Palaces
items.overview:
In the Forbidden City, which has a long history and profound cultural heritage, there live many cute cats. From the perspective of humans, they live an enviable and leisurely life. Among them, six royal cats are special. They are responsible for protecting the memory of cultural relics of "Wuhua." They entered the world of Wuhua and defeated the destroyer Black Owl time and time again, bringing the world of Wuhua back on the right track and thus protecting the cultural relics.

The six imperial cats are Luban and Momo from the literary class, and Shuangmei, Aobai, Pingan and Xiaozai from the martial class. Not only are they intelligent and brave, they also have a tacit understanding. They form the Forbidden City Imperial Cat Room, which protects the national treasures of the world.

items.title: Upin & Ipin
items.overview:
“Upin & Ipin” is a 3D animated series produced by Les’ Copaque Production Sdn. Bhd. and is currently one of the most popular animated series in Malaysia receiving excellent reviews and steadfastly averaging around 800, 000 viewers per episode. The series is actually a spin-off of the company’s debut feature film “Geng: Pengembaraan Bermula”.

The series centres on a pair of 5-year-old twin boys, the titular Upin and Ipin, who tell stories of their everyday lives through fun and amusing actions with their friends while also learning new things during their day to day activities. Like every other children, Upin and Ipin are very mischievous and often find themselves getting into trouble, most of the time with their teenage sister Ros.

items.title: The Djinn's Curse 2
items.overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.
items.tagline: Once it's in your soul, There's no way out.

items.title: Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
items.overview: Follow a tween vampire girl who leaves the safety of Transylvania to attend a performing arts boarding school. Living amongst humans for the first time, she pursues her passion for music while keeping her vampire identity a secret, something that’s made more challenging when her overprotective father charges an overzealous ghost to live with her at the school.
items.tagline: Let it all fang out.

items.title: The Detective Is Already Dead
items.overview: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

items.title: The World's Strongest Witch
items.overview: Cast out by her aristocratic family after manifesting a seemingly useless skill, Lorna discovers her ability, “Internet,” is an SSS-rank cheat that grants her access to the entirety of the world’s knowledge. All Lorna wants is a peaceful life, but as she collects rare gear and potent items, the “world’s weakest witch” suddenly becomes very powerful, landing in one chaotic adventure after another.

items.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm
items.overview: When a sickly young girl suddenly becomes obsessed with inventing new things, her family and friends are all puzzled. "What has gotten into Myne?" they wondered, never dreaming that the answer is not a "What" but a "Who": Urano Motosu, a book-loving apprentice librarian who died in an earthquake in Tokyo who somehow found herself in Myne's body! And since Myne's world is still in a medieval stage, where books can only be owned by the elite, the new Myne intends to do everything she can to bring her beloved books to the masses in the time she has left.

items.title: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
items.overview: “Find Senki,” those were the final words of Kairi’s grandfather and now his mission. DARK MACHINE, a new and captivating eSport game, transformed Japan’s economy. The most powerful player controls it with the title Senki. Now, on the seventh Senki, Kairi plays to finally meet them and ultimately take claim. Will he be able to hold his own, though?

items.title: Red River
items.overview: After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

items.title: The Hunt
items.overview: A teacher lives a lonely life, all the while struggling over his son’s custody. His life slowly gets better as he finds love and receives good news from his son, but his new luck is about to be brutally shattered by an innocent little lie.
items.tagline: The lie is spreading.

items.title: Death at a Funeral
items.overview: Aaron's father's funeral is today at the family home, and everything goes wrong: the funeral home delivers the wrong body, his cousin accidentally drugs her fiancé, and Aaron's successful younger brother, Ryan, flies in from New York, broke but arrogant. To top it all off, a mysterious stranger wants a word with Aaron.
items.tagline: This is one sad family.

items.title: Death at a Funeral
items.overview: A myriad of outrageous calamities befalls an eccentric English clan with more than a few skeletons in its closets when the family's patriarch dies an unexpected death.
items.tagline: Last rites... and wrongs.

items.title: Secrets and Lies
items.overview: Detective Andrea Cornell is a tough, thorough Homicide Detective who leaves no stone unturned. Her unwavering dedication to her job makes her the most formidable opponent - or a highly valuable ally.
items.tagline: Did he or didn't he?

items.title: Mononoke
items.overview: The Medicine Seller is a deadly and mysterious master of the occult who travels across feudal Japan in search of malevolent spirits called mononoke to slay. When he locates one of these spirits, he cannot simply kill it; he must first learn its Form, its Truth, and its Reason in order to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword and fight against it. He must begin his strange exorcisms with intense psychological analysis and careful investigative work—an extremely dangerous step, as he must first confront and learn about the mononoke before he even has the means to defeat it.

items.title: Fuori
items.overview: Rome. The 1980s. After the magnum opus The Art of Joy she has been working on for a decade is rejected by the Italian publishing world, writer Goliarda Sapienza commits a desperate theft that costs her her reputation and social position. Incarcerated in Italy’s largest female prison, she finds herself living alongside thieves, junkies, sex workers and revolutionaries. After her release, she continues to meet with these women and over the course of a sweltering summer, a life-changing relationship flowers – a relationship that will reawaken her the desire to live and to write.

items.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
items.overview: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

items.title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo
items.overview: The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

items.title: Battle Spirits [Re] ZEKKAI NO KU
items.overview: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu's journey—and sets history in motion.

items.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me
items.overview: Sato may be the most beautiful girl in school but she's also the coldest, never smiling at anyone. When her classmate Oshio spots her at a café, he learns Sato's secret: she's actually just shy and clumsy. As Sato and Oshio bond over their shared interests in photography and desserts, a sweet romance starts to blossom between two socially awkward people.

items.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
items.overview: A dying girl is saved when a fallen warrior’s soul is placed in her body, giving her new life, healing powers, and an unstoppable thirst for battle that brings chaos in its wake.

items.title: PSYREN
items.overview: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he's drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.
items.tagline: A PSYЯEN echoes through our future.

items.title: Tiny Fugitives
items.overview: A reckless group of twelve year olds set out on a mission to spend the rest of their lives at sleepaway camp. They'll just have to get past Bob - the camp's deranged, relentless, 50-year-old lifer counselor.
items.tagline: Summer ain't over yet.

items.title: The Musical
items.overview: Doug, a frustrated playwright and middle school theater teacher, learns his ex is dating his nemesis, the school principal. To get revenge and cost him a Blue Ribbon Award, Doug secretly stages the most inappropriate play imaginable.
items.tagline: It's not personal. It's middle school.

items.title: Phony
items.overview: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.
items.tagline: The mother of all mysteries.

items.title: Pancho Villa: The Centaur of the North
items.overview: This is the story of Doroteo Arango, of a life that began on the wrong side of the law, to becoming "Pancho Villa", the feared commander and key figure in the Mexican Revolution. Buried within the story is a man fixated on his own myth, a man whose efforts to become a larger-than-life figure would shape history, but also leave him with many vengeful and powerful enemies.

items.title: Love in Disguise
items.overview: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?
items.tagline: Trickery is a game two can play.

items.title: By Any Means
items.overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.
items.tagline: The FBI couldn't crack it. So they called in the mob.

items.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess with Zero Believers
items.overview: An isekai fantasy where an ordinary gamer reincarnates without special powers, teams up with a minor goddess, and rises from the weakest to the strongest in a new world.

items.title: From Far Away
items.overview: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

items.title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner
items.overview: Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human girl who's too weak to resist her desires, and Roni, an overly serious priest! Roni welcomes Amona as a new member to his adventuring party. Everyone expected the two would clash and become sworn enemies. But, to their surprise and on their first day together, they have a one-night stand...!

items.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!
items.overview: Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.

items.title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
items.overview: When office worker Akira Yagami gives his life saving a child, he awakens in another world as a weak goblin. But luckily, he’s granted a unique skill that extends his lifespan decades beyond their species limit and allows him to inherit the abilities of fallen goblins. In a realm of powerful races like demons and elves, Akira’s rise to becoming the strongest goblin begins.

items.title: Seeking Persephone
items.overview: To save her family, Persephone marries a cold, distant duke - never expecting to awaken a love that could change them both forever.

items.title: Bad Apples
items.overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.
items.tagline: It only takes one.

items.title: Hana Korea
items.overview: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

items.title: Self/less
items.overview: An extremely wealthy elderly man dying from cancer undergoes a radical medical procedure that transfers his consciousness to the body of a healthy young man but everything may not be as good as it seems when he starts to uncover the mystery of the body's origins and the secret organization that will kill to keep its secrets.
items.tagline: God Created Man. Man Created Immortality.

items.title: Oculus
items.overview: A woman tries to exonerate her brother's murder conviction by proving that the crime was committed by a supernatural phenomenon.
items.tagline: You see what it wants you to see.

items.title: Two Weeks Notice
items.overview: Dedicated environmental lawyer Lucy Kelson goes to work for billionaire George Wade as part of a deal to preserve a community center. Indecisive and weak-willed George grows dependent on Lucy's guidance on everything from legal matters to clothing. Exasperated, Lucy gives notice and picks Harvard graduate June Carter as her replacement. As Lucy's time at the firm nears an end, she grows jealous of June and has second thoughts about leaving George.
items.tagline: Over. Done. Finished. A comedy about love at last glance.

items.title: Tinker Bell and the Pirate Fairy
items.overview: Zarina, a smart and ambitious dust-keeper fairy who’s captivated by Blue Pixie Dust and its endless possibilities, flees Pixie Hollow and joins forces with the scheming pirates of Skull Rock, who make her captain of their ship. Tinker Bell and her friends must embark on an epic adventure to find Zarina, and together they go sword-to-sword with the band of pirates led by a cabin boy named James, who’ll soon be known as Captain Hook himself.
items.tagline: From the World of Peter Pan.

items.title: Tinker Bell and the Great Fairy Rescue
items.overview: During a summer stay on the mainland, Tinker Bell is accidentally discovered while investigating a little girl's fairy house. As the other fairies, led by the brash Vidia, launch a daring rescue in the middle of a fierce storm, Tink develops a special bond with the lonely, little girl.

items.title: Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure
items.overview: A blue harvest moon will rise, allowing the fairies to use a precious moonstone to restore the Pixie Dust Tree, the source of all their magic. But when Tinker Bell accidentally puts all of Pixie Hollow in jeopardy, she must venture out across the sea on a secret quest to set things right.
items.tagline: Adventure beyond Pixie Hollow.

items.title: The Princess and the Frog
items.overview: A waitress, desperate to fulfill her dreams as a restaurant owner, is set on a journey to turn a frog prince back into a human being, but she has to face the same problem after she kisses him.
items.tagline: Every love story begins with a kiss...

items.title: Anne of Green Gables
items.overview: Anne Shirley, an orphan, is fostered by farmer Matthew Cuthbert and his sister Marilla, who were expecting a boy to be sent them to help with their farm work. They accept Anne, who quickly endears herself to them and to the local villagers.
items.tagline: Go back to the day that Anne was waiting at the train station...

items.title: Possession
items.overview: A young woman left her family for an unspecified reason. The husband determines to find out the truth and starts following his wife. At first, he suspects that a man is involved. But gradually, he finds out more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a possessed love affair.
items.tagline: Inhuman ecstasy fulfilled.

items.title: The Elephant Man
items.overview: A Victorian surgeon rescues a heavily disfigured man being mistreated by his "owner" as a side-show freak. Behind his monstrous façade, there is revealed a person of great intelligence and sensitivity.
items.tagline: A true story of courage and human dignity.

items.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
items.overview:
When Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens in search of a worthy rival, Goku and his friends face an epic battle to stop him from destroying Earth.

Remastered and re-edited version of Dragon Ball Super.

items.title: Fresh off the Sea in Calape
LIAR GAME
items.overview: When Nao Kanzaki receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen, she learns that she has been selected to participate in the LIAR GAME. In this high-stakes psychological battle, lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and honest, Nao turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist, to survive the twisted game. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?
items.tagline: Trust. Doubt.

items.title: King of Comedy
items.overview: A spirited young villager and her reluctant ally race against a seven-day demolition deadline, battling viral mishaps, copyright disputes, and a rival village’s sabotage to save their coastal hometown—and find love along the way.

items.title: Shadow Punisher
items.overview: Lord Qingyang's son, Li Si, devised a plan to infiltrate the Imperial Detective Division to uncover the truth behind the death of the Fourth Prince. There, he met and joined forces with Bai Zhenzhu, the finest female forensic expert in the land; and Meng Rui, a ghost-catcher renowned for his martial prowess but burdened with a deep-seated vendetta. Together, they formed the Divine Detectives. With seamless teamwork and unwavering determination, this trio ventured through perilous challenges, solving eight enigmatic and bizarre cases.

items.title: Tenzing
items.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
items.tagline: The ascent that made history.

items.title: Masterplan
items.overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

items.title: Therapy Done Right
items.overview: A psychoanalyst who's lost faith in traditional therapy crosses every boundary to help a blocked novelist in this cutting Argentine dark comedy.

items.title: Clean Hands
items.overview: The true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis and "the thin blue line" from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

items.title: Hallowarrior

Pumpkin’s lonely holiday ritual is interrupted by the arrival of a savage gang of raiders at her doorstep, led by the fearsome Thalia. Outnumbered and armed with candy, wit and weapons, Pumpkin must ferociously fight back to survive the night.
items.tagline: The whole world is a haunted house.

items.title: Reporting Live

items.tagline: Some stories refuse to be buried.

items.title: Deathgasm 2: Goremageddon
items.overview: After failing to reform his heavy metal band DEATHGASM for a battle-of-the-bands to win back his girlfriend Medina, Brodie decides to use black magic to raise his ex-band members Zakk and Dion from the dead. However, his resurrected friends become unpredictable and dangerous, leading to chaos in the town.
items.tagline: Evil cums again!

items.title: Deathgasm
items.overview: Two teenage boys unwittingly summon an ancient evil entity known as The Blind One by delving into black magic while trying to escape their mundane lives.
items.tagline: Evil is coming...

One diver soon finds himself on a spectacular odyssey 25,000 feet below the ocean's surface where he confronts a mysterious force that has the power to change the world or destroy it.
items.tagline: When you get there, you will understand.

Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?
items.tagline: Rage is a mother.

items.title: Money Trap

With the help of a wise old Woodsman and a foul-tempered bluebird named Beatrice, Wirt and Greg must travel across this strange land, in hope of finding their way home. Join them as they encounter surprises and obstacles on their journey through the wood.

items.tagline: What feels tingly-  My heart? My body?

What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be trapped together. Their polished acts fall, and an unfiltered meltdown starts. When the panic starts to creep in and they all realise the seriousness of the situation, the farm starts to shrink, secrets spill out, and unexpected feelings take shape.

items.tagline: Welcome to Auk Isle. Population: one too many.

Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. This is his inspirational story.

items.tagline: All for one and one for all!

Labelled the loser of his school, he wants to afford a better life for his physical disabled sister, who is in a wheelchair, and his father. To make it possible, he took on the goal to become the best magician and to show everyone that one’s status in society is not important to achieve this.

As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

Cheerful and creative, Lumina finds herself working in a mermaid salon customizing fabulous hairstyles. And when Lumina has the chance to attend the royal ball, her friends adorn her with a gown fit for a princess. At the ball, villains try to seize power over the kingdom, and Lumina finds within herself an unexpected power that proves she is much more than a hair stylist.
items.tagline: A Glowing Undersea Adventure!

items.title: Avalon High
items.overview: Elaine "Ellie" Harrison has just moved from Minnesota to Annapolis, Maryland while her parents take a year-long sabbatical to continue their medieval studies in nearby Washington D.C. Her new high school, Avalon High, seems like a typical high school with the stereotypical students: Lance the jock, Jennifer the cheerleader, Marco, the bad boy/desperado, and Will, the senior class president, quarterback, and all around good guy. But not everyone at Avalon High is who they appear to be, not even Ellie herself. Eventually, it becomes apparent that Avalon High is a situation where the ancient Arthurian legend is repeating itself.

items.title: Wendy Wu: Homecoming Warrior
items.overview: It is the story of an average, popular American teenager named Wendy Wu who discovers that in order to win the coveted crown she must first learn the way of the warrior. Wendy Wu has a one track mind, and that track leads directly to the title of homecoming queen -- no unscheduled stops, and no unnecessary detours. When a mysterious Chinese monk named Shen arrives to mold Wendy into a fearless kung fu warrior, however, her royal aspirations suddenly jump the track as she desperately attempts to juggle her boyfriend, her homework, and of course, the fierce competition to become homecoming queen. Now, as Wendy begins to train her mind, body, and spirit in the ancient tradition of the martial arts and her inner warrior gradually begins to emerge, the girl who once obsessed over popularity finally begins to put that popularity into perspective as she gradually realizes what truly matters in life.
items.tagline: Pretty. Tough.

A universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes still trying to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.
items.tagline: There is no justice without sin.

When circus prodigy Mizuka Tsurumaki joins their ranks, the Sunflower Circus’s fortune shifts, finally giving them a shot at big top glory.
items.tagline: We're bringing the circus to you!

items.overview: Melody may be the heroine and saint destined to save the world from a rising demon king–but all she wants to do is become a perfect maid! Reincarnated in a story-based video game, Melody veers off the set story path, refusing to heed the call to action and instead using her powers to clean. Her new world becomes increasingly chaotic, and the story? Totally unhinged and unpredictable.

items.title: MEBIUS DUST
items.overview: Araki, Stella, and Olga are ordinary high-schoolers living in a city shaped by the mysterious Mebius Dust. Between gaming, bathhouse trips, and quiet walks home, their days pass peacefully—yet strange technology and rising unrest begin to quietly distort their everyday lives.

items.title: Rabbit on the Moon
items.overview: Jira is a twenty-nine-year-old bar host—not a career he'd have envisioned for himself. Twenty-eight-year-old Phugh is a real estate agent from a wealthy family. They're not a match, which should be fine, because they aren't looking for anything serious with each other.

items.title: Chasing in the Wild
items.overview: A basketball team captain and a cheerleader have instant chemistry – but can their relationship survive pressure from family, friends, and school?

items.title: Past Life, Present Love
items.overview: After a family emergency forces Mild to end her engagement and rush home, a car crash unexpectedly brings back her lost love with a bizarre twist.

items.title: Let's go KAIKIGUMI
items.overview: A nameless man who is six times more afraid of ghosts than the average person gets swept up with the supernatural. The trouble begins when he crosses paths with Mechako, a fearless girl who runs the Kaiki-gumi, an organization that polices the supernatural. Mechako ropes him into helping her revive the organization. Hilariously strange events and spooky shenanigans abound!

items.title: The Moth Effect
items.overview: A satirical six-part sketch comedy.

items.title: Physical 100: Italy
items.overview: One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.

items.title: The Real Rooneys
items.overview: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.
items.tagline: New roles. New goals.

items.title: The Villager of Level 999
items.overview: In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Koji Kagami, who is Level...999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King's daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.

items.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
items.overview: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he’s reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!

items.title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA
items.overview: Suddenly thrown together, a group of girls are now debuting as the virtual band, Mugendai Mewtype. They’ve got talent and personality, but no clue how to perform as one. Can they survive, let alone make it to the top in this unforgiving music world?

items.title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
items.overview: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.
items.tagline: This is the tale of a witch who toyed with a vast continent.

items.title: The Cat and the Dragon
items.overview: An orphan since hatched, a lone dragon named “Uncle Wings” is taken in by a family of magic-wielding cats and raised as one of their own. As Uncle Wings grows, he becomes the cats’ protector, determined to keep them safe from humans. But as he watches the cats connect with humans using their magic, Uncle Wings slowly starts to warm up to humans in this heartfelt, bittersweet tale.

items.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
items.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.
items.tagline: Are you down?

items.title: Onslaught
items.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
items.tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.

items.title: My Family
items.overview: Haruto Narusawa, the president of a video game company, enjoys life in the affluent seaside town of Kamakura with his wife and daughter, who attends an elementary school. However, tragedy befalls this happy family when his daughter is kidnapped. Haruto must now face numerous hardships as he navigates through the complex web of human nature that begins to show its ugliness. The only way to save his beloved daughter is to take matters into his own hands without the police's involvement and, together with his wife, stand against the kidnappers. Can this family's story reach a happy ending? Or will theirs be a tragedy? This non-stop family suspense-thriller tests the bonds of a family facing life's worst nightmare.

items.title: Kung Fu Soccer
items.overview: The "Supreme Invincible Cup" is about to begin, and a host of top teams are about to engage in an unprecedented showdown! But the Kung Fu Women's Soccer Team has been dealt a hellish script right from the start?! Their opponents are all highly skilled, and external pressure is mounting. The schemes on the field are one after another... Can they use their kung fu to turn the tide on the green field?
items.tagline: One kick can ignite the world.

productionCompanies.name: Shanghai Maoyan Film 上海猫眼影业

items.title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
items.overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

cast.name: Seth MacFarlane
cast.character: Brian Griffin / Stewie Griffin / Peter Griffin

items.title: Between Steps
items.overview: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.
items.tagline: Two hearts learning to love.

items.title: Barbie: The Princess & the Popstar
items.overview: Tori is a blonde princess who is bored of living her royal life, and has dreams of becoming a popstar. Keira, on the other hand, is a brunette popstar who dreams of being a princess. When the two meet, they magically trade places, but after realising it is best to be themselves.
items.tagline: True friends rock in perfect harmony!

items.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
items.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
items.tagline: Evil found a way out.

items.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
items.overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.
