items.title: Union County
items.overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amid the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

items.title: Rose
items.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers' suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

items.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
items.overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.
items.tagline: Some wars are won by armies. Others by those who refuse to surrender.

items.title: Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force
items.overview: Kagami drags Marinette to Tokyo to help the Stellars defeat a new supervillain, but Marinette soon realizes her friend has another, untold reason for this trip to Japan.

items.title: Miraculous World: London, at the Edge of Time
items.overview: To save the future from a terrible fate, Marinette becomes Chronobug and teams up with Bunnyx to defeat a mysterious opponent who travels through time.

items.title: Miraculous World: Paris, Tales of Shadybug and Claw Noir
items.overview: Ladybug and Cat Noir discover the existence of a parallel universe in which they're supervillains determined to seize the Butterfly Miraculous.
items.tagline: It only takes one decision to become a hero.

items.title: Miraculous World: Shanghai - The Legend of Ladydragon
items.overview: On school break, Marinette heads to Shanghai to meet Adrien. But after arriving, Marinette loses all her stuff, including the Miraculous that allows her to turn into Ladybug!
items.tagline: New city, new challenges.

items.title: Miraculous World: New York, United HeroeZ
items.overview: Marinette's class is headed to New York, the city of superheroes, for French-American Friendship Week. But the arrival of Hawk Moth will complicate everything.
items.tagline: New city. Same duty.

items.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
items.overview: President Lincoln's mother is killed by a supernatural creature, which fuels his passion to crush vampires and their slave-owning helpers.
items.tagline: Are you a patriot or a vampire?

items.title: The King's Speech
items.overview: The King's Speech tells the story of the man who became King George VI, the father of Queen Elizabeth II. After his brother abdicates, George ('Bertie') reluctantly assumes the throne. Plagued by a dreaded stutter and considered unfit to be king, Bertie engages the help of an unorthodox speech therapist named Lionel Logue. Through a set of unexpected techniques, and as a result of an unlikely friendship, Bertie is able to find his voice and boldly lead the country into war.
items.tagline: Find your voice.

items.title: Blue Lagoon: The Awakening
items.overview: Two high school students become stranded on a tropical island and must rely on each other for survival. They learn more about themselves and each other while falling in love.

items.title: Return to the Blue Lagoon
items.overview: In this sequel to the 1980 classic, two children are stranded on a beautiful island in the South Pacific. With no adults to guide them, the two make a simple life together and eventually become tanned teenagers in love.
items.tagline: Return to the Romance, Return to the Adventure...

items.title: The Blue Lagoon
items.overview: Two small children and a ship's cook survive a shipwreck and find safety on an idyllic tropical island. Soon, however, the cook dies and the young boy and girl are left on their own. Days become years and Emmeline and Richard make a home for themselves surrounded by exotic creatures and nature's beauty. But will they ever see civilization again?
items.tagline: A story of natural love.

items.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
items.overview: David, a robotic boy—the first of his kind programmed to love—is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David.
items.tagline: David is 11 years old. He weighs 60 pounds. He is 4 feet, 6 inches tall. He has brown hair. His love is real. But he is not.

items.title: Dracula III: Legacy
items.overview: Dracula leads vampire hunters Father Uffizi and Luke back to Eastern Europe, and a country plagued by civil war.
items.tagline: You can't fight it. You can't kill it.

items.title: Dracula II: Ascension
items.overview: A group of medical students discover the body of the infamous count. Soon, they find themselves in the middle of a bizarre and dangerous conflict when a shadowy figure offers them $30 million for the body so that he may harvest his blood.
items.tagline: The terrifying sequel to Dracula 2000.

items.title: Dracula 2000
items.overview: When a team of techno-savvy thieves break into a high-security vault, they don't discover priceless works of art... they find a crypt unopened for 100 years.
items.tagline: The Most Seductive Evil of All Time Has Now Been Unleashed in Ours.

items.title: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
items.overview: Hinako Konohana is the perfect young lady—graceful, elegant, and flawless… or so everyone thinks. Behind closed doors, she's a total disaster who can't handle basic chores! When ordinary student Itsuki Tomonari becomes her caretaker, he's thrown into 24/7 damage control, maintaining her "perfect" image. It's awkward, nonstop chaos—but it starts softening into something that feels like love…

items.title: Iron Wok Jan
items.overview: The story follows Jan, a devilish master chef of Chinese cuisine, who will stop at nothing to crush his opponents. This is an adrenaline-pumping tale where the unhinged cast defies ethics and treats cooking like magic, creating all kinds of wild dishes. Jan charges forward to face the ultimate Chinese cuisine battle, ready to challenge the world!

items.title: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers
items.overview: The Demon World once plunged the Human World into terror. With the seal broken and hordes of Demon Soldiers launching an invasion, five young warriors rushed to humanity's rescue. They were called the Samurai Troopers, and now their battle begins anew!

items.title: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her
items.overview: Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki’s looks may have changed, with Hayato, she’s still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.

items.title: GTO (2026)
items.overview: Maverick teacher Eikichi Onizuka takes on a new role at the elite Seishin Academy, where he struggles to connect with students locked to their screens.

items.title: GATE24: The Border
items.overview: A newly formed airport task force overcomes institutional barriers and uses an eccentric officer's extraordinary observational skills to protect Japan's borders from international crimes.

items.title: 25 Years of You
items.overview: After 25 years of silent devotion, a man finally approaches the woman he has always loved, triggering a chain of revelations tied to a dark incident from their past.

items.title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
items.overview: After being publicly betrayed by the crown prince and thrown into prison, noblewoman Elizabeth escapes her kingdom with the legendary Seven Grimoires. With help from a viscount from a neighboring nation, she rebuilds her life while plotting revenge against the kingdom that cast her aside.

items.title: HELL MODE: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
items.overview: Kenichi Yamada, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a "Hell Mode"—a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential. Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him.

items.title: Haunted Universities 4
items.overview: Four Thai campuses, four deadly legends. Students face a cursed bridge, a ghost house, a cruel ritual and a haunted room in this horror anthology.
items.tagline: Friends forever. Fear forever.

items.title: Midnight Girls
items.overview: Set in Nagoya, Japan, four Filipina entertainers form a sisterhood while facing the emotional cost of their jobs. Together, they must decide what they are truly willing to sacrifice for their dreams in a foreign land.

items.title: Desert Warrior
items.overview: In 7th-century Arabia, Princess Hind becomes a warrior to defy the ruthless Emperor Kisra. Forged into a warrior and aided by legendary bandit Hanzala, Hind unites warring tribes for a last stand—the historic Battle of Dhi Qar—that will change history.
items.tagline: One warrior must unite them all.

items.title: Stranglehold
items.overview: Bailey is an exotic dancer with big dreams. She and her Army vet husband Tim are fed up with their lives of barely getting by in small-town Arkansas, so they decide to rob the strip club that employs her.
items.tagline: It's the most wonderful crime of the year.

items.title: Livestream from Hell
items.overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

items.title: Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend
items.overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.
items.tagline: One goal. One season. The start of something great.

items.title: Doing Life
items.overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.
items.tagline: Choose a love that breaks all chains.

items.title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
items.overview: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

items.title: The Labyrinth
items.overview: A fantasy horror movie about high school students struggling to save their friends from evil spirits that are causing strange phenomena late at night at their school. Hee Min is the heir of the greatest exorcist in Korea, who is not yet aware of his own powers. So Young is a girl who is keeping a secret about the curse that is afflicting their school.

items.title: Nisekoi: False Love
items.overview: Raku Ichijo (Kento Nakajima) is an only son and a high school student. His father is the leader of yakuza group Shuei-gumi. Raku Ichijo doesn't like to fight and he studies hard. His dream is to become a public official. One day, he passes the entrance gate at his high school and is kicked inadvertently by Chitoge Kirisaki (Ayami Nakajo). She is a new transfer student at the school. Chitoge Kirisaki is the only daughter of a rival gang leader. To keep the peace between the rival gangs led by their fathers, Raku Ichijo and Chitoge Kirisaki decide to act as boyfriend and girlfriend. --asianwiki

items.title: Slumdog Millionaire
items.overview: A teenager reflects on his life after being accused of cheating on the Indian version of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?".
items.tagline: What does it take to find a lost love?

items.title: Juno
items.overview: Faced with an unplanned pregnancy, sixteen year old high-schooler, Juno MacGuff, makes an unusual decision regarding her unborn child.
items.tagline: A comedy about growing up… and the bumps along the way.

items.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
items.overview: Matt Sullivan's last big relationship ended in disaster and ever since his heart's been aching and his commitment's been lacking. Then came Lent, that time of year when everybody gives something up. That's when Matt decides to go where no man's gone before and make a vow: No sex. Whatsoever. For 40 straight days. At first he has everything under control. That is until the woman of his dreams, Erica, walks into his life.
items.tagline: Easier said than done.

items.title: Hart's War
items.overview: When Col. William McNamara is stripped of his freedom in a German POW camp, he's determined to keep on fighting even from behind enemy lines. Enlisting the help of a young lieutenant in a brilliant plot against his captors, McNamara risks everything on a mission to free his men and change the outcome of the war.
items.tagline: Beyond courage, beyond honor.

items.title: What's the Worst That Could Happen?
items.overview: Thief Kevin Caffery attempts to rob from the home of rich businessman Max Fairbanks. But Fairbanks catches him and steals his cherished ring that his girlfriend gave him. Caffery is then bent on revenge and getting his ring back with the help of his partners.
items.tagline: It takes a thief to nail a crook.

items.title: Mercury Rising
items.overview: Renegade FBI agent Art Jeffries protects a nine-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new "unbreakable" code.
items.tagline: Someone knows too much.

items.title: The Amityville Horror
items.overview: George Lutz, his wife Kathy, and their three children have just moved into a beautiful, and improbably cheap, Victorian mansion nestled in the sleepy coastal town of Amityville, Long Island. However, their dream home is concealing a horrific past and soon each member of the Lutz family is plagued with increasingly strange and violent visions and impulses.
items.tagline: For God's sake, get out!

items.title: War
items.overview: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.
items.tagline: Take sides. Take everything.

items.title: Sneaky Pete
items.overview: A con man on the run from a vicious gangster takes cover from his past by assuming the identity of his prison cellmate, Pete, “reuniting” with Pete’s estranged family, a colorful, dysfunctional group that threatens to drag him into a world just as dangerous as the one he’s trying to escape - and, just maybe, give him a taste of the loving family he’s never had.
items.tagline: The truth is always changing.

items.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
items.overview: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.
items.tagline: Pirates assemble.

items.title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Road Trip in Another World
items.overview: Late 20's caregiver Rin Takanashi has been summoned as a saint, only to then be dumped alone in another world. Equipped with just her ridiculously overpowered god-like skills, Motor Home aka "Mochan" and Survival, she decides to indulge her love of solo camping and cooking in this strange new place. Thus begins Rin's journey: one filled with gourmet cuisine and an array of wonderful companions along the way.

items.title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
items.overview: Kakeru Sorano, a quiet university freshman who avoids others, meets Koharu Fuyutsuki, a blind girl who faces the world with quiet brightness. When she says, “I want to see fireworks someday,” something in Kakeru shifts. As they grow closer through small moments and shared loneliness, he searches for a way to make her wish come true.

cast.name: Shunsaku Nishigaki
cast.character: Amano-san the Fireworks Expert of 35 Years (voice)

items.title: Nisekoi
items.overview: Raku Ichijo is an average high school student. He also happens to be the sole heir to the head of a Yakuza Family called the Shuei-gumi. 10 years ago, Raku made a promise… a secret promise with a girl he met. They promised one another that they will “get married when they reunite.” Since then, Raku never let go of the pendant the girl gave him.

items.title: Sakamoto Days
items.overview: After getting married and having a daughter, a retired legendary hitman must protect his family when his past catches up to him.

cast.name: Shin Takuma
cast.character: Customer Who Arrives During a Fight

items.tagline: That man was a legendary assassin.

items.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
items.overview: In 1910 London, independent-minded Katharine Hilbery defies her family's expectations of marriage to pursue a career in astronomy. But when her father pressures her into an unwanted engagement, her resolve is tested. Through new friendships—including a bold suffragette and a thoughtful editor—Katharine begins to question the limits placed on her by society, love, and tradition, ultimately searching for a path that is truly her own.
items.tagline: Claim your space.

items.title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
items.overview: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

items.title: The Nice Ones
items.overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

items.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
items.overview: Ready to quit the dating scene altogether, burned-out Leah accepts her grandmother's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights in exchange for a year's rent—only to discover amidst the awkward dinners and unexpected sparks that her biggest obstacle to love is herself.
items.tagline: How many dates does it take to find love?

items.title: The Uprising
items.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.
items.tagline: Rise or die.

items.title: Sinagtala
items.overview: The stage is set. The music is loud. But behind the melody lies a story of dreams, struggles, and unbreakable bonds.

items.title: 500 Miles
items.overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.
items.tagline: Hope will lead you home.

items.title: A New Dawn
items.overview: The Obinata Fireworks Shop factory is getting prepared for an administrative action for confiscation tomorrow. It has been six years since Keitaro has been holed up in a closed-down factory creating fireworks by himself, chasing after an illusion of his father who vanished. It is a story about three young people who overcome the extreme weather conditions, disasters and environmental problems imposed on them and establish their own identities.

items.title: Runner
items.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.
items.tagline: Next-day delivery isn't an option.

items.title: Gintama: Yoshiwara in Flames
items.overview: Upon meeting a young boy named Seita who makes a living as a pickpocket, Gintoki discovers that he is pickpocketing out of a desire to meet his long-lost mother, Hinowa, Yoshiwara's number one courtesan. Gintoki and his friends venture to Yoshiwara to fulfill Seita's wish, but standing in their way is Housen, the Night King who rules Yoshiwara.

items.title: UNABOMBER
items.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.
items.tagline: Where brilliance ends, the madness begins.

items.title: Legend of the White Dragon
items.overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.
items.tagline: Legends never die.

items.title: The Deputy
items.overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.
items.tagline: Trust no body.

items.title: Rage of Stars
items.overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

items.title: The Fix
items.overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.
items.tagline: Settle the score.

items.title: The Furious: Pertaruhan Maruah
items.overview: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.

items.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
items.overview: Just as His Highness’s favored butterfly Reirin is beloved by the prince, jealous “court sewer rat” Keigetsu uses magic to swap their bodies—and their destinies. With a looming execution, Reirin embraces her new, healthy body, while Keigetsu learns Reirin’s life isn’t what it seems as she’s pulled into an inner-court conspiracy.

items.title: Draw This, Then Die!
items.overview: First-year high school student Ai Yasumi lives on the island of Izu Oshima and loves reading manga. But after a certain turning point, she sets her sights on creating stories of her own! As she dives into the world of manga-making, Ai faces challenges, growth, and the excitement of chasing her creative dreams. Where will her creative journey take her?

items.title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power
items.overview: Overshadowed by her saintly sister Flora, plain Carolina seizes a chance to be useful by agreeing to political marriage with a prince rumored to be cruel. But the prince is nothing as expected—he’s a gentleman, and Carolina feels valued for once in her life. As Carolina blossoms, she discovers a sense of self-worth and a mysterious power, while Flora’s perfect life back home starts to crumble.

items.title: BLACK TORCH
items.overview: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago’s powers.

items.title: Recommendations from Iwamoto-Senpai
items.overview: 1910s, Japan. A town with mysterious black snow. Kodo Iwamoto, a student at a military school dedicated to studying the paranormal, is sent to investigate. There, he meets a boy who believes he’s sick, but Kodo recognizes the illness as something else: supernatural abilities. Kodo recruits the boy to the school and sets off across the country, chasing mysteries and searching for others like him.

items.title: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration
items.overview: An arranged marriage. Two complete strangers. One adorable romance! When cheerful noblewoman Elsa is suddenly wed to the reserved duke-to-be Julius, neither expects their political marriage to spark something more. As awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and growing feelings pile up, these newlyweds discover that falling in love might be the easiest—and hardest—part of married life.

items.title: Sparks of Tomorrow
items.overview: In an alternate past, an unlikely duo team up to look for a missing catalog that could bring electricity to the smoke-filled streets of Kyoto.
items.tagline: Chasing an unseen light!

items.title: Chainsmoker Cat
items.overview: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones' concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

items.title: Safe Skies, Archer
items.overview: Tourism student, Yanna, and young pilot, Hiro, agree to have a no-strings attached relationship but when their romance becomes real, they start to reexamine their deal.

items.title: Love Upon a Time
items.overview: A modern man is transported 400 years into the past, where he must pose as a missing criminal's son while falling for a suspicious noble.
items.tagline: A cruel twist of fate that takes the 'cruel' part too seriously!

items.title: The Final Problem
items.overview: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

items.title: Magical Girl Lyrical NANOHA EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
items.overview: Thirty years ago, aliens attacked Earth and nearly brought humanity to extinction. Since then, mankind has clawed for survival, fighting the invaders for land, and the UN established EXCEEDS, an agency to stave off alien threats. On a remote island in a world of chaos, young hunter Shiina yearns for a quiet life with her sister, Setsuna, but a single incident draws her into the larger battle.

items.title: The Drops of God
items.overview: When world-renowned wine critic Toyotaka Kanzaki passes away, he leaves behind an enviable collection. The will promises his estate to whoever correctly guesses the brand and year of the 12 greatest wines he selected, and the legendary wine that stands atop them all, "Drops of God." The challengers are Toyotaka's son, Shizuku Kanzaki, and a young critic, Issei Tomine, who was adopted by Toyotaka.
items.tagline: Uncork the moment.

items.title: Goodbye, Lara
items.overview: Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

items.title: The World Is Dancing
items.overview: In 1374, amid the turmoil of the Northern and Southern Courts' long running conflict, a boy named Oniyasha is born into a family of sarugaku theater performers. He spends his days in a kind of quiet gloom, haunted by a simple but persistent question: Why do people dance? Then, one day, he witnesses a dance that he feels to be “good”—and everything begins to change. This is the story of the beautiful young boy who would one day shape the art of Noh and be remembered as Zeami.

items.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil
items.overview: On the front lines of the war, Tanya Degurechaff, blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain white skin, commands her squad with lisping voice. Actually, she is one of Japan's most elite salary men, reborn as a little girl into a world of magical warfare after angering a mysterious being who calls himself God.

items.title: Dive into You
items.overview: An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.
items.tagline: Take us back to our brightest days!

items.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
items.overview: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental SWAT unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities, and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city and saving the program that made him who he is.
items.tagline: New generation. New tactics. Built to protect.

items.title: A Different World
items.overview: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.
items.tagline: The new class just enrolled.

items.title: My Sad Dead
items.overview: Emma can see the dead. But when her niece arrives, thousands of lives are shaken.

items.title: Delusion
items.overview: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.
items.tagline: When someone you love becomes someone else, can you still trust what you see?

items.title: Shaque: Trust No One
items.overview: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

items.title: Super Troopers 2
items.overview: When an international border dispute arises between the U.S. and Canada, the Super Troopers- Mac, Thorny, Foster, Rabbit and Farva, are called in to set up a new Highway Patrol station in the disputed area.
items.tagline: The mustache rides. Again.

items.title: Super Troopers 3
items.overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.
items.tagline: The mustache rides, again. Again.

items.title: Super Troopers
items.overview: Five bored, occasionally high and always ineffective Vermont state troopers must prove their worth to the governor or lose their jobs. After stumbling on a drug ring, they plan to make a bust, but a rival police force is out to steal the glory.
items.tagline: In their town, you don't screw with the law, the law screws with you.

items.title: Physical 100: Mexico
items.overview: Reality competition show based on the original Korean format.

items.title: Habeas Corpus
items.overview: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

items.title: The Vacation Principle
items.overview: After losing her job, a woman retreats to her late grandmother's seaside villa, where an unexpected friendship with its mysterious caretaker helps her heal and embrace a new beginning.

items.title: The Love Hypothesis
items.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.
items.tagline: Fake dating. Real chemistry.

items.title: KAIJU GIRL CARAMELISE
items.overview: Kuroe Akaishi just wants a normal high school life—but that’s impossible with a rare condition that turns her into a giant kaiju whenever her emotions spike! Things get even worse when she falls for Arata Minami, the most popular boy in class. Now every blush, heartbeat, and crush could trigger a monster transformation. Can Kuroe survive high school love before it destroys everything around her?!

items.title: The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch
items.overview: Spica Virgo dreams of joining a magical academy, but there’s one problem: She can’t use magic! With no mentor or connections, her chances seem slim—until a mysterious talking black cat appears. A powerful mage cursed into feline form, he agrees to teach her in exchange for help breaking the spell. As their secret pact begins, Spica steps into a world of magic, mystery, and unexpected surprises.

items.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
items.overview: The war is over, and hero Dias is finally rewarded with land of his own—only to discover it's a barren frontier with no people, no villages, and no sign of civilization. With nothing but endless grassland ahead of him, Dias sets out to build a domain from the ground up. But after meeting Alna, a mysterious girl with a blue horn, his lonely frontier is about to spring to life.

items.title: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand
items.overview: Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero's party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as "Lock," an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

items.title: Brothers
items.overview: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.
items.director: Matthew McConaughey, Woody Harrelson, David West Read, Lee Eisenberg
items.tagline: A comedy series based on a rumor.

items.title: Idiots
items.overview: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

cast.name: Nicholas Braun
cast.character: Joe Thom Pell Aka Pricka Bush Da Werewoof

items.tagline: They're doing their best.

items.title: One Last Shot
items.overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.
items.tagline: One last traitor. One last mission. One last fight.

items.title: I'mPerfect
items.overview: Two people with Down syndrome navigate love, acceptance, and self-discovery in a world that often sees their condition before seeing them.

items.title: Louis Tomlinson: All of Those Voices
items.overview: Ditching the typical glossy sheen of celebrity documentaries, this film gives audiences an intimate and unvarnished view of Louis Tomlinson's life and career. Through never-before-seen home movie footage and behind the scenes access to Louis’ sell-out 2022 World Tour, the documentary offers a unique perspective on what it's like to be a musician in today's fast-paced world.

items.title: Playful Kiss
items.overview: Clumsy high school student Oh Ha-ni falls for the brilliant and aloof Baek Seung-jo, only to have her feelings rejected. When her family home collapses, Ha-ni moves in with her father’s longtime friend, who happens to be Seung-jo’s father, giving her an unexpected chance to win his heart.

items.title: Minerva Academy
items.overview: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

items.title: Until the T-Shirt Dries
items.overview: A sudden summer accident shatters the peaceful lives of two couples, dragging a happily married editor into a web of grief, human selfishness, and her husband's hidden secrets.

items.title: Sai
items.overview: A mysterious man appears before six individuals, each struggling with their own issues, as an impending disaster disrupts their lives, unraveling suspense and psychological tension.

items.title: The Kicks
items.overview: Devin Burke and her family have moved cross-country to California and now must adjust to a new life and a new soccer team. The Kentville Kicks don't quite play up to the standard that Devin is used to, so she must establish herself as a leader while also trying to make friends in a strange place.

items.title: The Ogre's Bride
items.overview: In a world where humans and ayakashi–supernatural beings–coexist, being chosen as an ayakashi’s bride is the ultimate honor. Yuzu, an ordinary schoolgirl, has been overlooked her whole life, eclipsed by the shadow of her sister Karin, a chosen bride. Just when Yuzu has had enough, she unexpectedly captures the heart of Reiya, a dashing ogre from a powerful clan who claims Yuzu as his own.

items.title: Barbie: A Fashion Fairytale
items.overview: Barbie, a popular actress on a sabbatical, learns that her fashion designer aunt Millicent has sold her business to a rival. With the help of a few magical beings, Barbie steps in to save the day.
items.tagline: Discover your inner sparkle!

items.title: Ice Cream Man
items.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

cast.name: Ari Millen
cast.character: The Ice Cream Man / Jonathan Smiley

cast.name: Tyler Ronald
cast.character: SSE Kid Force Fed Ice Cream

items.tagline: We all scream.

items.title: Spa Weekend
items.overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
items.tagline: Friendship is a real trip.

items.title: See You Later... Maybe
items.overview: After being pushed to fake his death by a manipulative manager, fallen writer Fang Haowen teams up with obsessive fan Bie Fan as the "Jiongtu Duo", embarking on a chaotic redemption journey through fame, betrayal, and surreal reality.

productionCompanies.name: 北京真乐道文化传播有限公司

items.title: Abyss
items.overview: The long-standing peace of a conservative small town is shattered by the appearance of an online novel "Abyss." Many plot points bear a striking resemblance to a cold case from years ago that has never been made public. Li Cheng, a passionate and righteous rookie police officer, engages in a series of high-stakes battles of wits with various suspects. He unravels the mystery, revealing the truth buried beneath heartbreaking kinships and friendships.

items.title: Blossom Through the Cloud
items.overview: Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

items.title: In My Prime
items.overview: In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

productionCompanies.name: iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）

items.title: Youth
items.overview: A 50-year-old divorcee searches for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.
items.tagline: Not wasted yet.

items.title: You+Me – Against the World
items.overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, leads a seemingly perfect life in a wealthy family, who believe she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream — cinema. On campus, she meets 20-year-old Vadim Arcadi, a rebellious and magnetic solitaire with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they compete, get closer and start to fall in love – in spite of themselves. But someone is watching them. A mysterious figure begins to send anonymous threats, determined to separate them and expose secrets that could destroy Alma and Vadim.
items.tagline: He runs from everything. Except her.

items.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
items.overview: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.
items.tagline: Blood. Lust.

items.title: Goody Goody
items.overview: Lulled into a necessary sense of comfort during a long home birth process, expecting parents and their midwife begin to realize that something may be horribly wrong. As labor complications ensue, a blizzard rages outside trapping the family in their home – sitting ducks for whatever sinister presence might be in there with them.
items.tagline: Push…

items.title: Best of the Best
items.overview: Two childhood best friends, Maya and Anjali, join their college’s competitive Bollywood dance team only to discover that the road to winning the national championship is far more raucous and cutthroat than they ever imagined.
items.tagline: It takes two to take over.

items.title: Shark Frenzy
items.overview: A family vacation goes wrong when their daughter and her friends get lost at sea on a fishing boat. When that boat is destroyed, they survive in a row boat, then the open ocean. Her parents race to find her as sharks circle ever closer in a deadly fight for survival.
items.tagline: A fun day on the water may be their last…

items.title: Turn 2
items.overview: A father whose world is shaken when he uncovers the truth about his own past-and his own father. Nearby, a fugitive named Donavan battles the agonising superpower side effects of the father's experimental chemical injection.

items.title: Lust Stories 3
items.overview: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

items.title: Lust Stories 2
items.overview: Four eminent Indian directors explore sex, desire and love through short films in this sequel to 2018's Emmy-nominated 'Lust Stories'.

items.title: Lust Stories
items.overview: An anthology of four stories that sheds light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman.
items.tagline: Four Stories Four Climaxes

items.title: The Scandal
items.overview: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.
items.tagline: Desire what is forbidden.

items.title: The Last Kiss
items.overview: Laurel always imagined her first kiss would be a fairy tale. Instead, that fantasy turns frightening when she's cursed with an ability to see the death of anyone she kisses. After a vision reveals her crush is doomed to die in a strange murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to unmask the killer before the mystery becomes a massacre.
items.tagline: Some goodbyes last forever.

items.title: Nimrods
items.overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

items.title: Tony
items.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.
items.tagline: "I was — to be frank — a spoiled, miserable, narcissistic, self-destructive and thoughtless young lout, and badly in need of a good ass-kicking."

items.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
items.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.
items.tagline: Ain’t no one all bad or all good.

items.title: Love Barista
items.overview: A superstar Korean actor stranded in Vietnam ends up crossing paths with a sweet, ordinary barista-to-be, kicking off an unpredictable, heart-fluttery romance that shakes up both their worlds.
items.tagline: SURVIVE TO LOVE

items.title: Another Child
items.overview: Teenage girls suffer from conflicts from their parents' affairs. A baby from the affair is born, and the two families have to accept reality.
items.tagline: A secret is born.

items.title: Once Upon a Time
items.overview: Bai Qian, a goddess and monarch from the Heavenly Realms, is sent to the mortal world to undergo a trial to become a High Goddess. There, she meets Ye Hua, with whom she falls in love and marries. When an old enemy reappears in her life, everything she holds dear is threatened.

cast.name: Liu Yifei
cast.character: Bai Qian / Si Yin / Su Su

items.title: Four Daughters
items.overview: Between light and darkness stands Olfa, a Tunisian woman and the mother of four daughters. One day, her two older daughters disappear. To fill in their absence, the filmmaker Kaouther Ben Hania invites professional actresses and invents a unique cinema experience that will lift the veil on Olfa and her daughters' life stories. An intimate journey of hope, rebellion, violence, transmission and sisterhood that will question the very foundations of our societies.

items.title: Idle Hands
items.overview: Anton is a cheerful but exceedingly non-ambitious 17-year-old stoner who lives to stay buzzed, watch TV, and moon over Molly, the beautiful girl who lives next door. However, it turns out that the old cliché about idle hands being the devil's playground has a kernel of truth after all.
items.tagline: The touching story of a boy and his right hand.

items.title: Plastic Beauty
items.overview: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

items.title: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
items.overview: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

items.title: The Fixers
items.overview: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

items.title: Not a Stranger
items.overview: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

items.title: Neagley
items.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

items.title: Minimum Security
items.overview: Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.
items.tagline: A show about the only people who choose to spend their lives in prison, the guards.

items.title: City of Blood
items.overview: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

items.title: The Doll
items.overview: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

items.title: Golden Axe
items.overview: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

items.title: Kisah Bawah Tanah
items.overview: Follows best friends Sam and Zack as they navigate a world teeming with creatures that have long haunted the imaginations of peoples across Southeast Asia.

items.title: Snowfall
items.overview: Los Angeles. 1983. A storm is coming and its name is crack. Set against the infancy of the crack cocaine epidemic and its ultimate radical impact on the culture as we know it, the story follows numerous characters on a violent collision course.
items.director: Eric Amadio, Dave Andron, John Singleton
items.tagline: This is how crack began.

items.title: Atlanta
items.overview: Two cousins work through the Atlanta music scene in order to better their lives and the lives of their families.
items.tagline: A side of the city you've never seen.

items.title: Sofia the First
items.overview: Set in the storybook world of Enchancia, this is the story of Princess Sofia, an adventurous little girl who is learning how to adjust to royal life after her mom marries the king and she becomes a princess overnight.

items.title: The End of Oak Street
items.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.
items.tagline: Where goes the neighborhood.

items.title: The Little Hours
items.overview: Garfagnana, Italy, 1347. The handsome servant Masseto, fleeing from his vindictive master, takes shelter in a nunnery where three young nuns, Sister Alessandra, Sister Ginevra and Sister Fernanda, try unsuccessfully to find out what their purpose in life is, a conundrum that each of them faces in different ways.
items.tagline: Obedientia. Paupertas.

items.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
items.overview: Swedish thriller based on Stieg Larsson's novel about a male journalist and a young female hacker. In the opening of the movie, Mikael Blomkvist, a middle-aged publisher for the magazine Millennium, loses a libel case brought by corrupt Swedish industrialist Hans-Erik Wennerström. Nevertheless, he is hired by Henrik Vanger in order to solve a cold case, the disappearance of Vanger's niece
items.tagline: Based on the Worldwide Best Seller

items.title: A Love Other Than Yours
items.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.
items.tagline: When love becomes familiar, is staying together enough?

items.title: Army of Darkness
items.overview: Ash, a handsome, shotgun-toting, chainsaw-armed department store clerk, is time warped backwards into England's Dark Ages, where he romances a beauty and faces legions of the undead.

cast.name: Ted Raimi
cast.character: Cowardly Warrior / Second Supportive Villager / S-Mart Clerk

items.tagline: Trapped in time. Surrounded by evil. Low on gas.

items.title: Evil Dead II
items.overview: Ash Williams and his girlfriend Linda find a log cabin in the woods with a voice recording from an archeologist who had recorded himself reciting ancient chants from "The Book of the Dead." As they play the recording an evil power is unleashed taking over Linda's body.

cast.name: Sam Raimi
cast.character: Fake Shemp / Medieval Soldier / Possessed Rocking Chair

cast.name: William Preston Robertson
cast.character: The Hand / The Dark Spirit / The Deer Head / The Enchanted Objects (voice)

items.tagline: Kiss your nerves goodbye!

items.title: The Evil Dead
items.overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.
items.tagline: The ultimate experience in gruelling terror.

items.title: John Q
items.overview: John Quincy Archibald is a father and husband whose son is diagnosed with an enlarged heart and then finds out he cannot receive a transplant because HMO insurance will not cover it. Therefore, he decides to take a hospital full of patients hostage until the hospital puts his son's name on the donor's list.
items.tagline: Give a father no options and you leave him no choice.

items.title: Knightfall
items.overview: MI5 Weapons Tech Ros Knight finds herself unexpectedly called into a Black Ops mission headed up by her Field Agent boyfriend Hugh. When the mission goes fatally wrong, Ros finds herself on the run with a target on her back and must turn to the only man she can trust, her estranged father – legendary retired spy catcher Charles Knight.
items.tagline: Nowhere to run. Except home.

items.title: Drive Through Fire
items.overview: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

items.title: Go Team!
items.overview: Gracias, equipo follows a struggling Spanish cheese company whose rural team-building retreat spirals into betrayal and layoffs, satirizing office politics and corporate absurdity.
items.tagline: The same f**king team building every year.

items.title: Libang Libu
items.overview: A production team is filming at the home of one of their crew members' parents in a village in Perak. Trouble starts from day one, and even more challenges arise in the days that follow.

items.title: The Early Spring
items.overview: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

items.title: Crew Girl
items.overview: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

items.title: The Perfect Lie
items.overview: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

items.title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
items.overview: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.
items.tagline: Welcome to her inner circle.

items.title: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
items.overview: Seiichirou Kondou gets caught up in a summoning ritual and is transported to a parallel world called Romany Kingdom. Having worked day and night, he demands a job and joins the Royal Accounting Department. After narrowly surviving a tonic’s deadly side effects with the aid of magic, Seiichirou entrusts himself to Aresh, captain of the Third Royal Order, known as the Ice Prince.

items.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
items.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

items.title: Hot Spot
items.overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.
items.tagline: The system is unstable.

items.title: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.overview: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.
items.tagline: Won the jackpot, still at his desk.

items.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
items.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.
items.tagline: An adventure of prehistoric pawportions.

items.title: Drawn Together
items.overview: Marfil Cortés, a daughter of a wealthy Spanish businessman, is kidnapped and released, leading her father to hire Sebastian Moore as a bodyguard. Despite initial clashes, they form an irremediable attraction, navigating a world where no one is who they say they are.

items.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
items.overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"
items.tagline: Ring any bells?

items.title: Vanishing Point
items.overview: On the morning of the winter solstice, Tang Yu's son disappeared in the stairwell; gambler Yuan Wu hid his father's body; and two unsolved cases involving the assault.

items.title: The Monkey Hero
items.overview: Once upon a time in a land far, far away, Tang Sanzang set out on a journey with Monkey King Jazz and Sha Wujing—However, one member was missing from their group: Zhu Baji.
items.tagline: Where man and god become friends.

items.title: Almost Us
items.overview: RR has always been in love with his best friend, Janine. But she's infatuated with Kenzo, the star of her own fan fiction. When he finds a way for Janine to meet Kenzo, will he risk his own happiness just for her to have her own happiness?

items.title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
items.overview: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.
items.tagline: The world depended on them. They depended on each other.  A look back after 25 years.

items.title: Tarung: Unforgiven
items.overview: After unintentionally causing the death of his opponent during a martial arts tournament, Hatta vows to never participate in any fighting tournament again. However, when his only sister becomes seriously ill and requires costly medical treatment, he is offered 'financial assistance' by a head of mobsters in return for Hatta fighting for him in the underworld fighting ring.
items.tagline: You're just a cock.

items.title: Us in the End
items.overview: Cisco and Cheska, a long-term couple, embark on a final "break-up trip" to decide whether to let go or fight for their relationship after years of growing apart due to conflicting ambitions.

items.title: Lesbian Space Princess
items.overview: A space princess is thrust out of her sheltered life into a galactic quest to save her bounty hunter ex-girlfriend from the straight white maliens.
items.tagline: She'll save her ex. Or die crying.

items.title: Pet Sematary II
items.overview: The "sematary" is up to its old zombie-raising tricks again. This time, the protagonists are Jeff Matthews, whose mother died in a Hollywood stage accident, and Drew Gilbert, a boy coping with an abusive stepfather.
items.tagline: Raise some hell.

items.title: Pet Sematary
items.overview: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.
items.tagline: Sometimes dead is better.

items.title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
items.overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

items.title: So I'm a Spider, So What?
items.overview: I, the protagonist, was just an ordinary high school girl, but suddenly I was reincarnated as a spider monster in a fantasy world. Not only that, but I awakened in a dungeon filled with vicious monsters. Armed with only my human knowledge and my overwhelming positivity, I'm forced to use spiderwebs and traps to defeat far stronger monsters just to stay alive... So begins the labyrinth survival story of a girl with incredible mental strength living as one of the lowest-ranked beasts!

items.title: Sasaki and Peeps
items.overview: Sasaki is a middle-aged office worker living in Japan. Feeling drained by the vapid corporate world, he heads to the pet shop in search of a new companion. There he finds an adorable bird named Peeps and takes him home. But Sasaki quickly learns that Peeps isn’t your average bird…he’s a powerful mage from another world! Together, they embark on a magical adventure filled with swords and sorcery.

items.title: Last Seen
items.overview: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.
items.tagline: He's waited years for the truth to call.

items.title: DANG!
items.overview: Follow a brother and sister whose fun, messy lives in New York City are interrupted when their worst nightmare comes true: Their high-achieving older sister shows up and wants to hang out with them.

items.title: Siren
items.overview: The coastal town of Bristol Cove is known for its legend of once being home to mermaids. When the arrival of a mysterious girl proves this folklore all too true, the battle between man and sea takes a very vicious turn as these predatory beings return to reclaim their right to the ocean.
items.tagline: More. Are. Coming.

items.title: Portal to Hell
items.overview: After a debt-collector finds a portal to hell in a washing machine at his local laundromat, he’s propositioned into feeding it sinners to save his neighbor’s soul, maybe even at the expense of his own.

items.title: Sheep in the Box
items.overview: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.
items.tagline: Trust what you cannot see.

items.title: One Night Only
items.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.
items.tagline: 12 hours can change everything.

items.title: The Piano Teacher
items.overview: Erika Kohut, a sexually repressed piano teacher living with her domineering mother, meets a young man who starts romantically pursuing her.

items.title: Moana
items.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.
items.tagline: The ocean chose her for a reason.

items.title: The Young Karl Marx
items.overview: 26 year-old Karl Marx embarks with his wife, Jenny, on the road to exile. In 1844 in Paris, he meets Friedrich Engels, an industrialist’s son, who has been investigating the sordid birth of the British working class. Engels, the dandy, provides the last piece of the puzzle to the young Karl Marx’s new vision of the world. Together, between censorship and the police’s repression, riots and political upheavals, they will lead the labor movement during its development into a modern era.

items.title: The Thin Red Line
items.overview: The story of a group of men, an Army Rifle company called C-for-Charlie, who change, suffer, and ultimately make essential discoveries about themselves during the fierce World War II battle of Guadalcanal. It follows their journey, from the surprise of an unopposed landing, through the bloody and exhausting battles that follow, to the ultimate departure of those who survived.
items.tagline: Every man fights his own war.

items.title: Awaken
items.overview: During World War II, photographer Chen Kailai unexpectedly becomes involved in an underground resistance mission to stop the Japanese army’s secret biological experiment. Taking up his fallen mentor’s codename, he joins fellow spies in a perilous fight to expose the enemy’s crimes and prevent a viral catastrophe.

items.title: The Trembling of Cicada
items.overview: Three legal professionals with troubled pasts become entangled in complex criminal cases, where psychological warfare, hidden agendas, and long-buried secrets blur the line between hunter and prey.

items.title: The Grand Tour
items.overview: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show returns with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.
items.tagline: Same show. New knobs.

items.title: THE ONE SHOT
items.overview: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

items.title: Murder Club: Liar's Table
items.overview: A competitive mystery-variety series fusing deduction, role-play, and entertainment. Each episode drops the cast into a murder case as characters who gather clues, hold secret talks, and complete the story themselves—from the opening crime through character intros, clue rounds, interviews, a final vote, and the ending.

items.title: Mayday
items.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.
items.tagline: A friendship with major red flags.

items.title: Dark Hollow
items.overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.
items.tagline: Not everything buried is dead.

items.title: The Girl in the River
items.overview: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.
items.tagline: Every lie floats to the surface.

items.title: Splash City
items.overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

items.title: Come with Me
items.overview: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.

items.title: Gandhari
items.overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

items.title: The Brink of War
items.overview: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.
items.tagline: Not all battles are fought with bullets.

items.title: Lovesick
items.overview: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

items.title: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm
items.overview: The GBRB crew returns for a new challenge as Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo swap city life for the ranch. Spending several days alongside experienced ranchers, the trio learns the essentials of raising dairy cows and horses while experiencing the hard work and philosophy behind livestock farming. From feeding animals to tackling demanding daily tasks, the three celebrities approach every mission with determination, humor, and plenty of mishaps. Their playful chemistry and growing bond with the animals create both hilarious and heartwarming moments. Blending comedy, friendship, and the charm of rural life, the show offers a refreshing look at ranch life and the unexpected rewards of working together in nature.

items.title: Idiot Girls and School Ghost: School Anniversary
items.overview: The high school senior girls discovered a 'Ghost Hide and Seek' tape recorded by their seniors in the broadcasting club. Through the tape, the girls learned about a rumor that if they win in the ghost hide and seek game on the upcoming school anniversary, they can receive a perfect score on the college entrance exam. The girls decided to recruit Min-joo, a second year student from the religious club, as a mercenary and made a decision to participate together in the ghost hide and seek.
items.tagline: Let's Go!

items.title: The Runner
items.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.
items.tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.

items.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
items.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.
items.tagline: Some heroes juct click.

items.title: Lola Dust
items.overview: After attending an audition, an aspiring actress finds herself the subject of a deep fake campaign targeting the British Immigration minister. In her quest to expose the truth and find the perpetrators, she becomes the victim of identity theft and digital harassment which leads her to a world hidden in plain sight.
items.tagline: Stealing her image was just the beginning

items.title: Sugarhouse
items.overview: A sweet-natured teenager and her headstrong little sister, abandoned by their outlaw father, reach out for help from their wayward brother, who remains haunted by the sins of his past.

items.title: The Room Below
items.overview: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother living with a mysterious creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son. But when a retired detective begins investigating the child's disappearance, her carefully constructed world starts to unravel.

items.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
items.overview: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

items.title: The Night I Got Pregnant By the CEO
items.overview:
Hanai Shiori, who works in the sales department of a fashion distribution website, is suddenly dumped by her boyfriend Keiichi on their third anniversary. While she is in tears at a bar, a kind man approaches and gently speaks to her. Leaning on his kindness, Shiori ends up spending the night with him.

As time passes, Shiori discovers that she is pregnant. To make matters more complicated, the new company president who appears at her workplace turns out to be the very man from that night.

items.title: The Yakuza Boss’s Beloved
items.overview: After discovering her live-in boyfriend's affair, an advertising employee moves in with her cold, feared boss — unaware he's secretly a young Yakuza leader.

items.title: A Calm Sea and Beautiful Days with You
items.overview: During the Showa-era, newlyweds Natsumi Ebata and Takimasa Ebata enter an arranged marriage without a single day of courtship. Through tender yet exasperating moments, the two slowly bridge the gap between them, discovering love in the quiet routines of their shared days.

items.title: Then You Try Making It!
items.overview: A woman loses herself by playing the "perfect girlfriend," cooking elaborate meals for her partner, while her old-fashioned boyfriend assumes women should cook. After a smooth college romance and cohabitation, they break up right after his proposal. Through cooking, they rethink stereotypes and rebuild their love in this rom-com.

items.title: My Hot Sexless Lover
items.overview: A woman thinks her new boyfriend is “perfect,” but while he is handsome and fun, he says he’s not interested in intimacy. Can she convince him to change his mind?

items.title: My Little Lover - Minami Kun no Koibito
items.overview: Shun'ichi Minami possesses good looks and does well academically in high school. Chiyomi Horikiri is a bright girl who likes dancing. They were childhood friends and also their first loves, but after Shun'ichi Minami's father disappeared they hardly talk. On a storming night, Chiyomi Horikiri has an argument with her parents over her future course and leaves home. While trying to avoid the rain, Chiyomi Horikiri wishes that she go back to her childhood. Suddenly, Chiyomi becomes 15 cm tall. Shun'ichi Minami happens to see tiny Chiyomi Horikiri. She tells him that she doesn't want anyone else to see her, and Shun'ichi Minami takes her his home.

items.title: Just Play Dead
items.overview: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.
items.tagline: Til death do they part.

items.title: I Want Your Sex
items.overview: When fresh-faced Elliot lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy, his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.
items.tagline: Don't worry, you'll like it.

items.title: Confinement
items.overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

items.title: The Wrong Girls
items.overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.
items.tagline: Best buds. Worst adults.

items.title: The Weight
items.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.
items.tagline: A tale of good and evil.

items.title: The Keeper of the Camphor Tree
items.overview: Reito Naoi, a young man fired unfairly from his day job, finds himself hitting rock bottom when he's arrested after a desperate attempt to get back on his feet. With nothing left to him, he surrendered himself to fate, giving up on any hopes for the future, and lost the will to make his own choices in life. But one day, a chance encounter threw him a lifeline that could change his fate forever.

items.title: The Last Scene
items.overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

items.title: Tangled: Before Ever After
items.overview: Rapunzel grapples with the responsibilities of being a princess and the overprotective ways of her father. While she wholeheartedly loves Eugene, Rapunzel does not share his immediate desire to get married and settle down within the castle walls. Determined to live life on her own terms, she and her tough-as-nails Lady-in-Waiting Cassandra embark on a secret adventure where they encounter mystical rocks that magically cause Rapunzel's long blonde hair to grow back. Impossible to break and difficult to hide, Rapunzel must learn to embrace her hair and all that it represents.
items.tagline: Life is about to get hairier.

items.title: Tangled Ever After
items.overview: The kingdom is in a festive mood as everyone gathers for the royal wedding of Rapunzel and Flynn. However, when Pascal and Maximus, as flower chameleon and ring bearer, respectively, lose the gold bands, a frenzied search and recovery mission gets underway. As the desperate duo tries to find the rings before anyone discovers that they’re missing, they leave behind a trail of comical chaos that includes flying lanterns, a flock of doves, a wine barrel barricade and a very sticky finale. Will Maximus and Pascal save the day and make it to the church in time? And will they ever get Flynn’s nose right?

items.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
items.overview: Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway Noa is drawn to a mysterious girl named Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for Mafty's mission -- the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Meanwhile, Kenneth Sleg of the Earth Federation Forces prepares a defense operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate Mafty and is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfill her own role.

items.title: The Mongoose
items.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

items.title: Intense Love
items.overview: A love story between a genius doctor and an actress, both determined to reject their parents' arranged marriages, only to discover that love is something destined for them.

items.title: Unchained Love
