Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unraveling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.

items.title: We Bare Bears
items.overview: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized  society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends,  or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice  Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the  hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the  siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By  their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human  character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka  Bigfoot.

items.title: The Devil's Mouth
items.overview: Five college friends set off to explore the Devil's Mouth cave system in Thailand for one last adventure before life in the real world begins. But they soon discover that something is hunting them under the water… fast, silent, and deadly. In the suffocating darkness, trust erodes, panic spreads, and every wrong turn becomes a fight for survival.

items.title: Who Are You: School 2015
items.overview: After losing her memory in an accident, a bullied high school orphan finds herself in the place of an identical-looking girl who's gone missing.
items.tagline: She lost herself but found her other self.

items.title: Fireflies at El Mozote
items.overview: A boy seeks revenge after surviving El Mozote massacre in El Salvador, where government forces killed his family and destroyed his village - the deadliest civilian massacre in modern Latin America.

items.title: Leviticus
items.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.
items.tagline: It will never stop.

items.title: Second Sister
items.overview: High school student 'Ji-eun' was the victim of the crime, but distorted online posts and malicious comments made her into the perpetrator in the public eye, driving her to take her own life. Her sister 'So-eun' finds detective 'Jun-kyung' to uncover the truth behind her sister's unfair death, and he begins hunting down a suspect in cyberspace. As clues are revealed one by one, the case grows from a simple rumor into a complex web of truth involving anonymous accounts.
items.tagline: Find the murderer hiding in the network

items.title: Pay the Ghost
items.overview: One year after his young son disappeared during a Halloween carnival, Mike Cole is haunted by eerie images and terrifying messages he can’t explain. Together with his estranged wife, he will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery and find their son—and, in doing so, he unearths a legend that refuses to remain buried in the past.
items.tagline: Evil walks among us.

items.title: Blue Miburo
items.overview: The year is 1863, with the story being based in Kyoto. We follow a youth named Nio who is an honest and kind soul who's considerate of his family, yet he also has a hidden burning passion for seeking justice. From the time he came across Toshizou Hijikata and Souji Okita, members from a group of hated ronin known as the Miburo, his life then takes a turn to a bluer, and clearer path. Nio, alongside the other men whose hearts burn bravely and true, step forth towards an honest path with their blue wills adorned on their hearts!

items.title: As Scheduled
items.overview: After a failed acting career, singer Jin Xi turns to musical theatre in hopes of rebuilding his reputation. Under the demanding guidance of renowned director Ning Jin, he struggles to earn the respect of the troupe while discovering his true passion for the stage.

items.title: Blossoms of Power
items.overview: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

items.title: Furious
items.overview: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.
items.tagline: There's a thin line between hunter and prey.

items.title: President Curtis
items.overview: Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

items.title: Supergirl
items.overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.
items.tagline: Truth. Justice. Whatever.

items.title: Unidentified
items.overview: The body of a teenage girl is found in the heart of the desert, he raised many questions about the girl's personality, the lady decides to search for the circumstances of the crime and collect information about the unknown body, and solves the mystery surrounded by the crime.

items.title: Assassination Classroom the Movie: Our Time
items.overview: United by a common mission to eliminate their teacher, Koro-sensei, an alien creature with phenomenal strength, join Nagisa and his Class 3-E classmates in brand-new adventures.
items.tagline: With ten years' worth of love.

items.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
items.overview: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.
items.tagline: He's a Sixty Million Dollar Man But He Has Only a Mouth, a Head, and a Penis!

items.title: The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry
items.overview: Harold Fry is an unremarkable man who has made mistakes with all the important things: being a husband, a father and a friend. And now, well into his 60s, he is content to fade quietly into the background of life. Until, one day – Harold learns his old friend Queenie is dying. Harold leaves home, walking to his post office to send her a letter. And out of the blue, Harold decides to keep walking, all the way to her hospice, 450 miles away.
items.tagline: Hope is a journey.

items.title: Adopt a Highway
items.overview: Russ Millings has just been released from prison after serving 21 years for a 3rd strike conviction for possessing an ounce of marijuana. As he tries to adapt to a world he doesn’t recognize – including trying to learn how to use the internet – he finds an abandoned baby in a dumpster behind the fast food restaurant where he works as a dishwasher. Unsure of what to do, and caught between impulses of kindness and panic, Russ soon realizes this could be his chance at redemption.

items.title: Musafir Cafe
items.overview: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

items.title: Time
items.overview: A wealthy and ambitious businesswoman is thrust one year into the future and learns that she has been declared missing, her family has fallen apart, and her fiancé has moved on. Determined to uncover the truth, she must confront the life that continued without her.

items.title: The Prosecutor's Proposal
items.overview: A victim’s son and a killer’s son reunite as a prosecutor and investigator, fighting systemic corruption while becoming each other's salvation.
items.tagline: Chasing the same truth with different beliefs.

items.title: GTO Revival
items.overview: Onizuka, a former motorcycle gang member turned high-school teacher is assigned to a private academy full of troubled students. The issue at this high school revolves around an exposé-style influencer who has nearly 2 million followers who specializes in exposing and spreading rumors, causing controversies and uproar, regardless of whether the individuals involved are celebrities or ordinary people. Several teachers and students from the academy have been exposed so far, and due to being targeted so frequently, there are rumors circulating within the school that there might be a culprit impersonating the influencer. As a result, students live their school lives while constantly observing each other’s expressions, becoming increasingly suspicious and paranoid.

items.title: GTO: The Movie
items.overview: Great Teacher Onizuka is back, using his unorthodox brand of inspiration and education as a substitute teacher in a depressed small town in Hokkaido.

items.title: Newborn
items.overview: After serving seven years in solitary confinement, Chris Newborn seeks to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family only to find that freedom has become a terrifying psychological battleground.
items.tagline: Protect your mind.

items.title: GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka
items.overview: Eikichi Onizuka, former gang leader, becomes a teacher of a class of students who torment their teachers and fellow students. Of course they do not do this out of whim, they have their reasons. Onizuka is charged by the chairlady to help these troubled students into a more healthy adulthood, and help rehabilitate the teachers in the process as well.

items.title: Great Teacher Onizuka
items.overview: A former gang member wants to be Japan's best teacher. When he's hired to supervise a class of hopeless cases, it's his chance to prove himself.

items.title: Cowboy Bebop
items.overview: In 2071, roughly fifty years after an accident with a hyperspace gateway made the Earth almost uninhabitable, humanity has colonized most of the rocky planets and moons of the Solar System. Amid a rising crime rate, the Inter Solar System Police (ISSP) set up a legalized contract system, in which registered bounty hunters, also referred to as "Cowboys", chase criminals and bring them in alive in return for a reward.

cast.name: Aoi Tada
cast.character: Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivruski IV (voice)

items.tagline: See you space cowboy...

items.title: The Forbidden Land
items.overview: Zhang Chao, a quiet and withdrawn student, finds himself at odds with a school bully while seeking the truth behind his roommate’s mysterious death. As he digs deeper, he unravels a hidden secret about his past, embarking on a transformative journey of friendship, redemption, and self-discovery.

items.title: Love For You
items.overview: In the 1990s, teenagers Chen Yi and Miao Jing met due to their parents, initially getting off to a rocky start. However, Miao Jing's kindness eventually softens Chen Yi's attitude towards her. Chen Yi and Miao Jing's relationship deepens after Chen Yi's father dies and Miao Jing's mother disappears, leaving the two to rely only on each other. Miao Jing eventually confesses her feelings for Chen Yi, but he pushes her away after he gets tangled up as a crime witness, urging her to leave their city. Years later, Chen Yi runs a billiards hall in their hometown, while Miao Jing returns for a work assignment. But when Chen Yi suspects that Miao Jing's boss is involved in smuggling, he vows to protect her – and stay by her side.

items.title: 72 HOURS
items.overview: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.
items.tagline: The night is young. He isn't.

items.title: The Truthers
items.overview: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

items.title: The Dink
items.overview: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

items.title: Colony
items.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
items.tagline: Survive the hive.

items.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
items.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

cast.name: John Ross Bowie
cast.character: Barry Kripke / Supreme Ruler Barry Kripke

items.tagline: Every universe needs a hero. We got Stuart.

items.title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
items.overview: The Soul Reapers and Quincies clash in a final battle as Yhwach breaches the Royal Palace. When the Soul King falls, reality begins collapsing. Former enemies unite to storm the transformed palace and face a threat to all existence. A theatrical screening of the first three episodes of the anime featuring an exclusive behind‑the‑scenes conversation with creator Tite Kubo, chief series director Tomohisa Taguchi, and series director Hikaru Murata about the production.

items.title: The Debt Collector
items.overview: Haunted by guilt after prison, a former debt collector races against a terminal illness, returning to his old world to avenge loan shark victims.
items.tagline: A Debt Can Be Settled, But Not Erased.

items.title: Love in Slow Motion
items.overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

items.title: UnMarry
items.overview: In the middle of annulment cases and custody battles, Celine and Ivan meet at the law office of a lawyer and YouTube host of “Walang Butas Ang Batas”. What begins as a chance encounter grows into a friendship that helps them navigate heartbreak, family, and the possibility of starting over.
items.tagline: Not every "Forever" begins with the wedding. Sometimes, it starts with walking away.

items.title: This is Not a Business Expense!
items.overview: Sanako Moriwaka (Mikako Tabe) is single and works in the accounting department of a soap company. For her job, she checks receipts and bills. Each slip that she reviews, mentions only the dollar amount and a brief reason for the expense. When Sanako Moriwaka reviews the slips, she can often discern suspicious facts surrounding the expense or even troubles in the lives of the employee.

items.title: Adventure Time: Distant Lands
items.overview: Based on the animated series Adventure Time, these four specials explore the unseen corners of the world with both familiar and exciting brand-new characters.

cast.name: Tom Kenny
cast.character: Y5's Dad / Ice King / Simon Petrikov / Berdzerd / Additional Voices (voice)

cast.name: Olivia Olson
cast.character: Marceline the Vampire Queen / Additional Voices (voice)

cast.name: Maria Bamford
cast.character: Margaret / Chocoberry / Mother Worm / Additional Voices (voice)

items.title: Elite Force
items.overview: Following an unprecedented attack on the GIGN, an officer—just as he is leaving the force—will carry out a mission that rivals the intensity of that attack.

items.title: My Daughter's Father
items.overview: Follows Julieta who, during her graduation party suffers a life-threatening health crisis that forces her mother, Maca, to face secrets from the past.

items.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
items.overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

items.title: Masters of the Universe
items.overview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.
items.tagline: Witness how he became He-Man.

items.title: Masters of the Universe
items.overview: When the evil Skeletor finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible, seizing Castle Grayskull and the surrounding city. The Sorceress is now Skeletor's prisoner and he begins to drain her life-force as he waits for the moon of Eternia to align with the Great Eye of the Universe which will bestow god-like power upon him. However, courageous warrior He-Man locates the locksmith inventor Gwildor, who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie and Kevin. Now, both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.
items.tagline: A battle fought in the stars...now comes to Earth.

items.title: Key to the Phoenix Heart
items.overview: The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.

items.title: The Death of Robin Hood
items.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.
items.tagline: He was no hero.

items.title: Feng Shui
items.overview: Park Jae-sang was a royal geomancer, who helps people designate propitious site for houses, store and even graves under the belief that a grave in a good site will bring future fortune for descendants. But he loses his family because he exposed a conspiracy about crown Prince's grave site. Park Jae-sang plans to make a revenge of his family and learns that there is a much bigger conspiracy about propitious grave site; the place that would make grave owner's son the King of Joseon.
items.tagline: The one that occupies the propitious site would rule the world.

items.title: The Vampire Lestat
items.overview: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

cast.name: Delainey Hayles
cast.character: Regina / Claudia de Lioncourt de Pointe du Lac

items.tagline: Scream for me.

items.title: First Love
items.overview: Lu Wanwan is a sophomore student in the Clinical Department of Tsingyao University School of Medicine. After getting drunk she got into a scandal with Ren Chu, a bright student of the same school. To curb the raging scandal, the two agreed to a strategy to eliminate the gossips. In the process they discover each other's shining points and gradually developed a good impression of each other. With the help and guidance of Ren Chu, Lu Wanwan overcame her timid personality, and strived to become a qualified medical student. Unconsciously, the two influenced each other and became their better selves.

items.title: Live On
items.overview: Baek Ho-rang is a high school student. Due to her pretty appearance, she is popular on social media and at her school. Yet, Baek Ho-rang only has one friend, due to her condescending personality. Baek Ho-rang encounters a problem. She learns that someone is trying to unveil her secret. To find that anonymous person, Baek Ho-rang joins her high school's broadcasting club. Go Eun-taek is the chief of the broadcasting club. He is a perfectionist and respected by the club members.

items.title: Girls Like Girls
items.overview: Coley, 17, from rural Oregon, navigates intimacy after her mother's passing. Meeting Sonya sparks new feelings, but self-doubt hinders their connection. Sonya, unfamiliar with dating girls, is uncertain. They learn to embrace emotions.
items.tagline: Love begins when you let it in.

items.title: Disclosure Day
items.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.
items.tagline: We deserve to know.

items.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
items.overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.
items.tagline: If you're searching for new adventure, "this is the way."

items.title: Operation Dark Gold
items.overview: After being expelled from the police academy, Yan Mingyu goes undercover inside his biological father Mai Zhongwei's Tianyao Group to investigate a major money laundering case. As he gains the organization's trust, he uncovers a conspiracy linking organized crime, corrupt officials, and the truth behind his mother's death.

items.title: Scary Movie
items.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.
items.tagline: Every line will be crossed.

items.title: Under the Shadow
items.overview: After Shideh's building is hit by a missile during the Iran-Iraq War, a superstitious neighbor suggests that the missile was cursed and might be carrying malevolent Middle-Eastern spirits. She becomes convinced a supernatural force within the building is attempting to possess her daughter Dorsa, and she has no choice but to confront these forces if she is to save her daughter and herself.
items.tagline: Fear will find you.

items.title: The Strongest Job Is Apparently Not a Hero or a Sage, But an Appraiser (Provisional)!
items.overview: High schooler Hibiki is transported to a monster-filled fantasy world, where he possesses only non-combat skills. However, through key encounters, he discovers hidden powers and embarks on an epic adventure.

items.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
items.overview: Every morning, Sakuradaimon-kun enforces the rules at the school gate, stopping Poem-chan for her too-short skirt. But when they’re thrown together in remedial class, she discovers his secret—the serious, uptight Sakuradaimon-kun is hopeless at studying! As they clash, bicker, and stumble through school life together, the two opposites slowly draw closer and form an unexpected friendship.

items.title: The Food Diary of Miss Maid
items.overview: After a mysterious incident drives her from her job at a British mansion, Suzume moves into a small apartment and begins a new life in Japan. Curious about her new surroundings, she dives into the country’s vibrant food culture. From local diners to street stalls, Suzume discovers new flavors, meets colorful people, and finds joy in life one meal at a time.

items.title: Road to Success
items.overview: When Lin Wanxing returns to her hometown and takes a job at a local high school, she’s unexpectedly tasked with reviving its long-disbanded soccer team. With help from her mysterious tenant, former coach Wang Fa, they work to rebuild the team, guide the students toward their dreams, and face the shadows of their own pasts along the way.

items.title: Jinsei
items.overview: Our hero (voiced by rapper ACE COOL), called by a different name in each chapter of his life, becomes a J-pop idol, an outcast, a leader, and an oracle in this hundred-year chronicle spanning the past, present, and future. Through a chance encounter with a transfer student, he trains to become an idol, starting his search for self-identity and a journey toward greatness beyond superstardom. Written, directed, edited and entirely hand-drawn by newcomer Ryuya Suzuki over eighteen months, JINSEI (meaning “life” in Japanese) is an anime tour-de-force that announces Suzuki to the world as a bold new talent in independent animation.
items.tagline: One life. One hundred years.

items.title: Spooky in Love
items.overview: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.
items.tagline: A chaebol heiress who sees ghosts

items.title: The Undertaker
items.overview: Cherd, a 25-year-old law graduate, is hesitant to take over his father's undertaker business because he is afraid of ghosts. However, his father's condition is worsening, and he has no choice but to help.
items.tagline: Death is The Truth.

items.title: The Map of Longing
items.overview: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

items.title: Chasing Love
items.overview:
Song, a hot nerd and food researcher, arranged a one-night stand with a mysterious woman under a strict condition: no strings attached. However, the other party broke the terms, asking for an emotional connection. Song ended the steamy encounter and walked away.

But the world really is round. That woman turned out to be Piangrawin—the daughter of the president of the company where Song worked. And Piangrawin wasn’t letting go easily. She pursued her with puppy-like devotion, entangling Song's heart and routine with reckless charm. She even claimed she’d already named their future child.

items.title: The Mentalist
items.overview: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.
items.tagline: Let the mind games begin.

items.title: Dinner for Schmucks
items.overview: Rising executive Tim Conrad works for a boss who hosts a monthly dinner in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career-boost. Tim plans on not attending until he meets Barry, a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. Barry's blundering but good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's engagement to his fiancee.
items.tagline: Takes one to know one.

items.title: The Undertaker 2: Afterlife
items.overview: Following the passing of Baikaow and Sak, life in the village slowly returns to normal. This calm is disrupted when Grandma Joy is suddenly struck by lightning and miraculously revives.
items.tagline: When the living haven't found closure, the dead cannot move on.

items.title: Heartstopper Forever
items.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.
items.tagline: Love like there's no ending.

items.title: 23 000 Lives
items.overview: Unable to stand by and watch as countless refugees lose their lives attempting to reach Europe by sea, a group of young Berliners take action. Inexperienced but driven by passion and courage, they launch a crowdfunding campaign to buy an old ship. Venturing into the Mediterranean, they embark on a mission to save thousands of people. But their efforts soon put their understanding of law and justice to the test.

items.title: Desire
items.overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

items.title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
items.overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain - Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work with Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

items.title: The Eternal Fragrance
items.overview: When the Sea Calamity strikes and the Divine Tree appears, whoever claims its fruit gains power over all creation, sparking a bloody war among the immortals, demons, and monsters. A century later, Lei Xiuyuan seeks out Qingqiu orphan Xiaobangchui to save his brother. Fate brings them to Chufeng Academy, where loyal friends give her warmth and love begins to bloom. As their bond deepens from friendship to something more, the truth of her origins slowly unravels, threatening everything they've built.

items.title: The East Palace
items.overview: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?
items.tagline: Beyond boundaries, they unearth the truth.

items.title: Toy Story 5
items.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.
items.tagline: It's on.

items.title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
items.overview: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.
items.tagline: "Uncovering the journey behind the myth."

items.title: Ghost Board
items.overview: A group of friends stumbles upon an ancient board game hidden in a remote temple. Once the die is cast, a vengeful spirit is unleashed, turning the game into a deadly trap. To survive, they must figure out how to end it before they become its next victims.
items.tagline: Roll the dice. Stay alive. Till sunrise.

items.title: Wonderful Nightmare
items.overview: A high-flying, career-driven lawyer dies prematurely due to a clerical error in heaven.
items.tagline: New Life. Wrong Family.

items.title: Love You So Bad
items.overview: Confident college senior Savannah must choose between wild bad boy L.A. and ambitious Vic while facing personal growth and past hurts, all while staying true to herself.

items.title: The Hawk
items.overview: On the back nine of his career, golf legend Lonnie "The Hawk" Hawkins chases one final major — and drags everyone he loves into the chaos.

items.title: Release that Witch
items.overview: Roland, a modern man reborn as a prince in the dangerous Border Town, rescues the witches Anna and Nana Pine from the Church. Harnessing their extraordinary powers, he fuses magic and technology to craft weapons, armies, and steam engines to defend his people. As the Demon Moon rises and conspiracies close in on his family, Roland must lead a revolution to protect his allies and reshape the world.

items.title: Stop! That! Train!
items.overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.
items.tagline: The greatest trainwreck in herstory.

items.title: Ride or Die
items.overview: Best friends, Judith and Debbie, know everything about each other … well, almost everything. Judith has been living a double life that Debbie knows nothing about: she is a highly trained assassin. When a hit goes horribly wrong, Judith and Debbie must go on the run together and work to repair their broken friendship—all while being targeted by a mysterious enemy who wants them dead. And only together, can they solve this layered mystery.
items.tagline: Some friendships are bulletproof.

items.title: Lucky
items.overview: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.
items.tagline: Wish her luck.

items.title: Monster
items.overview: Kenzou Tenma, a Japanese brain surgeon in Germany, finds his life in utter turmoil after getting involved with a psychopath that was once a former patient.
items.tagline: The only thing humans are equal in is death.

items.title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
items.tagline: This is a story about a deranged world.

items.title: CAMP
items.overview: Emily is the cause of two tragedies early in her life; her dad suggests she go to a Camp for troubled youth to ease her guilt. When Emily arrives, she is taken in by the other counsellors; they accept her as she is and wrap her in a veil of peace & forgiveness. Emily stands at the forefront of a new kind of life, but there’s a voice out there in the woods she can’t ignore, telling Emily to go home.
items.tagline: Maybe it's time to go home.

items.title: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God 10th Anniversary
items.overview: Ten years after Goblin, Gong Yoo, Lee Dong-wook, Kim Go-eun, and Yoo In-na reunite for a special journey, revisiting iconic locations from the drama and sharing memories, stories, and reflections on one of Korea's most beloved series.
items.tagline: Goblin has returned!

items.title: Sunset Strip Killers
items.overview: Based on a true story, in 1980s Los Angeles, nurse Carol Bundy falls for the charming but deadly Doug Clark. Drawn into his world of murder, obsession, and blood, she becomes complicit in shocking crimes across the city.
items.tagline: Love. Fame. Murder.

items.title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table
items.overview: Yuki plays death games for a living, but when she wakes in a mansion with five other women, can she survive a new lethal maze of locked rooms and traps?
items.tagline: This is a story about a deranged world.

items.title: The Breadwinner
items.overview: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.
items.tagline: One dad. Three kids. Zero clue.

items.title: Backrooms
items.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
items.tagline: See how far it goes.

items.title: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-
items.overview: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe?  The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...

items.title: Rekonek
items.overview: A multi-story film that centers on six different Filipino families during a Christmas Eve when the internet goes out worldwide, forcing them to reconnect with each other through more traditional means.
items.tagline: As the world goes offline, find your way home to a true Filipino Christmas.

items.title: Dream to You
items.overview: Dreaming of filmmaking, a passionate high schooler pushes aside all obligations to create short films, inspiring a studious but passionless classmate. Their deep bond eventually turns romantic, but they are abruptly separated when he is forced to move overseas. Years later in their thirties, their lives have completely swapped: she is a disillusioned, struggling TV reporter, while he has become an award-winning director. When a sudden reunion brings them face-to-face, he resolves to help her rediscover her lost spark, but she still harbors deep resentment over his past disappearance.
items.tagline: Our greatest story has yet to be filmed.

items.title: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
items.overview: Serafina, the West’s fiercest knight, expected torture when captured by barbarians. Instead, she got a marriage proposal! Marrying her sworn enemy is a hard no! But after seeing her wedding captor’s culture and very pretty face, she may be tempted to swap her sword for a wedding veil. Get ready for the ultimate enemies-to-maybe-lovers arc.

items.title: Go for It, Nakamura-kun!!
items.overview: Nakamura falls for his classmate Hirose instantly, but they've never spoken. Can his bumbling attempts to say hello lead to a real connection?

items.title: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
items.overview: Natsuki Haibara thought his high school years were a complete failure—until he suddenly wakes up as a freshman again, armed with all he learned in college. Determined to rewrite his school days, he joins the popular crowd, makes friends he never had, and grows closer to his crush. But second chances aren’t as easy as hitting “Restart.” Can Natsuki turn his regrets into a rainbow-colored youth?!

items.title: The Legend of Rosy Clouds
items.overview: In the legendary Nine Cities, noblewoman Fan Yun and cunning lord Qi Zheng join forces to overcome a looming crisis. As they fight for the people's welfare, their bond deepens into friendship and love to bring peace and prosperity to the realm.

items.title: The Apartment Job
items.overview: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.
items.tagline: In This Apartment, Trust Is the Rarest Resident.

items.title: Tomb Raider King
items.overview: Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.

items.title: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
items.overview: Bertia is reincarnated into her favorite otome game—not as the heroine, but as the villainess engaged to the perfect Crown Prince Cecil! Fully aware that her role is to sabotage his future romance, she’s determined to bloom as a wicked flower and wither away according to the story. But no matter how hard she tries to scheme, her “evil” plans only make her more endearing!

items.title: Mistress Kanan Is Devilishly Easy
items.overview: Kanan the “Gourmet Devil” has descended upon the human world with one goal: to gorge herself on youthful souls. Her first target is high schooler Youji Kyougi—except her plan backfires horribly! Instead of her meal, he’s now her…boyfriend?! Even though she’s lived for thousands of years, Kanan has never known love! Can a devil survive the dangers of dates, hand-holding, and her very first romance?

items.title: I Want to End This Love Game
items.overview: Childhood friends Yukiya and Miku share everything…except their feelings. Ever since sixth grade, they've played a "love game": they take turns saying "I love you" and whoever gets flustered first loses. Now in high school, their hearts are closer than ever—but will they finally find the courage to confess?

items.title: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
items.overview: Takuya Seo is a quiet otaku who keeps a low profile at school—until two gals from his class start talking to him. The cool but scatterbrained Kei Amane and the cheerful, energetic Kotoko Ijichi couldn’t be more different, but the three soon bond over anime, games, and shared fandom. But one question remains: do nice gals who hang out with otaku really exist?!

items.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
items.overview: Maki Maehara, the class outcast, finally makes his first friend: Umi Asanagi, the second-prettiest girl in class and the center of everyone’s attention. He’s convinced she’s out of his league, but as their unlikely friendship grows, Maki starts to wonder…could there be more than just friendship between them?

items.title: Eren the Southpaw
items.overview: As high school reaches its midpoint, Koichi Asakura—who dreams of studying design at art school—has his plans shaken by explosive graffiti on a museum wall. The artist is Eren Yamagishi, a left-handed girl who buried her talent after a past incident. Drawn together by art, Koichi pursues design as Eren returns to painting, but fear, ambition, and old scars threaten their paths.

items.title: Protector
items.overview: Nikki's life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.
items.tagline: Mother. Savior. Killer...

items.title: The Outer Threat
items.overview: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

items.title: Ikka
items.overview: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.
items.tagline: Some trials don't end in court.

items.title: ONE PIECE HEROINES
items.overview: After buying a pair of shoes that end up hurting her feet, Nami returns to the shop feeling dissatisfied. There, she meets Lebno, the designer, who tells her, "I'll make you a brand-new pair from scratch—but only if you’ll be my model." The shoes are crafted by the artisan Miucha, leading to an unexpected and stylish encounter.

items.title: Simpsley
items.overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.
items.tagline: A Simpsons noir? We're in.

items.title: Boulevard
items.overview: Hasley, a girl with a list of unfulfilled dreams, and Luke, a complex and vulnerable boy marked by a tragic past, find refuge on the boulevard, where they discover whether love can conquer all.

items.title: Nothing to Lose
items.overview: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

items.title: The World of Love
items.overview: Jooin, a 17-year-old student confused by love, unleashes chaos with some words spoken in a moment of anger. Anonymous notes questioning her actions begin to arrive, altering her quiet life.

items.title: The Son
items.overview: A successful lawyer, with a new wife and infant, agrees to care for his teenage son from a previous marriage after his ex-wife becomes concerned about the boy's wayward behavior.

items.title: Deleter
items.overview: An online content moderator deletes a suicide video made by her co-worker. But the otherwise desensitized woman cannot escape from either her own troubled past or from a mysterious vengeful presence.
items.tagline: Don't delete the dead.

items.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
items.overview: A couple of thirtysomething best friends unwittingly become entangled in an international conspiracy when one’s ex-boyfriend shows up at their apartment with a team of deadly assassins on his trail.
items.tagline: They got this.

items.title: Grave Encounters 2
items.overview: Tortured by the ghosts of the demonized insane asylum that killed the crew of GRAVE ENCOUNTERS, film students fight to escape death as their own paranormal investigation goes terribly wrong in this horrifying sequel.
items.tagline: Fear is just a word. Reality is much worse.

items.title: Grave Encounters
items.overview: A crew from a paranormal reality television show lock themselves in a haunted psychiatric hospital. They search for evidence of paranormal activity as they shoot what ends up becoming their final episode.
items.tagline: They were searching for proof... they found it.

items.title: Reign Over Me
items.overview: A man who lost his family in the September 11 attack on New York City runs into his old college roommate. Rekindling the friendship is the one thing that appears able to help the man recover from his grief.
items.tagline: Let in the unexpected.

items.title: Little House on the Prairie
items.overview: The close-knit Ingalls family builds a new life on the Western frontier, where the joys of nature and the struggle for survival are deeply intertwined.
items.tagline: Adventure awaits.

items.title: Kusunoki's Garden of Gods
items.overview: Minato Kusunoki is assigned to manage his family’s haunted, abandoned countryside estate. However, thanks to his overwhelming spiritual power, Minato accidentally purifies the entire place, turning the once-cursed property into a peaceful haven for wandering gods and deities! As Minato settles in, he finds himself surrounded by quirky divine neighbors and the lively chaos of life among the gods.

items.title: I'm Not Afraid
items.overview: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

items.title: Walid
items.overview: The story follows Walid (Faizal Hussein), a former leader of the deviant cult Jihad Ummah, who flees from the authorities and hides in a mountainous region to rebuild his influence. His attempt to rise again leads him to meet Habiburrahman (Aqasha), a charismatic preacher who conceals his true intentions behind eloquent words.

items.title: Camellias
items.overview: After learning of her sister's death, Jiang Yukui, the saintess of the Zhao Clan, embarks on a quest for revenge. Alongside the powerful Feng Ye, she becomes entangled in a dangerous struggle against a tyrannical ruler, only to uncover a shocking truth that changes everything she thought she knew about her family and destiny.

items.title: Reverse Chase
items.overview: After discovering a woman's remains hidden for sixteen years, Xu Weizhang unexpectedly establishes contact with police officer Liu Xinjian in 1995. Together, they investigate a serial murder case across two timelines.

items.title: The Furious
items.overview: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network and he receives no help from the corrupt police, Wei sets out to find her himself. His only ally is Navin, a relentless journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo ruthlessly battle the kidnappers in this explosive martial arts showdown.
items.tagline: To save their loved ones, they will fight everyone.

items.title: Black Box (Flight 298)
items.overview: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.
items.tagline: What happened to Flight 298?

items.title: Pitfall
items.overview: After a young man is separated from his friends in the woods, he falls into a ten-foot deep pit of spikes, impaling him through his leg and leaving him trapped. He quickly learns that his fall was not an accident.
items.tagline: If the fall doesn't kill you... He will.

items.title: Friends from College
items.overview: Twenty years after graduation, a tight-knit group of college friends reconnects and discovers that love hasn't gotten easier with age.

items.title: Blue Film
items.overview: Drawn by the promise of easy money and anonymous sex, queer camboy Aaron Eagle is shocked to discover a personal connection with the mysterious stranger who has paid for his company. Over the course of one night, the two men engage in a war of words and emotions as they wrestle with the impact of a tainted and shared past.

items.title: Heidi: Rescue of the Lynx
items.overview: When eight-year-old Heidi saves a lynx family and their home from a greedy businessman, she gets her grandfather to come clean with the village community, and she realizes that her beloved little lynx belongs with his family in the wild just as she belongs with her grandfather in the mountains.

cast.name: Tom Zahner
cast.character: Grandfather / Chief of Station / Hunter (voice: English version)

cast.name: Mike McAlpine
cast.character: Mr. Sesemann / Police Officer (voice: English version)

cast.name: Leanne Maksin
cast.character: Mrs. Feichtmooser / Child / Mrs. Watts(voice: English version)

items.title: Ticket to Heaven
items.overview: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.
items.tagline: One… who has lost all faith. one… who is full of unwavering faith.

items.title: The Air
items.overview: When a violent coup erupts back home, Princess Catherine "Blue" De Lena becomes an assassination target while visiting Thailand. Her survival falls entirely on Lieutenant "Lom" Wayo Watinwanich, a sharp female marine police officer assigned as her underground protector. Forced off the grid, the two women must navigate relentless tactical hits and political betrayal. As duty and survival blur, their isolation sparks an intense, undeniable magnetic attraction—a forbidden love defying rigid military protocol and royal expectations. Amidst constant gunfire, Catherine finds safety in Lom's embrace, while Lom discovers a kindred spirit beneath the royal exterior. In a world where everyone has a price, their fierce devotion becomes both their ultimate liability and their only way out. Together, they must dismantle the conspiracy before the assassins close in.

cast.name: Becky Armstrong
cast.character: Princess Catherine Blew De Laina | Helena

items.title: Avengers Social Club
items.overview: Women gather power to revenge on targets, as well as uncover social injustice.

items.title: Passenger
items.overview: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger that won't stop until it claims them both turns their van life adventure into a nightmare.
items.tagline: 130 million people take road trips every year. 15,400 of them are never seen again.

items.title: Man of War
items.overview: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

items.title: Meet, Greet & Bye
items.overview: A mother, who loves watching K-dramas, decides to stop her chemo treatment after losing hope of getting better. Her only dream before dying is to meet her ultimate K-drama idol, who is visiting Manila for a series of events. Her four children agree to work together with the condition that once their mother meets their idol, she will undergo therapy before her time runs out.
items.tagline: To the hands that held us and the hands we now hold.

items.title: Sextuplets
items.overview: Father-to-be Alan is shocked to learn that he was born a sextuplet. With his newfound brother Russell riding shotgun, the duo sets out on a hilarious journey to reunite with their remaining long-lost siblings.

cast.name: Marlon Wayans
cast.character: Alan / Russell / Dawn / Jasper / Ethan / Baby Pete / Lynette

items.title: Enemies With Benefits
items.overview: Head of Sales Lal is determined to triumph over Head of Accounting Wine. Wine is her polar opposite and known for her mercilessness. When a wild night leads them to a friends with benefits relationship, they'll do anything to keep it a secret, pretending to be enemies so that absolutely no one at work finds out. Without realising it, however, their newfound closeness begins to give way to love.
items.tagline: If you have something to say to me, just take it to the bed.

items.title: Fatal Code
items.overview: After Yuan Jing's consciousness becomes trapped inside a virtual reality game, Li Wenwan enters the digital world to uncover the conspiracy behind his apparent death. With the help of the mysterious Yuan Qi, she faces growing threats in both the virtual and real worlds.

items.title: Love In Sync
items.overview: A former top actress who has lost her ability to feel and a psychological counselor who feels too much are brought together through a mysterious ability to share emotions. As she begins to rediscover emotions through him, and he learns to manage the overwhelming weight of empathy through her, the two gradually heal each other in unexpected ways.
items.tagline: Can you hear my heart..?

items.title: The Husband
items.overview: Tae-ju and Se-yun are on the verge of divorce. But when a drunken comment from Tae-ju gets his wife, Se-yun, kidnapped, everything changes. Even worse, he's now the prime suspect. Forced to go on the run, Tae-ju must rescue his wife on his own. To save her, he pushes himself to the absolute limit.
items.tagline: The end of their marriage is only the beginning

items.title: Miracle in Cell No. 7
items.overview: Joselito is a mentally-challenged man who is wrongfully charged with sexually assaulting and murdering a little girl. In prison, he becomes friends with his fellow inmates and together they form a plan to smuggle his young daughter inside the cell! Years after, his daughter becomes a lawyer and is determined to prove her father's innocence.
items.tagline: A tale of miracle inside a notorious cell.

items.title: Never-Ending Summer
items.overview: To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

items.title: The Ramparts of Ice
items.overview: Weighed down by memories she can't shake, high schooler Koyuki Hikawa keeps everyone at arm's length — until three schoolmates draw her out of her shell.

items.title: Human Vapor
items.overview: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.
items.tagline: You won't see it coming. You won't survive it.

items.title: Summer '36
items.overview: Nice, 1936. As workers enjoy their first paid holidays, four very different women become entangled in the murder of a prosecutor at the Riviera hotel.

items.title: Super Subbu
items.overview: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

items.title: Pee Nak 5
items.overview: A year after the deadly battle that finally subdued the vengeful ghost of Nak Tinn, the cycle of vengeance returns once again.
items.tagline: No forgiveness for bad karma.

items.title: Wings of Dread
items.overview: Air marshal Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back from his honeymoon

items.title: Living the Land
items.overview: With both parents working far away, ten-year-old Chuang is being raised by extended family in his home village, where thousands of years of rural tradition collide with the socio-economic changes of China in the early 1990s.

items.title: Wira
items.overview: After a long stint in the army, an ex-lieutenant returns home and enters an underground MMA match to take on a local mobster and protect his family.

items.title: Number One
items.overview: Eighteen-year-old Ha-min suddenly begins to see the number "365" every time he eats his mother's homemade meal—and the number drops with each bite. Believing it to be a countdown to his mother's death, he distances himself from her and her cooking. Years later, still haunted by the number, Ha-min lives cautiously, preparing for the worst. Just as he begins to find peace with his girlfriend Ryeo-eun, an unexpected truth turns his world upside down.
items.tagline: Mom's time began counting down.

items.title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
items.overview: Nao is a replica created to be Sunao Aikawa’s perfect double, stepping in whenever Sunao skips school. She studies, plays sports, and lives each day for the original—until one day, Nao falls in love. Suddenly, her quiet, borrowed life blooms with secret dates and shy promises. But the more she cherishes them, the more she must hide from Sunao, who’s starting to notice the changes in her replica.

items.title: Always a Catch!
items.overview: Born into a legendary ducal family, martial prodigy Maria “Mimi” Annovazzi loses her claim as heir and is suddenly ordered to marry into prestige. With no options left in her homeland, she transfers to a neighboring kingdom—only to be publicly dumped at graduation by a prince she’s never met over an engagement she didn’t even know she had! Will Maria be doomed to the life of a spinster?!

items.title: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
items.overview: New university life, new dormmates…and a whole new world of drinks! Botan Kamiina takes her first sip of alcohol after spotting the quiet dorm leader, Ibuki Tonami, enjoying a highball alone. From shochu to whisky, Botan shares the joy of drinking with friends, while Ibuki slowly learns that some pleasures are better when shared.

items.title: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls' High School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party
items.overview: A 3DCG movie for Love Live! Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club.

cast.name: Miyake Miu
cast.character: セラス柳田リリエンフェルト

items.title: Elle
items.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.
items.tagline: Law school was hard. High school was harder.

items.title: Love Has Fireworks
items.overview: Qian Fei, an employee in a bank, was planning a fulfilling life. But after being abandoned by her fiancé, she had to redefine her life. Li Yifei, from a rich family, always prioritized his career. His girlfriend couldn't endure poverty and left. To cover her mortgage, Fei rent out a room to Yifei, and they became collaborators. Fei bravely faced challenges and grew through the process. Their journey was marked by collisions, but they fell in love and decided to face the future together.

items.title: You Have My Heart
items.overview: A materialist scholar strays into a demon's realm, only to rediscover a century-old soul-bond and a love predestined by fate.

items.title: A Hundred Scenes of AWAJIMA
items.overview: At Awajima Opera School, girls from across Japan strive to earn a place on stage. Wakana is driven by her love of musical theater, while Kinue studies with quiet discipline. Scholarship student Emi draws attention from all—but especially from Keiko, who struggles with admiration and comparison. Through shifting perspectives, their intertwined days explore ambition, friendship, and self-discovery.

items.title: Enola Holmes 3
items.overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.
items.tagline: Tis I do?

items.title: HUNGRY
items.overview: A group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose after becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands.
items.tagline: This hippo isn't playing games.

items.title: Raakh
items.overview: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

items.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
items.overview: Young hero Finn and his magical dog best friend Jake embark on adventures across the fantastical land of Ooo — partying with cloud people and punching evil in the butt along the way.

items.title: The Get Out
items.overview: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.
items.tagline: The night life is dirty business.

items.title: Marriage Toxin
items.overview: For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by Masters, and Five Great Families hold the greatest power and influence. Hikaru Gero, an heir to the Gero family, lives in the underworld as an elite assassin. When his sister is pressured to produce an heir, Hikaru asks Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler, to find him a bride. The most challenging mission of his life begins!

items.title: The First Jasmine
items.overview: Eldest daughter Ye Li marries the crippled Prince Mo Xiuyao, while her sister Ye Ying weds Prince Mo Jinglei the same day. A descendant of Lishan, Ye Li secretly seeks revenge on those who wronged her clan. Suspected by her husband, who also hides a revenge plan, the couple gradually become allies. Meanwhile, Prince Jinglei plots to seize the throne. In the end, Ye Li and Mo Xiuyao join forces to defeat their enemies and restore peace to the empire.

items.title: Akane-banashi
items.overview: As a child, Akane witnesses a shocking event during her father's career-defining show. Now in high school, she vows to reach the art's highest rank.
items.tagline: And so, here begins a story.

items.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
items.overview: Meet Sasaki, an overworked, middle-aged office worker. His days are marked only by the passing of more unrewarding corporate drudgery. Smoking helps take the edge off, but other than that, the only bright spot of his day is when he goes to the nearby supermarket and sees Yamada's smiling face. So, one evening after yet another exhausting day, he heads to the supermarket to find he missed Yamada's shift. Dejected, he decides to go find a smoking area but discovers there isn’t one to be found. Just as he’s about to leave, a girl in a biker jacket named Tayama asks him to join her at a secret smoking area!

items.title: SNOWBALL EARTH
items.overview: Ten years after saving Earth with his robot friend Yukio, Tetsuo returns to a planet of endless ice and snow.

items.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
items.overview: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.
items.tagline: The cat and mouse chase never ends!

items.title: Obsession
items.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
items.tagline: Be careful who you wish for…

items.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
items.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.
items.tagline: Icons reign forever.

items.title: Petals of Reincarnation
items.overview: Toya Senji is talentless. He's tried everything but he can't seem to excel at anything no matter how hard he tries. Then he meets Haito, a Kendo champion and... humanity's protector? She uses the Stem of Reincarnation to draw on the abilities of her past lives, but it only works when she slits her own throat. And now she wants Toya to join her?!

items.title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An almost History of America
items.overview: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.
items.tagline: He can tell a lie.

items.title: Chloe et Emma
items.overview: Having lost love, her job, and her home, Emma had hit rock bottom when she stumbled upon the estate of Chloe, a mysterious heiress. Unexpected happenings lead the two of them to become housemates, and together, they open a fortune-telling shop where troubled souls come searching for answers. The pair soon realize that each client's problem comes with hidden secrets and mysteries.

items.title: I Wanna Be Sup'Tar
items.overview: A disgraced superstar with nothing left ends up living under the same roof as an ordinary supporting actress. As house rules pile up and egos collide, their dysfunctional cohabitation spirals into sharp humor, constant friction, and consequences neither can avoid.

items.title: Meet Yourself
items.overview: Grieving the premature death of her closest friend, a despondent young Chinese woman quits her job to fulfill the friend's dying wish of visiting an area in southern China. What began as a three-month recuperative stay in a village far from the madding crowd gradually reveals the potential of life-changing camaraderie, romance, and purpose.

items.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea
items.overview: After concluding the opening ceremony of the Demon Kingdom Federation Tempest, Rimuru and his companions are invited by the Celestial Emperor Hermesia of the great elven nation – the Magi Dynasty Salion – to visit her private resort island. As the group enjoys their brief vacation, a mysterious woman named Yura appears. A new incident unfolds against the backdrop of the boundless azure sea.

items.title: Citizen Vigilante
items.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.
items.tagline: An action film based on real cases and a commentary about injustice.

items.title: Big Time Adolescence
items.overview: A seemingly bright and mostly innocent 16-year-old named Mo attempts to navigate high school under the guidance of his best friend Zeke, an unmotivated-yet-charismatic college dropout. Although Zeke genuinely cares about Mo, things start to go awry as he teaches Mo nontraditional life lessons in drug dealing, partying, and dating. Meanwhile, Mo’s well-meaning dad tries to step in and take back the reins of his son’s upbringing.
items.tagline: Under his influence.

items.title: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring
items.overview: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

items.title: Yowayowa Sensei
items.overview: Hiyori Hiwamura is known as the "Scary Teacher," and if you offend her, she'll put a curse on you! Or at least that's what everyone believes. She's secretly a total softy who's deeply misunderstood, and once you see her sweet side, she'll put a different kind of spell on you.

items.title: Finding Emily
items.overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.
items.tagline: Right name, wrong number.

items.title: La Haine
items.overview: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
items.tagline: How far you fall doesn't matter, it's how you land…

items.title: As the Gods Will
items.overview: High school student Shun Takahata is bored. Bored with the day-to-day monotony of school and life, he prays for change, for something exciting. Suddenly, he and his classmates are forced to play deadly children's games and facing terrifying creatures from a talking Daruma doll to a sharp-clawed lucky cat.
items.tagline: Oh my God, please return my tedious everyday.

items.title: Erased
items.overview: Struggling manga author Satoru Fujinuma is beset by his fear to express himself. However, he has a supernatural ability of being forced to prevent deaths and catastrophes by being sent back in time before the incident occurred, repeating time until the accident is prevented. One day, he gets involved in an accident that has him framed as a murderer. Desperate to save the victim, he sends himself back in time only to find himself as a grade-schooler one month before fellow classmate Kayo Hinazuki went missing. Satoru now embarks on a new quest: to save Kayo and solve the mystery behind her disappearance.

items.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
items.overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.
items.tagline: Daughter Missing, Past Unleashed.

items.title: Little Brother
items.overview: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.
items.tagline: An uncomfortably touching comedy.

items.title: King Kaew
items.overview: After a child in her care dies, a young woman is executed for a crime she didn't commit. Now, her spirit seeks justice for her wrongful death.
items.tagline: I'm innocent.

items.title: Savage House
items.overview: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.
items.tagline: Polite society has never been so Savage.

items.title: Donnie Brasco
items.overview: An FBI undercover agent infiltrates the mob and identifies more with the mafia life at the expense of his regular one.
items.tagline: In 1978, the US government waged a war against organized crime. One man was left behind the lines.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.overview: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.
items.tagline: The story with a twisted ending.

items.title: Descending Stories: A Life In Rakugo
items.overview: Set during the early Showa period, Yakumo enters the world of rakugo. He forms a friendship with talented storyteller Yurakutei. Yakumo admires Yurakutei’s talent and struggles to achieve his level of performance. With the help of geisha Miyokichi, Yakumo grows up as a rakugo storyteller. Yurakutei and Miyokichi get married, but they die in a mysterious accident. Yakumo takes Konatsu, who is the child of Yurakutei and Miyokichi, and raises her. Konatsu grows up blaming Yakumo as her parents’ enemy. Konatsu and Yakumo’s disciple Yotaro chases after the truth of her parents’ death, which Yakumo hides.

items.title: Tokyo Salad Bowl
items.overview: In Tokyo, police officer Mari Kouda and Chinese interpreter Ryo Arikino solve cases while bonding over meals from different cultures, forming an unexpected connection through their shared experiences.

items.title: The Science Club
items.overview: East Shinjuku Night High School has students with various challenges. Delinquent Taketo is trapped in a negative spiral. Filipina-Japanese Angela struggles with schoolwork, while Kasumi spends all her class hours in the infirmary. Shozo had to leave school to work in his youth. With guidance from their new science teacher, Fujitake, they work on an experiment for an academic conference.

items.title: I Didn't Love You Because I Was a Family, But I Loved You as a Family
items.overview: Follow the daily lives of the Kishimoto family.

items.title: The Sheep Detectives
items.overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
items.tagline: A new breed of mystery.

items.title: In the Hand of Dante
items.overview: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

items.title: Luck My Life
items.overview: Born with a silver spoon, an arrogant mahjong player loses all his luck. Now, he has to re-learn the game and will soon discover the joy and principles of life over the mahjong table. The final match will be his one shot to turn his life around.

items.title: A Special Memory
items.overview: The illness challenges the couple's love in a way they never anticipated, shifting the narrative from a sweet romance to an emotional journey.
items.tagline: What the mind forgets, the heart remembers...

items.title: Pegasus Market
items.overview: Employees at a struggling mart embrace their roles as kings, defying the customer-centric norms. The manager strives to revive the store, battling against a ruthless boss determined to ruin it.

items.title: Archives: The Nanyang Mystery
items.overview: In the early days of the Republic of China, a mysterious murder at sea draws Zhang Haiyan and his partner into an investigation that quickly spirals into a dangerous conspiracy. What begins as a search for truth aboard the massive ship Nan'an becomes a fight for survival in a world of intrigue and betrayal.

items.title: Wonder Wall
items.overview: A struggling couple accidentally moves into a lavish mansion and discovers a hidden fortune. But as unexpected troubles follow, they begin to question whether their sudden luck is a blessing or a curse.

items.title: Visage and Soul
items.overview: After losing her memory, Qiao Xiaomi is confronted by her brother at their father’s funeral, until her fiancé Qin Yu—missing for three years—suddenly returns to protect her. As he helps her recover memories, Xiaomi begins to rebuild her trust in him. But when she learns his reappearance was carefully orchestrated, she must decide whether love can survive the truth.

items.title: Lost in Oz
items.overview: When 12-year-old Dorothy Gale discovers her mother's mysterious journal in her Kansas home, she and her dog, Toto, are transported into a bustling, modern Emerald City. Disoriented and determined to get home, Dorothy embarks on an epic journey with West, a young witch, and Ojo, a giant Munchkin, to seek the magic she needs - as Oz faces its greatest magic crisis. Based on L. Frank Baum's books.

cast.name: Chris Cox
cast.character: Toto / Agent Wally Pugmill / Patchwork Doll / Winged Monkeys (voice)

items.title: Red Oaks
items.overview:
A coming-of-age comedy set in the "go-go" 80s  that is equal parts hijinks and heartfelt about a college student enjoying a last hurrah before summer comes to an end--and the future begins. 

David Myers, an assistant tennis pro at the Red Oaks Country Club in suburban New Jersey in 1985, is both reeling from his father's heart attack and conflicted about what major to declare in the fall. While there, he meets a colorful cast of misfit co-workers and wealthy club members including an alluring art student named Skye and her corporate raider father Getty.

items.title: Witch Hat Atelier
items.overview: In a world where only witches can cast magic, they must avoid being seen by ordinary people while casting. While Coco does her chores, she daydreams of becoming a witch. When a young witch named Qifrey visits her village, Coco uncovers the “absolute secret,” becomes Qifrey’s apprentice, and begins her studies. This is the story of children who encounter despair, yet reach out toward hope.
items.tagline: No one can ever know — the witch's absolute secret.

items.title: Power Ballad
items.overview: When Rick, a past-his-prime wedding singer, meets fading boy-band star Danny during a gig, the two bond over music and a late-night jam session. But when Danny turns one of Rick’s songs into the hit that reignites his career, Rick sets out to reclaim the recognition he believes he deserves - even if it means risking everything he cares about.
items.tagline: It's time to set the record straight.

items.title: I Love Boosters
items.overview: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.
items.tagline: Booster: Somebody who steals clothes from a store and sells them at a discount price, aka community service.

items.title: Carolina Caroline
items.overview: A young woman, desperate to leave her small town, runs away with a charming con man, embarking on a crime and passion-filled journey through the Southeast to find her estranged mother.

items.title: Tuner
items.overview: A talented piano tuner's life is turned upside down when he discovers that his meticulous skills for tuning pianos can equally be applied to cracking safes.
items.tagline: Everybody has one hidden talent.

items.title: Blue Heron
items.overview: In the late 1990s, a family of six settles into their new home on Vancouver Island, as internal dynamics are slowly revealed through the experiences of the youngest child, Sasha. Their fresh start is interrupted by the increasingly dangerous behavior of Jeremy, the family's oldest child.

items.title: Chapter 51
items.overview: An elusive serial killer known as the Hollywood Killer turns a high-profile film production into a grisly crime scene, murdering three actresses and casting a dark shadow over the troubled project.
