items.overview: A former medical school dropout claiming to be able to cure terminal illnesses is sentenced to death for the murder of 17 people. Is he a monstrous killer, or a savior holding the cure for humanity?
items.tagline: Hope is on death row.

items.title: Glory in Shadows
items.overview: Shen Yaochu is forced into a marriage with General Li Jingchuan, believed to be dead, only to discover he’s alive. After her mother’s tragic death, Shen Yaochu and Li Jingchuan join forces to unravel conspiracies and hidden plots within the Shen family, discovering trust and love along the way.

items.title: Old Street Justice
items.overview: In 1995, Zhao Fengsheng returns home only to be shunned by villagers, prompting him to lead the “Four Troublemakers of Old Street” in uncovering a dark conspiracy, settling old feuds, and restoring peace to their town.

items.title: Vaka
items.overview: An insomnia epidemic plunges Stockholm into chaos. A prime minister manages the crisis while protecting his son, a nurse fights to save her infected partner, and a teenager protects her neighbor amid the spreading disease.

items.title: Holy Light
items.overview: Intellectual Yi Gaoyuan and Tibetan girl Gesang Meiduo fall in love while studying at Tibet’s first modern school, against the backdrop of Tibet’s peaceful liberation and the region’s transformative journey into a new era.

items.title: A Vow in the Dark
items.overview: Three hundred years after immortal fairy Jin Li seals Demon Lord Jie Chuan, a celestial beast named Jin Li accidentally frees him and is taken to the Demon Realm for her rare power. As enemies bound by fate, their hostility slowly turns into love—until a shocking truth about Jin Li's origin threatens to tear them apart and rewrite their destinies.

items.title: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
items.overview: A dedicated customs officer and his team take on a notorious smuggler leading a powerful syndicate, but unexpected obstacles threaten their mission.

items.title: The Ultimate Vow, Unknown to You
items.overview: After her family is massacred, Shen Qingru infiltrates the General’s household through marriage to seek revenge against the man she believes destroyed her life. Trapped within palace intrigue, she becomes entangled in a turbulent relationship of love and hatred, until the truth behind the massacre is revealed—forcing both to choose between vengeance, sacrifice, and redemption amid a brutal power struggle.

items.title: Love: Track
items.overview: A romance anthology featuring 10 different love stories, each with its own unique tone and charm. It has an ensemble cast.

items.title: Reply 1988 10th Anniversary
items.overview: The special follows the cast on a two-day, one-night trip to celebrate the show's anniversary.

items.title: Elegy of Zhao Li
items.overview: To avoid an unwanted marriage, Jiang Li often escapes to Wenxiang Pavilion with her confidant A Zhao—only to later discover, after entering the palace as the Left General’s bride, that he is actually the emperor. Thrown into a world of romance and political intrigue, the two unite to crush rebellion and unravel hidden conspiracies.

items.title: Under the Surface
items.overview: After blaming her family’s downfall on her ex-husband Xiang Yang, Leng Xiaoxiao undergoes plastic surgery and manipulates her kind best friend Xie Yuxuan into helping her carry out a revenge scheme. But as unexpected complications arise, Xie Yuxuan begins to see Xiang Yang’s true character — and even develops feelings for him.

items.title: Will You Be My Manager?
items.overview: A student at a top entertainment school chases her dream of becoming a pop manager. Will a rival learn a secret from her past – and derail her plans?

items.title: LuBan Mysteries
items.overview: Master carpenter Li Mudun, famed for his skill with ancient Luban techniques, becomes the prime suspect in a series of eerie, superstition-filled murders. Determined to clear his name, Li teams up with detective Yang Zong and forensic doctor Su Qingyun. With reason and justice, the trio races to stop a new wave of killings and expose the truth behind the so-called “supernatural.”

items.title: Free Bert
items.overview: A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby crowd at their elite new school.

items.title: Extraordinary
items.overview: Shi Xiaofan, a modern engineer, transmigrates into a fictional dynasty as Shi Feifan, a notorious playboy, and secretly uses his advanced knowledge to protect his family, build power, and reshape the empire. While pretending to be irresponsible, he quietly amasses wealth, outsmarts political enemies, and rises from “good-for-nothing” to a hidden military force pivotal to the kingdom’s survival.

items.title: The Princess Decree
items.overview: When a political marriage ignites a long-awaited revenge, the returning Princess Royal and her former lover clash in the court’s power struggles. But as love and rivalry collide, they realize they are each other’s only salvation and join forces to reshape the kingdom’s future.

items.title: Love Through a Prism
items.overview: In early 1900s London, a young Japanese woman enrolls in a famous art school, only to be surprised when rivalry with a gifted classmate becomes romance.

items.title: The Sparrow's Gambit
items.overview: After being betrayed by her adoptive father, the formidable and beautiful assassin Qingmao is left for dead. In her final moments, she uncovers the truth that the mastermind behind her family's annihilation has been lurking nearby. Burning with vengeance, she bides her time for five years, reinventing herself as the enchanting songstress Liu Rumeng. Now, under this new identity, she sets her revenge plan in motion...

items.title: The Cross-Dressed Union
items.overview: Amid political chaos caused by the former emperor’s suppression of the military, the general’s son Nan Chenxiao disguises himself as a woman to stay safe, while aspiring official Rui Yu hides her identity by posing as a man. Forced into partnership through an unexpected marriage by the new emperor, the two face dangerous trials and uncover each other’s secrets to help the emperor restore stability to the realm.

items.title: The Palace Gambit
items.overview: Two sisters enter the palace and quickly earn the emperor’s favor, but their rise ends in tragedy when the elder sister—pregnant with the heir—is killed in a palace scheme. Left with nothing, the younger sister Lu Jiuning hides her grief and, as a lowly palace maid, carefully plots her revenge. Moving between rival consorts and imperial power, she wages a quiet but ruthless battle to avenge her sister’s death.

items.title: I AM BOXER
items.overview: Don Lee's extreme boxing survival. Who will survive to be the champion standing in the ring?

items.title: Silent Truth
items.overview: When a detective returns to his hometown to investigate a murder case, he uncovers shocking connections to the primary suspect and the weapon.

items.title: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
items.overview: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

items.title: What's in the Box?
items.overview: Players answer trivia to win spectacular hidden prizes — but can they keep them from the competition?

items.title: Gorgeous Dream
items.overview: Labeled as tainted after four years in prison, Shen Wanqing is destroyed by the Liu family to protect their reputation. Reborn with a new face as Lan Mengyan, she marries into the Liu household to seek revenge, drawing both father and son into her trap. But as her plan places her in growing danger, the mysterious Qin Moxiu—who has been watching from the shadows—steps in.

items.title: Chef of Antarctica
items.overview: Let's raid the Antarctic base's storage shed and serve warm meals to the thousands of researchers living in isolation, separated from their families, in Antarctic stations across more than 30 countries, driven by a sense of mission!

items.title: Love is Always Online
items.overview: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan secretly joins a virtual game to track down his first love, Yao Yuan, rekindling their relationship and bringing it into the real world. Just as their wedding plans begin, long-standing family grudges and unexpected hardships threaten to break them apart. Facing misunderstandings and illness, they must fight for each other and their future to prove that true love can withstand even the deepest grudges.

items.title: Badly in Love
items.overview: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

items.title: The Dreamwalker
items.overview: Hei Fuyi, the sole survivor of her family’s massacre, accidentally awakens the ancient lamp spirit A Qi and forms a life-bound partnership with her. With the spirited A Qi and a runaway young prince at her side, she moves through the chaos of the late Qing era, chasing supernatural secrets and human darkness until she uncovers the truth behind her family’s fall.

items.title: Start Up, Fall Down: From Billionaire to Convict
items.overview: One of Milan's most exclusive parties takes a dark turn when a woman reports sexual assault. This documentary chronicles the investigation that followed.

items.title: The Seven Legends
items.overview: A former soldier haunted by his past assembles a team of unlikely warriors to dismantle a powerful criminal empire threatening the nation.

items.title: Fortnite x The Simpsons
items.overview: Springfield and Fortnite universes converge. Chaos ensues as Homer sets out to transform the world, wielding a powerful alien energy.
items.tagline: Fortnite Battle Royale has crashed into Springfield!

items.title: Rise of Her Lady Physician
items.overview: After being wronged by a false accusation, gifted healer Rong Zelan enters the imperial palace determined to break into the male-dominated Imperial Medical Bureau. Defying ridicule and prejudice, she proves her brilliance in medicine within the palace—turning her struggles into an inspiring story of courage, justice, and equality on her journey to become the empire’s first female official.

items.title: Three Idiots in Kenya
items.overview: Once a far-off promise, now a reality — three buddies finally hit the road in Kenya. Get ready for adventure, banter and maybe even a giraffe selfie.

items.title: Her Phoenix Majesty
items.overview: Wandering scholar Xie Yuan accidentally enters a matriarchal kingdom where women take multiple husbands. Admired for his looks, he’s forcibly taken by the eldest princess to become her consort. Refusing to yield, Xie Yuan plans his escape, but when the gentle second princess aids him, he’s drawn into a dangerous struggle of power and deceit within the royal palace.

items.title: LOVE.exe
items.overview: After a university merges its modeling and computer engineering departments, the charming model Min-hak and the perfectionist coder Yeon-san, polar opposites in every way, unexpectedly fall for each other.

items.title: Tide of Love
items.overview: A wealthy heir and an art student enter a transactional arrangement that slowly deepens into real affection, forcing them to face what they truly want.

items.title: Life Like
items.overview: Disguised as a courtesan, assassin Zhen Xu crosses paths with Zhou Musheng, a man on a secret mission. Though they start by using each other, their bond deepens through peril and betrayal. Facing deadly threats together, they ultimately unite to expose the Chamber’s crimes.

items.title: MARINES
items.overview: Follow the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they conduct high-stakes combat exercises in the Pacific.

items.title: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
items.overview: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

items.title: Keeping Up with Beauty
items.overview: After a courageous general named Fu Yunyun time-travels into the body of a wealthy heiress, she becomes entangled in a web of love and deception. As she searches for the truth behind an ancient promise, Fu Yunyun must rely on her strength and wit to find her place in a world both familiar and strange.

items.title: SEVENTEEN: OUR CHAPTER
items.overview: Answers discovered through endless questioning, never-ending challenges and performances, and the stories shared with CARATs. This 10th-anniversary documentary series captures SEVENTEEN's candid stories.

items.title: Sicily Express
items.overview: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.

items.title: Silver Lining
items.overview: Chi Xia, a young detective joins the Dongzhou City task force to investigate her adoptive parents’ mysterious deaths. Working alongside team leader Luo Xun, she uses her keen psychological insight and his sharp observation skills to crack a series of intricate cases. Together, they uncover a powerful criminal network and bring justice back to Dongzhou City.

items.title: Search for Soul Stone
items.overview: Fifty years ago, the sudden emergence of spiritual energy within jadeite gave rise to families of superpowered individuals. After his clan is wiped out for their rare ability to sense jade aura, young Meng Yan escapes with a mysterious girl, Xiao Duo. Years later, he returns with newfound powers to seek revenge, igniting an epic clash between two generations of gifted beings.

items.title: The End of an Era
items.overview: A behind-the-scenes docuseries event chronicling the development, impact, and inner workings that created the phenomenon that was Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour, as well as providing an intimate look at Taylor's life as her tour made headlines and thrilled fans around the world. The series also spotlights performers, family members, and friends — including Gracie Abrams, Sabrina Carpenter, Ed Sheeran, and Florence Welch — offering never-before-seen insight into what it took to create a phenomenon.

items.title: Bad Influencer
items.overview: A single mother — and luxury bag counterfeiter — finds herself teaming up with a self-obsessed influencer to sell her bags and scrape her way out of debt.

items.title: Phoenix's Homecoming
items.overview: After being betrayed and killed in a fire, Princess Sheng Yunlin is reborn and sets out to reclaim her power. Using her wit and courage, she gathers allies, exposes corruption, and seeks justice for her family, all while navigating a dangerous love with the proud Grand Tutor Xie Fei amid courtly intrigue and political battles.

items.title: Just Alice
items.overview: Torn between two loves, Alicia secretly marries both a famous writer and a former priest. How long can she juggle love, lies and her double life?

items.title: Dear Secretary
items.overview: After three years working as a secretary, Lin Han decides to resign and start a new life. His boss, the poised CEO Qin Meili, tries her best to make him stay, but he’s determined to move on. As they prepare to say goodbye, both realize how much they’ve come to mean to each other.

items.title: The Spring Avenger
items.overview: At seventeen, Jiang Chunyu becomes the target of cruel bullying led by Gu Nian, a torment that ends with the heartbreaking death of her mother, the only family she had left. Years later, forged by suffering, she returns transformed into an angel of vengeance. In this gripping tale of retribution, no one will escape the consequences of her revenge.

items.title: The Bad Guys: The Series
items.overview: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.
items.tagline: Thinking outside the vault

items.title: Too Young To Love
items.overview: Gifted cellist Yi Lan, inspired by her mother’s influence and her childhood friend Tong Xiaole, forms a trio in her first week of high school to challenge the school orchestra and perform at the annual festival. Her fiery passion for music reignites Tong Xiaole’s own dream, and as they chase their ambitions together, love, friendship, and youth blend into a heartfelt symphony of growth and hope.

items.title: The Age of Passion
items.overview: After dropping out of school to protect his first love, Zhou Mingrui teams up with his friends Xu Jiaming and Pan Bowen to chase their dream of making video games. Despite financial struggles, technical challenges, and market doubts, the three persevere, supporting each other through countless sleepless nights to find success.

items.title: R.J. Decker
items.overview: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.
items.tagline: Private eye. Public mess.

items.title: Peach Trap
items.overview: At the lowest point in both his career and life, Yoo Do-ha unexpectedly encounters three very different men — a cold yet caring former boss, a playful younger barista, and a devoted childhood friend. Caught in a whirlwind of overlapping “peach blossoms,” Do-ha finds himself at the center of three blossoming romances. But who will win his heart in the end?

items.title: To My Beloved Thief
items.overview: A noblewoman who becomes a righteous bandit called Gil Dong, and Joseon Prince Yi Yeol who secretly investigates this bandit, only to find their souls mysteriously swapped, forcing them to work together and fall in love amidst intrigue, as they uncover conspiracies while protecting the people!

items.title: Gimbap and Onigiri
items.overview: A disillusioned former college track star working at a diner meets a tired Korean animation student struggling to find housing in Japan, and they instantly connect over an emotional moment involving a rice ball.

items.title: Oops! I’m in Jail
items.overview: After a career-ending injury, Taekwondo star Zhiyao falls into gambling and is forced to become a prison administrator, tasked with overseeing the notorious boss Chihuahua under the watchful eye of instructor Jiang Yijie. Amid the harsh, absurd conditions, Zhiyao and his colleagues form bonds of friendship, trust, and love, finding meaning and resilience in their challenging work.

items.title: Ferry of Souls
items.overview: Cursed monster hunter Shangguan Feiye, trapped in an inn for a thousand years, must team up with the inn’s amnesiac former owner Dongfang Zhaobai to break his curse. As they help mysterious guests resolve their lingering regrets, the two confront past misunderstandings and rediscover human emotions while confronting a powerful Demon King.

items.title: My Foxfoe Queen
items.overview: After the Fox Clan is wiped out by Prince Xiling Xuan of Xiling Kingdom, the clan’s sacred maiden Tu Shanyue survives as a wandering soul and possesses the body of the late Empress Jiang Xin'er. Determined to take revenge, she infiltrates the palace—only to uncover a shocking truth that changes everything.

items.title: Heated Rivalry
items.overview: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.

items.title: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. the Mafia
items.overview: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

items.title: GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops
items.overview:
Lee Kwang Soo, Kim Woo Bin, and Doh Kyung Soo are back with a hilarious new spin-off of the beloved “GBRB” series!

GBRB: Joy Pops Laugh Pops,” which will follow the trio as they set off on a whirlwind trip to Mexico in search of fresh perspectives and experiences.

The program is a spinoff of “GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria Operation,” where the KKPP Food employees successfully completed their missions and earned the chance to go abroad for an insight trip to help the company grow. It also marks the second spinoff of “GBRB: Reap What You Sow.”

items.title: Fragrance of the Pomegranates
items.overview: Ming Liang, a young man working away from home, must return to take over his ailing foster mother's failing restaurant, where he rediscovers his true self.

items.title: Beyond the Loop
items.overview: After being killed in a deadly betrayal, Yu Yingwan is reborn and stays in the City Lord’s manor to uncover the truth—only to discover her husband Mu Yunqing has also returned from death. Together, they must face the hidden mastermind and fight to change their tragic fate.

items.title: Mrs Playmen
items.overview: Betrayed by her husband, a woman must step up and run an erotic magazine that becomes a symbol of empowerment in '70s Rome. Inspired by true events.
items.director: Mario Ruggeri, Eleonora Cimpanelli, Chiara Laudani, Sergio Leszczynski, Alessandro Sermoneta

items.title: True Haunting
items.overview: Paranormal encounters from the viewpoint of those who lived them are detailed through immersive reenactments and present-day interviews.

items.title: Kurukshetra: The Great War of Mahabharata
items.overview: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.
items.tagline: Mahabharata’s Battlefield Knew No Friends or Enemies — Only Dharma and Destiny

items.title: The Game: You Never Play Alone
items.overview: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.

items.title: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
items.overview: When a naïve aspiring actor meets a goblin master feared for centuries, their fated bond reignites a love powerful enough to break a thousand-year curse.

items.title: JUST MAKEUP
items.overview: Korea's first-ever makeup survival show highlights all things K-beauty. Top makeup artists and creators compete, showcasing their skills. Expect stunning visuals and techniques as they unveil new looks with each mission. The tension is high as they vie for the title of No. 1 makeup artist. Get ready for a survival show filled with dazzling beauty.

items.title: My Secret Vampire
items.overview: A naïve student rents a cheap mansion in Seoul, only to learn his generous roommates are vampires—and his blood is the price of admission.

items.title: BAKI-DOU: The Invincible Samurai
items.overview: Baki and the strongest Underground Arena fighters face a threat of historical proportions: the resurrected Musashi Miyamoto, Japan's greatest samurai.

items.title: Pray Speak What Has Happened
items.overview: In 1984 Shibuya, four quirky young souls navigate life’s struggles while chasing joy in a city bursting with hope.

items.title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26
items.overview: Six studios and seven directors adapt the early works of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the mastermind behind "Chainsaw Man," into an anime anthology. Each episode is an anime adaptation of a short story he drew from ages seventeen to twenty-six, including the first manga he ever submitted for competition. Watch as vivid tales of young love, chaos, madness, and the bonds between people unfold in each episode.

items.title: Go Up Against the Immortals
items.overview: After betrayal leaves him for dead, Chen Yuan gains extraordinary powers and, with three formidable allies, embarks on a vengeful quest to defy fate, crush powerful clans, and protect the world from destruction.

items.title: Simon Cowell: The Next Act
items.overview: Simon Cowell is looking for the next hit boy band. And he's risking it all to find them. Will these young singers prove he's still got the Midas touch?

items.title: Destiny of the General's Bride
items.overview: After being betrayed, violated, and buried alive, Su Hua returns under the guise of courtesan Qing Yan to infiltrate the Xiao family, rescue her persecuted sisters, punish the guilty, and reunite with her true love, General Xiao Yun.

items.title: Inside: USA
items.overview: Content creators scheme, sabotage and spend in wild challenges to win up to $1M in the first US series from British YouTube collective the Sidemen.
items.tagline: 7 days. 12 insiders. $1,000,000.

items.title: Chainsaw Man - The Compilation
items.overview:
The two-part compilation, Part I and Part II, re-edits and condenses the key moments from the first season of the Chainsaw Man anime. This compilation revisits Denji's journey, from his humble beginnings as a debt-ridden devil hunter to his transformation into the Chainsaw Man.

In addition to the re-edited material, the compilation includes newly animated segments titled Chainsaw Days. These segments adapt bonus chapters from the original manga.

items.title: RIV4LRIES
items.overview: At a middle school in Pisa, no one has ever challenged the cool kids — until new girl Terry arrives with bold ideas and the rivalries begin.

items.title: Chosen Home
items.overview: A clumsy romantic, an aloof teacher and a troubled teen cross paths, forming an unlikely household in this offbeat comedy about love and belonging.

items.title: The Sisters Grimm
items.overview: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.
items.tagline: Fantasy gets real.

items.title: Chef's Go-To
items.overview: Where do chefs go to eat? Korea's top chefs have their go-to spots, and there's something special about them. Hearty dishes from a no-frills auntie, with words warmer than the food. Stories unfold at her table, from quiet moments to genuine laughter. Chef's Go-To, your next favorite.

items.title: YOO Got a Minute?
items.overview: K-Comedy icon Yoo Byungjae's new original variety show. So funny, time flies. So YOO Got a Minute?

items.title: Cringy Romance
items.overview: Clumsy when it comes to romance, four friends are ready to make fools of themselves to protect their love.

items.title: First Lady
items.overview: A political thriller depicting the suffocating conflict between a president-elect and his wife as an unprecedented incident unfolds in which he demands a divorce from his future first lady.

items.title: I Kill U
items.overview: Sun Woo comes from a poor family background. She was once a promising Taekwondo athlete, but she now works part-time jobs to support herself. One day, she is is selected to become the stand-in for Ji Yeon due to their similar appearance. Ji Yeon is the granddaughter of Beomhan Construction Company's chairman. She was the driver of a fatal hit-and-run car accident. Sun Woo must play Ji Yeon in front of the public and media. Meanwhile, Sun Woo becomes the target of Ho Joong’s hostility. Ho Joong is Ji Yeon’s stepbrother and he has an inferiority complex over Ji Yeon. He wants to become the successor to Beomhan Construction Company.

items.title: Anchovy Physical Camp
items.overview: Anchovy Physical Camp: We are uncut gems! Choi Daniel, DinDin, Jonathan, and O3ohn are four men with big dreams but little endurance. Join these "anchovies," who are all form and no function, as they face 12 hours of grind mode and hellish workout missions. Their only ray of hope is the reduction game. Failure to complete missions on time means no future for them. They must do whatever it takes to win this brutal battle, whether their opponents are themselves or the production crew. Their struggle to escape "anchovy" status is a sweaty, laughter-filled journey to physical growth. Warning: This show is highly interactive and can increase your endurance just from watching it.

items.title: Beauty and the Bester
items.overview: Did renowned Dr Nandipha get embroiled in Thabo Bester's prison break? This chilling documentary series examines the enigmatic ties that bound them.

items.title: Just a bit Espers
items.overview: A down-and-out salaryman, fired and divorced, lands a bizarre job requiring him to fake a marriage with a stranger to save the world.

items.title: Dudes
items.overview: In the midst of a masculinity crisis, four friends in their forties are losing their throne, privileges and identity; years ago, they would have been alpha males in charge of their lives, but they have had to live in the era of equality.

items.title: Crime Scene Zero
items.overview: In this mystery showdown, players engage in layered scenarios as either suspects or detectives — each striving to outsmart others and uncover the truth.

items.title: Nightmares of Nature
items.overview: Chilling tales of survival unfurl in this documentary series that captures the drama, danger and dark beauty of nature from the perspective of its prey.
items.tagline: It's only natural to be scared.

items.title: Next Gen Chef
items.overview: Twenty-one rising chefs vie to be crowned a generational talent and win $500,000 in this cutthroat competition set at the Culinary Institute of America.

items.title: Recruit a General to Lead the Troops
items.overview: A modern deliveryman Li Chengyu is transported to ancient times, where he disguises himself as a farmer to investigate rebels, becoming the son-in-law of village chief Chen Xinrou and unexpectedly finding love while using his modern knowledge to turn the tides.

items.title: Thundercloud Rainstorm
items.overview: Bound by a debt, an illegitimate son moves in with his aloof cousin, unaware that their uneasy deal will spiral into a deep and dangerous obsession.

items.title: A Lifetime of Happiness
items.overview: After a car accident leads Jin Daxi to be mistaken for his estranged twin brother Tong Sheng, the two switch lives, triggering clashes, unexpected romance, and tests of family loyalty. With the help of Jin Dahuan and Yan Yan, they work together to expose a dangerous scheme.

items.title: Strip Law
items.overview: An uptight lawyer teams with a flashy Las Vegas magician to bring some pizzazz to the city's stupidest cases in this adult animated comedy.

items.title: My Bias is Showing?!
items.overview: A flustered teacher scrambles to hide his fanboy side when his idol films at school—but being cast as his co-mentor makes secrets hard to keep.

items.title: aka Charlie Sheen
items.overview: Actor Charlie Sheen tells his story in this candid two-part documentary tracing his dazzling Hollywood rise, tabloid-topping fall and road to recovery.
items.tagline: This isn't a comeback. It's a revelation.

items.title: Human Specimens
items.overview: Professor Shiro Sakaki, a butterfly researcher, confesses to turning six young boys, including his own son Itaru, into "human specimens."

items.title: First Love
items.overview: Music drama series that focuses on six different love stories about the innocence of teen love. Every love story is unique and powerful, packed with scenes that will give you butterflies. Feel the nervousness and the excitement as these young boys and girls fall into each other.

items.title: Love Con Revenge
items.overview: Victims of romance scams try to reclaim their lives with help from "The Tinder Swindler" target Cecilie Fjellhøy and private investigator Brianne Joseph.

items.title: Providence Falls
items.overview: In 1844 Ireland, thief Liam falls for aristocrat Cora. When their love disrupts destiny, angels send him to present-day Oregon to ensure Cora marries another man. As her police partner, Liam struggles with his enduring feelings.
items.tagline: They can't be together, but they can't stay apart

items.title: Flower Sea
items.overview: After a mysterious soul swap, Chen Jing'an and Zhu Niannian wake up in each other's bodies - one becoming a wealthy heiress, the other the sister of her secret crush. As they search for the cause with the help of Chen Changning, unexpected complications arise, and the truth leads them down a path they never anticipated.

items.title: Return of the Queen
items.overview: Heiress Ye Haimeng returns under a new identity to unravel the dark secrets behind her arranged marriage to the powerful Lu family. But when she crosses paths with the mysterious second son, Lu Siyu, their twisted fates spark a dangerous romance neither of them saw coming.

items.title: The Royal Family
items.overview: Kurisu has always admired his father, who runs a tax accounting firm, and dreamed of working with him one day. To broaden his skills, he joined a major tax firm, but a professional setback left him disillusioned. His life takes an unexpected turn when he meets racehorse owner Sanno Kozo, reigniting his sense of purpose.

items.title: The Guest
items.overview: A seemingly perfect household unravels when an unexpected visitor arrives, exposing hidden tensions and political aspirations that threaten to tear the family apart.

items.title: Our Universe
items.overview: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.
items.tagline: We met not by chance, but by the universe

items.title: Tales of Five Immortals
items.overview: In war-torn Republican-era China, Lai Fu, a wandering sorcerer, sets out to avenge his family's massacre by unraveling a supernatural mystery, only to uncover a far-reaching conspiracy involving spirit possessions, treason, and a powerful enemy from his past.

items.title: Threads of Destiny
items.overview: After being reborn, Jiang Xueying swaps marriages with her sister and becomes the Crown Princess. She must outwit rival women in the household and join forces with her seemingly idle husband to expose a dangerous conspiracy.

items.title: Dangerous Love
items.overview: To avenge his father, Xu Beisheng goes undercover as the warlord’s adopted son, plotting to sabotage an arranged marriage between the Xu and Zhou families by getting close to Zhou Menghuan. But as genuine feelings grow, their relationship spirals into a destructive cycle of love and revenge, culminating in a tragic downfall amidst the turmoil of war and power struggles.

items.title: The Chosen One
items.overview: The story follows college student Gao Ying, who, on his way to university, accidentally stumbles into the Great Qing Hotel in Nanting Village. There, he encounters a series of bizarre events and unexpectedly awakens the long-sealed Prince Zhennan, Yin Ting. He is then dragged into a century-spanning catastrophe involving mysterious forces like the Tai Sui and ancient Shamanic powers.

items.title: The Hidden Heir Ye Chen
items.overview: Living under a false identity as a live-in son-in-law, Ye Chen hides his past as the heir to a powerful family. As he rises through high society to uncover the truth behind his parents' murder, he battles hidden enemies and forms unexpected alliances.

items.title: Trainwreck: Storm Area 51
items.overview: A viral joke about storming a secretive US Air Force base sparks a meme-fueled media frenzy and puts the military on alert in this bizarre true story.

items.title: Spice Up the 80's
items.overview: In 1980s China, orphan Lin Xiaoxiao escapes a forced marriage and heads to Yangcheng, where she starts as a waitress and rises in the fashion world. With the help of heir Liang Keqing, she battles betrayal and adversity to become a rising business star.

items.title: Reincarnated Love
items.overview: Haunted by prophetic dreams, noblewoman Jiang Ruoli crosses paths with young heir Huo Linchuan, who is trapped in a cycle of ten lifetimes. As they search for a way to break the curse, their alliance evolves into a heartfelt romance, unraveling long-buried secrets and discovering that love may be the key to their salvation.

items.title: KPOPPED
items.overview: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.
items.tagline: Music icons team up with the hottest K-pop idols for song battles with a major twist.

items.title: Miss Dong Spends Valentine's Day Every Day
items.overview: After a failed relationship and a wish for a perfect Valentine’s Day, socially awkward Miss Dong finds herself stuck in a romantic time loop, only to realize she’s trapped inside a high-tech love simulation created by cold-hearted CEO Lin Mochen. As the two uncover a deeper conspiracy behind the virtual world, they must navigate trust, betrayal, and unexpected feelings to find their way out.

items.title: Duel on Mount Hua
items.overview: «Jin Yong Wuxia Universe» (金庸武侠世界 / The Legend of Heroes) is a martial arts series based on the novels of Jin Yong, with «The Legend of the Condor Heroes» as its main plotline. The series weaves together two dramatic stories – «Hot Blooded» (30 episodes) and «Duel on Mount Hua» (30 episodes), the latter encompassing four character arcs: «Nine Yin True Sutra» (8 episodes), «Eastern Heretic and Western Venom» (8 episodes), «Southern Emperor and Northern Beggar» (8 episodes), and «Five Great Masters» (6 episodes).

items.title: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser
items.overview: Takes an inside look at the making of the hit reality TV competition, exploring the good, the bad, and the complicated. Featuring interviews with former contestants, trainers, producers, and health professionals, the documentary examines the show's approach to transformation, the support systems in place, and the unique challenges of filming reality television.

items.title: Kiss or Die
items.overview: Male comedians face off in a steamy improv drama where they must resist the advances of irresistibly seductive co-stars and deliver the ultimate kiss.

items.title: Limitless: Live Better Now
items.overview: Chris Hemsworth takes on epic challenges to reveal ways we can all live better today.

items.title: Unburied
items.overview: Aylín, a teenager from a working-class neighborhood, discovers her supernatural abilities: when she eats soil, she has visions that help her find missing people. Together with her brother and friends, she learns to master this new power. As her skills strengthen, she becomes a heroine fighting against the violence and injustice plaguing her neighborhood.

items.title: Enigma Black Stage
items.overview: When the play “The Bloom and a Thousand Bees” is in being remade, it calls for a serious casting for the lead female role. Now, everyone in showbiz scrambles for and it seems they will do whatever it takes. Thus, the watchful eye of a certain group looms over this audition. What no one knows is that there’s a dangerous secret lurking behind the curtain, and whatever black magic is called upon.

items.title: My Special One
items.overview: Sahoko, an unremarkable high school girl, despises good-looking boys and has sworn off love after experiencing deep emotional pain. But her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets Kouta, a gorgeous pop star. As she gets to know his passion for his fans and his kindness, she realizes that he is different from the boys who have hurt her. Despite her strong resolve, she finds herself falling for him. However, Sahoko learns that Kouta, too, has made a firm decision in his heart to avoid special bond due to his own painful past.

items.title: His Chosen Favor
items.overview: After transmigrating into the body of a burial concubine destined to die, modern graduate Lu Zhen'er refuses to accept her fate. When she discovers that the puppet emperor Xiao Wenjing is from her hometown, the two become entwined in a dangerous struggle against destiny—one in which he may be the only person who can change, or seal, her future.

items.title: Positively Yours
items.overview: A man and a woman who swore off marriage find their carefully controlled lives overturned after a one-night mistake forces them into an unexpected, reverse romance neither planned nor wanted.

items.title: Love Formula
items.overview: Jian Dan, a kind-hearted village girl, helps Han Yansheng, a gifted but traumatized math genius, heal and rediscover his strength. Together, they grow through friendship, love, and shared courage.

items.title: Blend Feelings
items.overview: After being betrayed in both love and career by her boyfriend, a traditional incense maker named Jian Xiangxiang discovers mysterious on-screen messages that predict her grim future. Determined to change her fate and seek revenge, she sets out to seduce Gu Jingshi - her ex’s powerful, wheelchair-bound uncle. What starts as a calculated plan for vengeance turns into an unexpected entanglement of passion and power.

items.title: Scrubs
items.overview: J.D. & Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time–medicine has changed, interns have changed, but their bromance has stood the test of time. Characters new and old navigate the waters of Sacred Heart with laughter, heart and some surprises along the way.
items.tagline: Scrub back in.

items.title: Mirrored Souls: A Ming Dynasty Mystery
items.overview: Young swordsman Chu Bufan visits Tongzhou to see a friend but accidentally witnesses a shocking death, pulling him into a web of mysterious cases. As he investigates, his journey for truth tests his courage and chivalry in the martial world.

items.title: Predestined Love
items.overview: After returning home to revive her mother’s failing restaurant, Ren Xizhou reunites with her estranged high school classmate Xiang Nanfeng. As they work together to save the restaurant and confront their past misunderstandings, they heal old wounds and find the courage to embrace a new beginning.

items.title: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her
items.overview: Yoki was once a human but reincarnated into a demon. He now holds a middling position serving the Demon King tasked with taking down the hero party. But when he finally faces them, Yoki thinks... ""No way… she's perfect."" Of all things, he fell in love at first sight with Cecilia, the priest of the hero party! Her serious gaze, her every little gesture—everything about her is too cute! She's an angel! And so, Yoki made up his mind that he would confess his feelings to her.

items.title: Namju Search
items.overview: Oh Seol-Rem was the top student in her grade year at her high school. She got addicted to an online game and failed to enter a university. She is now studying to take her university entrance exam after graduating from high school. She met a male character Tarakexcali in the online game and fell in love with Tarakexcali. She never met him in real life and didn't know anything about him except that he attends Ganghan University. They even promised to marry, but one day, he suddenly disappeared from the online game. She unplugs her computer and studies hard. Finally, Oh Seol-Rem enters Ganghan University where the male character Tarakexcali is attending in real life. She looks around for Tarakexcali.

items.title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time
items.overview: Offers the most intimate and profound exploration into the wide-ranging impacts of the Hurricane Katrina disaster to date. Weaving together critical moments of the crisis and the past events that precipitated it, the series delivers an unparalleled, emotionally raw examination of the storm’s personal, political and societal fallout.

items.title: Don't Call Me Ma'am
items.overview: Three 41-year-old friends—a former TV host turned housewife, an art center manager in a strained marriage, and a fashion editor chasing love—navigate the messy mix of career, desire, and identity in midlife.

items.title: Amy Bradley Is Missing
items.overview: This true-crime series investigates the 1998 disappearance of a 23-year-old woman from a Caribbean cruise and her family's tireless search for answers.
items.tagline: Have you seen Amy?

items.title: Half-awake
items.overview: Gu Yixiao, a ruthless business tycoon, seeks revenge on his secretary, Ye Xingwan, over a long-held misunderstanding, only to be drawn into a twisted love-hate relationship when she fights back. As past wounds resurface, both are forced to confront their emotions, leading to a path of redemption, though true peace remains uncertain.

items.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes
items.overview: Mixing present-day interviews with previously unheard recordings, this true-crime series examines serial killer David Berkowitz's mark on 1970s New York.

cast.name: Carl Denaro
cast.character: Self - Author, 'The Son of Sam' and Me / Shooting Survivor

items.title: The Demon
items.overview: Fan Dayao, the mighty Tiger Demon King, rules Qianchun Mountain with absolute power. Shen Wangchen, a frail and distant nobleman’s son, seeks a cat demon to cure his illness. When they meet, an unlikely and humorous cohabitation between human and demon begins.

items.title: Aligned Reverence
items.overview: After a tragic mistake leads to the downfall of her benefactors, orphaned Su Jinyuan returns seeking redemption. Her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yunyuan, the adopted son of the fallen family. Together, they defy betrayal, fight to survive, and ignite a passionate, fate-defying love as they seek justice and reclaim their destiny.

items.title: A Fleeting Dream
items.overview: After a devastating betrayal that costs her everything and nearly her life, Lian Xinru, a wealthy merchant’s daughter, returns years later disguised as a famous singer. Partnering with Pei Yuze, the enigmatic man who saved her, she embarks on a calculated and thrilling quest for justice and revenge.

items.title: Voyage to Haihun
items.overview: Wang Heng, a disillusioned modern man, is transported to the Western Han dynasty, where he meets De Jiu, a warrior woman who resembles his ex-girlfriend, and befriends the carefree Prince Liu He. Together, they attempt to change fate, but personal struggles and painful choices lead them on a journey of growth, redemption, and unexpected healing.

items.title: Zombie Warfare
items.overview: In a city plagued by terrifying undead and mysterious illnesses, the sorcerer Dongqing emerges from seclusion to investigate. Suspicious of both supernatural and human causes, he sets out to uncover the truth behind the deadly chaos threatening Xuancheng.

items.title: Eternal Joy with You
items.overview: After being betrayed in her past life, Xu Wannian is reborn, determined to protect her biological child and exact revenge on those who wronged her. As she confronts dark secrets and crosses paths with Pei Heng, an investigator linked to her past, they uncover a deep connection that spans lifetimes.

items.title: The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty
items.overview: Li Jingnian and Lin Xiaoran travel to Chang’an, unraveling a string of mysterious and unsettling cases along the way. With each investigation, they come closer to exposing the true culprit behind the chaos plaguing the empire. Through relentless pursuit of justice and intense confrontations, they fight to restore order and bring peace back to Chang’an.

items.title: The Time of Rebirth
items.overview: Lin Yue, a man trapped in a time loop for 100,000 years, finally escapes after saving a young saintess. Armed with millennia of experience, he sets off on an epic adventure, only to find that the powerful enemy he could never defeat is now reawakening in the world he’s returned to.

items.title: Starlit Bloom
items.overview: Gu Liusu, a meticulous jewelry brand founder and her unexpected one-night stand, Lu Xingchen, find themselves working together as boss and secretary. What begins as a comedic misunderstanding between opposites slowly transforms into a heartfelt romance, as professional respect deepens into emotional connection.

items.title: Her Feast
items.overview: After being framed and tortured to death, Zhang Wange is reborn three years in the past with memories of her previous life. Determined to uncover the truth, she teams up with police captain Lu Ye, whose dreams begin revealing key clues. As they follow these leads, their fates become deeply intertwined.

items.title: Delirium
items.overview: When his wife Agustina falls into delirium, a professor delves into her dark past to piece together her story and uncover the cause of her madness.

items.title: The Revenge Club
items.overview: Six strangers are brought together by a divorce support group who quickly transform from therapy-seeking victims into architects of retribution. With little in common beyond their pain, they form an unlikely bond. What begins as a cathartic outlet quickly spirals into something far more dangerous.

items.title: All the Sharks
items.overview: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.
items.tagline: Find the sharks. Win the cash.

items.title: Love Blossoms with the Wind
items.overview: After catching her boyfriend cheating, Song Qiyue returns to Wuxi to reclaim their guesthouse and start over. With the unexpected help of Gu Cian, a mysterious businessman, she renovates the inn and rediscovers purpose and love. But when she learns Gu Cian is the executive behind a redevelopment project threatening the guesthouse, their growing bond is put to the test.

items.title: Marked
items.overview: Desperate to pay for her daughter's life-saving surgery, devout ex-cop Babalwa turns to an unholy savior to help her stage a daring heist.

items.title: Your Sunshine
items.overview: Lu Ye flees abroad to escape a family debt and returns to Tang City years later to investigate her sister’s mysterious death. Teaming up with her former brother-in-law, Yin Zhuofeng, she joins a secret resistance group to uncover the truth behind a powerful underground organization. As they face danger and uncover long-buried family secrets, an unexpected romance begins to blossom.

items.title: Physical: Asia
items.overview: Elite athletes from eight countries battle for national pride. After grueling tests of raw strength and endurance, only one flag can claim victory.

items.title: Undercover Miss Hong
items.overview: A retro office comedy depicting the chaotic events that unfold in the late 1990s when Sammo Hung, a 30-year-old elite securities supervisor who only cares about work, goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate employee at a securities firm where suspicious money flows are detected.

items.title: Heroes Next Door
items.overview: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but to safeguard their families and neighborhood.
items.tagline: Heroes aren’t born—sometimes, they live next door

items.title: The 19th Medical Chart
items.overview: In Japan's newest medical specialty, general practitioner Tokushige Akira listens closely to his patients' stories, uncovering hidden truths and guiding them toward healing through empathy and conversation.
items.tagline: A doctor who treats the person, not just the illness

items.title: Cinderella Closet
items.overview: A small-town college student and a cross-dressing beauty school student team up to explore fashion, self-discovery, and love in the city.

items.title: Esports World Cup: Level Up
items.overview: Esports World Cup: Level Up follows the most ambitious Esports tournament ever staged—1,500 players, 22 titles, $60 million on the line. From rising prodigies to battle-tested legends, the race for the first-ever Club Championship unfolds in Riyadh. Just because something doesn’t have a history… doesn’t mean it can’t be historic.

items.title: Falling for Divinity
items.overview: A gifted girl protected by a mountain deity falls in love with an amnesiac general she once saved. Bound by a vow that drives them apart, she later reunites with him, only to be met with cold suspicion. Disguised as a soldier, she joins his army and uses her prophetic abilities to protect him. But when her people face annihilation, Bu Nian’s true identity awakens, forcing her to choose between the man she loves and the destiny she was born to fulfill.

items.title: The Many Deaths of Nora Dalmasso
items.overview: Who killed Nora Dalmasso? In this true-crime series, family and journalists share the untold story of her murder and the media storm that followed.

items.title: Let's Play
items.overview: Samara “Sam” Young is a developer in Los Angeles who’s about to achieve her dreams with her first video game, Ruminate. That is, until a popular streamer gives the game a scathing review. Even worse, Sam finds out the troublesome critic is now her new neighbor! Get lost in a comedic, romantic, and all-too-real story about gaming, memes, and social anxiety. Come for the plot, stay for the doggo.

items.title: Above the Clouds
items.overview: Bound by a tragic love across lifetimes, Lu Anning and Ling Cang break free from fate’s control. From enemies to allies, they embark on a journey of cultivation to gain power and rewrite their destiny.

items.title: Paramount
items.overview: After losing her family and being cast aside by her wealthy husband, Bai Luo returns as a cabaret singer with a secret agenda. Behind the glamour, she plots a calculated revenge, determined to make everyone who betrayed her fall under her control.

items.title: To Get Master
items.overview: After being unexpectedly pulled into the world of a fantasy novel, Li Song'er, a sheltered princess from the Kingdom of Zuimeng, finds herself entangled with a notorious dark lord. With her only way home tied to him, the two are forced into a reluctant partnership, one that quickly turns into a passionate and turbulent love-hate journey.

items.title: Single Papa
items.overview: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

items.title: Reminder
items.overview: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

items.title: Radioactive Emergency
items.overview: Physicists and doctors race to contain a massive radiological disaster and save thousands of lives.
items.tagline: Based on the Real-Life Cesium-137 Accident.

items.title: Returned Master
items.overview: After his family is massacred, Li Jianwei hides as a courtesan to seek revenge while drawing dangerously close to his unsuspecting target.

items.title: The Miracles
items.overview: In Shenzhen, a jobless Lu Da rekindles hope in a 24-hour bookstore; opera star Fan becomes a tech sales whiz in Huaqiangbei; delivery rider Tan earns dignity; drone engineers Zhang Yi and Nuan build love with code; teen Xiao Peng creates a wildlife overpass; planner Wang Pengqian and daughter protect mangroves, with spoonbill Y075 marking eco-change. These stories weave entrepreneurship, innovation, and sustainability, showcasing Shenzhen’s 45-year transformation and future promise.

items.title: Too Hot to Handle: Spain
items.overview: A group of flirty Spanish singles expect sun, parties and steamy hookups, but they quickly learn that winning €100,000 requires giving up sex completely.

items.title: A Head Coach's Turnover
items.overview:
Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team ‘Big Pandas’, which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae’ coaching a professional basketball team.

Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname ‘Maeng Gong Extermination Group’. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong.

With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.

items.title: Returning Pearl
items.overview: Lin Suisui is transported into the broken plot of My Fair Princess and becomes a maid in the Empress’s palace. To return home, she must fix the story, while unexpected complications from a mysterious guard threaten to derail everything.

items.title: Mr. Scorsese
items.overview: Explore the many lives of Martin Scorsese through intimate interviews with the man himself, access to his private archives, plus conversations with Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Margot Robbie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Steven Spielberg, and more.
items.tagline: The story behind the storyteller.

items.title: Learning to Love
items.overview: This romance follows two unlikely souls bridging vast differences through secret lessons. A strict high school teacher, raised in a rigid household, begins tutoring a kind-hearted but illiterate nightclub host. As their bond deepens, societal judgment, jealousy, and prejudice threaten their forbidden connection.

items.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
items.overview: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants — Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride. With even wilder stories, bigger twists, and surreal humor, the show is so amazing that they had to rename it!

items.title: Boys II Planet
items.overview:
Boys II Planet is a survival show broadcasted on Mnet. It is a sequel to Girls Planet 999 and Boys Planet. Planet K premiered on July 17 while Planet C started airing on July 18, 2025.

Boys II Planet is based on the themes and aesthetics of space. It consists of two programs, K and C, produced in Korean and Chinese respectively, with both programs following the same format for each contest. The show will create a twin group project, with both groups debuting at the same time. The final line-up will work in two different groups, K and C, and will also work as a complete group.

items.title: Cocaine Air: Smugglers at 30,000 Ft.
items.overview: 2013: four Frenchmen are arrested in Punta Cana with 700 kg of cocaine — none fit the trafficker profile. This documentary asks: who was behind the bust?

items.title: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
items.overview: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.
items.tagline: Obsession is the main ingredient.

items.title: Memory of a Killer
items.overview: Angelo Doyle lives two totally separate lives — fearsome NYC hitman and sleepy upstate Cooperstown photocopier salesman and father. Both of them are threatened when he is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, a disease he already lost his older brother to.
items.tagline: A fading mind. A violent past.

items.title: Sara - Woman in the Shadows
items.overview: The suspicious death of her son pushes a former secret agent back into action, investigating a series of crimes that grows increasingly sinister.

items.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour
items.overview: "No new recipe, no return!" Three men set sail on a survival cooking adventure under this ultimate mission. Ryu Su Young (a.k.a. Mr. Eo), a man with proven culinary skills, teams up with Yoon Kyung Ho, who keeps the team grounded with humor, and Kihyun, full of youthful energy and passion. Though they come from different backgrounds and personalities, their unique colors blend as they build teamwork and develop creative new recipes. But the challenges go far beyond the kitchen. From unfamiliar food cultures to language barriers, wave after wave of obstacles stands in their way. Will this trio complete their culinary mission and successfully navigate their way back home? (Credit: Kocowa)

items.title: Murder Drones
items.overview: A heart warming story of "destroy all humans." Uzi, a sardonic teen worker robot gone rogue befriends N, an excitable optimistic disassembly drone sent to destroy her, creating what we can assume is a very bad relationship for mankind.
items.tagline: Cute little robots that murder each other for reasons.

items.title: The Unseen
items.overview: A series of bizarre cases intertwines the fates of mystery blogger Shen Man and young detective Jiang Li. Together, they join forces to unravel the complexities hidden within layers of mystery to uncover the truth.

items.title: Power Moves with Shaquille O'Neal
items.overview: NBA legends Shaquille O'Neal and Allen Iverson work to revive Reebok's legacy and find a rising star to rep the brand.

items.title: Marshals
items.overview: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.
items.tagline: A new era of Yellowstone.

items.title: Love Is for the Dogs
items.overview: A divorce lawyer Aiko and vet Kai bond over their dogs, while Korean conglomerate heir  Seo-ha approaches Kai on a mission. Their paths collide in a love story about connection and growth sparked by their pets.

items.title: The Echoes of Survivors: Inside Korea's Tragedies
items.overview: Discover the harrowing tales of those who survived Korea's gloomiest chapters, shedding a light on long-hidden truths.

Chen Xiaohua, a once good-for-nothing emperor, undergoes a journey of growth with help from his bionic concubine E-2099, only to discover it was all a virtual world. In reality, he's in a coma, and his girlfriend sacrificed herself to save him. Now awake, he must find a way to bring her back.

items.title: Manbo Destiny
items.overview: While expanding her e-commerce business abroad, Chinese entrepreneur Guan Mengmeng is swept into royal intrigue in the Kingdom of Manbo. A contract marriage with Crown Prince Song Pai turns into a powerful partnership, as she helps him fight for the throne and he backs her mission to bring digital change to his country.

items.title: The Long Snake Takes a Wife
items.overview: Haunted by his mother’s unsolved death, Bai Zhongtian returns to Baiyun Town, where sinister legends of ghostly weddings and supernatural rituals begin to reappear. As strange sightings and rumors spread, he follows a trail of clues to uncover the truth hidden beneath the town’s eerie folklore.

items.title: YOLANTHE
items.overview: This reality series follows Yolanthe Cabau in her glamorous new life in Los Angeles as she faces unexpected challenges and ghosts from her past.

items.title: Oops! Almost Broke Up
items.overview: After breaking up, Chen Jiawen and Shen Meng find themselves trapped in a repeating day. As they face a series of emotional challenges and confront buried issues, they must work together to break the cycle and move forward.

items.title: Unspeakable Sins
items.overview: A woman starts an affair with a male escort to get revenge on her controlling husband, but the plan spirals into a dangerous fight for survival when it leads to a crime scene with her husband missing and her lover on the run.

items.title: Love from 9 to 5
items.overview: Two colleagues from vastly different backgrounds initially despise each other. He is a privileged "nepo baby," while she is a determined worker who has earned everything through her efforts. Their competitive spirit leads to unexpected sparks and, eventually, deeper affection.

items.title: Kill Lover
items.overview: After losing her parents to a powerful tycoon’s scheme, You You returns years later under a new identity to seek revenge. Teaming up with Qi Dong, her former enemy and the tycoon’s discarded son, they unite against a shared past, unaware that a greater threat looms.

items.title: Marry My Husband: Japan
items.overview: Misa has been a supporting character all her life, blindly trusting her best friend and husband. When she discovers their affair, the betrayal results in her death. Waking up ten years in the past, Misa vows to become the main character of her own story. She plans to ruin her betrayers by making them marry each other, but after meeting her director at work, starts to consider who she truly is.

items.title: The Seven Relics of ill Omen
items.overview: Adapted from the novel The Seven Relics of ill Omen by Weiyu. In ancient times, a mysterious substance descended upon Fengzi Ridge. Capable of parasitic invasion, it twists the human heart and lures its host into evil. Now, these relics of ill omen have reemerged, unleashing a series of bizarre and gruesome murders. Five ordinary yet passionate young people—Mu Dai, Luo Ren, Thirteen-Thousand, Yan Hongsha, and Cao Yanhua—are successively drawn into this crisis through their own fateful encounters. They form the "Phoenix Squad" and embark on a perilous quest to subdue these ill omens. Amid life-and-death trials, Luo Ren and Mu Dai heal each other's wounds and forge a genuine bond. Through a long and arduous journey fraught with danger, the five overcome relentless challenges, their friendship tempered and deepened in the fires of adversity.

items.title: To Get Her
items.overview: South Korea’s first lesbian dating reality show, *To Get Her*, follows seven single women as they live together, connect, and search for love.

items.title: Helluva Boss
items.overview: In Hell, imp Blitzø (the 'o' is silent) runs an assassin business targeting the world of the living, using a spell book borrowed from a prince of the underworld. With employees Moxxie, Millie, and Loona, they attempt to survive each other while keeping business afloat.
items.tagline: R u in hell and need someone less alive? We can do that!!

items.title: Moonlit Order
items.overview: Feng Zuoren, a skilled assassin, disguises herself as a beautiful stepmother to infiltrate a noble family and eliminate the former crown prince. However, her mission becomes complicated when she develops a tense and unexpected bond with her clever stepson, uncovering secrets that challenge everything she thought she knew.

items.title: F1: The Academy
items.overview: Fifteen young women break barriers in one of the world's most demanding sports as they race to get a female driver back on the Formula 1 grid.

items.title: Love Phobia
items.overview: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.

items.title: CIA
items.overview: When by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman is loaned out to a clandestine CIA/FBI task force, he finds himself teamed up with secretive and roguish CIA case officer Colin Glass. Together they work covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells, and geopolitical secrets.
items.tagline: Two agents. One mission. Two methods.

items.title: Cold Case: The Tylenol Murders
items.overview: Who really laced Tylenol with cyanide? This true-crime series examines alarming theories behind the unsolved killings — and tracks down a key suspect.

items.title: WWE: Unreal
items.overview: From Monday Night RAW to WrestleMania, this series goes backstage with WWE Superstars and staff as they bring the company's biggest spectacles to life.
items.tagline: It's more real than you think.

items.title: LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy - Pieces of the Past
items.overview: A new threat rises in the galaxy, and Sig Greebling and Darth Dev must combine their powers of Force Building and Sith Breaking to stop it. Alongside Jedi Bob, Yesi Scala and Servo, they will journey into the deepest corners of Lego Star Wars lore, uncovering pieces of all the galaxies that have come before.

items.title: He Kills It
items.overview: Wu Ming, heir to a traditional Chinese medicine family, sets out to save his fiancée’s life but is drawn into a high-stakes mission when a billion-yuan reward is offered to cure a dying CEO. His journey becomes one of danger, opportunity, and unexpected romantic entanglements, forcing him to navigate both temptation and destiny.

items.title: Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!
items.overview: She's small. She's sweet. She's…capable of obliterating a tank in under three seconds?! Built by Enji and Suzume, two underappreciated genius scientists, Alma is the ultimate self-learning AI. There’s just one thing: She thinks they’re her mom and dad! Now as unexpected co-parents, the duo must hide their budding romantic feelings while taking on the messiest experiment of all: family life!

items.title: Fred and Rose West: A British Horror Story
items.overview: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.

items.title: Aniela
items.overview: After her wealthy husband leaves her with nothing, a high-society Warsaw snob is forced to use the only survival skills she has left — her sharp wit.

items.title: Franklin
items.overview: A counterfeit artist, also a single father, is forced to work with his ex-lover to craft the perfect $100 bill — all to save his dying daughter.

items.title: Better Late Than Single
items.overview: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

items.title: Final Draft
items.overview: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?

items.title: Secret Files of XSA
items.overview: Project Azure-1, a high-profile scientific endeavor, becomes the target of sabotage by the foreign spy agency SAD and a group controlled by Gapung, aiming to steal its technology. National security officer Huo Min and his team race to stop the sabotage and bring the conspirators to justice.

items.title: Qingchuan's Veil of Vengeance
items.overview: In the tenth year of the Zhanghe era, rebellious crown prince Xia Qiguang is sent to study under the scholar Mo Wang, unaware that his teacher is the legendary general Mo Qingchuan in disguise. As they bond through trust and sacrifice, they fight to restore honor to fallen heroes and protect their kingdom.

items.title: The Architect
items.overview: After her family is massacred on her wedding night, Shen Changning is miraculously reborn as Xi Yan, a dancer in Governor Pei Yu’s household. Using beauty and cunning as her weapons, she joins forces with Pei Yu to navigate a dangerous game of revenge and reclaim her destiny.

items.title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord
items.overview: Reborn as a marquis’ fourth son, Van was once hailed as a genius prodigy—until he’s exiled to a nameless frontier village for possessing Production Magic, a useless type of magic in this world. But when he uses his “useless” power to craft weapons, tools, and wonders beyond imagination, the village begins to thrive! What began as exile is now the start of a new life—and a world-changing adventure!

items.title: The Future Lover
items.overview: Zhou Nanfeng discovers a diary that lets him travel back in time to stop a vengeful act that could destroy Qin Zhiyi’s future. As past and present collide, four lives become entangled in a cycle of love, revenge, and fate, where uncovering the truth may come at the ultimate cost.

items.title: Angi: Fake Life, True Crime
items.overview: Sentenced for the murder and impersonation of her friend, this documentary sheds new light on Angi — and the death of her husband years before.

items.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
items.overview: Two outlaws must navigate the galaxy's dangerous underworld as they chart their destinies.
items.tagline: Return to a galaxy outside the law.

items.title: Her Trajecting
items.overview: Shu Yan, an extreme giver, sacrifices her family and career, leading to a series of tragic events. After regaining her clarity, she slowly rebuilds her life, and overturns her misfortune, alongside Shen Weizhou.

items.title: Be Yourself
items.overview: After a century of cultivation, an ancient monster ascends, only to be destroyed by lightning tribulations. Merging with Zhao Feiyang, the useless fourth son of the Zhao family, they begin an extraordinary journey, starting with three marriage proposals and an exciting new life.

items.title: Dominion and Devotion
items.overview: As the Great Ning Dynasty falls into turmoil, Pei Shenzhi manipulates the late emperor’s edict to place Ning Jinyi on the throne as a puppet ruler. Though she appears obedient, Ning Jinyi secretly builds her power and pushes for reform. Impressed by her intelligence, Pei Shenzhi becomes entangled in her rise as she purges the court.

items.title: Suspicious Partner
items.overview: After a disastrous first encounter, a stern prosecutor and a spirited judicial trainee are unexpectedly drawn into each other’s lives, where chaos sparks an unlikely connection.

items.title: Please Die My Beloved
items.overview: Three women, each facing troubled marriages, unite after one confesses to killing her husband, leading them on a path of revenge and self-discovery as they fight to reclaim their happiness.

items.title: The Reluctant Preacher
items.overview: When Shizuka Urumi reluctantly works as a high school teacher and aims to keep her distance, her students provoke her to get involved in their lives.

items.title: Love Story in the 1970s
items.overview: In 1970s China, Fei Ni, a hardworking factory girl, enters a fake marriage with Fang Muyang to secure housing and chase her dream of attending college. Through shared struggles and quiet moments, their bond deepens into real love as they pursue a brighter future together.

items.title: Love Me to Death
items.overview: A devoted husband and his loving wife’s seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when a female reporter is murdered, plunging them into a suspenseful web of love, madness, and danger.

items.title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
items.overview: Yoi Takiguchi is a first-year high school student, admired for her handsome looks and honest heart, which earned her the nickname “Prince.” One day, she bumps into Kohaku Ichimura, an upperclassman and another “Prince.” As the two grow closer, is what blossoms between them friendship or love? A youthful love story about a boy and a girl who are both called “Princes” begins.

items.title: Two Husbands One Wife
items.overview: When a man's ex suggests a three-person marriage with her boyfriend, the trio face jealousy, social stigma and intimacy issues in their unique setup.

items.title: A Tragedy Foretold: Flight 3054
items.overview: The untold stories and human tragedy behind Latin America's deadliest air disaster are investigated in this three-part documentary series.

items.title: Love Design
items.overview: Two former lovers turned rival architects clash professionally after a betrayal involving stolen work. Their competitive relationship grows more complex when a new romantic interest emerges.

items.title: Honour
items.overview: There's no statute of limitations on revenge. A mystery thriller about three female lawyers who confront the past head-on, as it returns as a massive scandal.
items.tagline: Three women. One buried truth. No escape

items.title: The Practical Guide to Love
items.overview: A woman determined to finally open her heart goes on a blind date with two very different men, and through the chaos and charm of it all, she ends up figuring out what love actually means for her.

items.title: Mechanical Marie
items.overview: Former martial arts legend Marie has accepted a new job as a “mechanical maid”… except she’s 100% human, and Arthur, her new boss, despises humans. Luckily, Marie’s naturally expressionless face helps her keep up the robot act while secretly protecting Arthur from constant assassination attempts. But when Arthur falls in love with his “perfect” maid, things quickly spiral out of control!

items.title: Queen's House
items.overview: A wealthy designer yearning for a simpler life has her world turned upside down by a shocking event, drawing her into the path of a compassionate surgeon whose life is consumed by a quest for revenge after a heartbreaking loss.

items.title: From Rock Star to Killer
items.overview: In 2003, rock singer Bertrand Cantat killed his partner, actress Marie Trintignant. This documentary revisits the case that divided a nation.

items.title: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
items.overview: Once a loyal court magician supporting the crown prince from behind the scenes, Alec Ygret is cast aside and exiled for only knowing support magic. But just as he hits rock bottom, he reunites with Yorha Eisentz, a former comrade from the legendary party Lasting Period. Invited to rejoin the team that once made history, Alec returns to dungeon exploration—and begins a new chapter in his life!

items.title: My Boyfriend
items.overview: The domineering CEO, Yi Ning, must marry to inherit her family business. Thus, she chooses a “supportive husband” — the charming private chef, Shen Qianze to start a contract marriage. Following their role reversal, Yi Ning finds herself falling for him. However, little does she know that Shen Qianze harbors a shocking secret. As he deliberately draws closer, she unknowingly surrenders to his love...
